# BH00010 (Unnamed)

*Translated on 17 Qudrat 183 using GPT 6.1 Sol*

### 1

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسم ربّنا الأقدس الأعظم العلیّ الأبهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismi rabbinā al-Aqdas al-Aʿẓam al-ʿAliyy al-Abhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of our Lord, the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious.
:::

### 2

::: {.original lang="ar"}
الحمد للّه الّذی تفرّد بالمحبّة و توحّد بالوداد انّه لمولی العباد و مالک الایجاد و النّاطق بما اراد فی المبدء و المعاد و النّفحة الّتی تضوّعت من قمیص اللّه و النّور المشرق من افق عنایته و السّلام الظّاهر اللّائح من ملکوت فضله علی الّذین قاموا علی اعلآء کلمته و اظهار امره و عملوا بما امروا به فی کتابه اولئک عباد بهم جرت الأوامر و الأحکام بین الأنام و ثبت حکم التّقدیس بین الأحزاب بهم رفعت الرّایات و ظهرت العلامات یصلّینّ علیهم الملأ الأعلی و عن ورائهم مالک الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī tafarrada bi-l-maḥabbati wa-tawaḥḥada bi-l-widād. Innahu la-mawlā al-ʿibādi wa-māliku al-ījādi wa-l-nāṭiqu bi-mā arāda fī al-mabdaʾi wa-l-maʿād. Wa-l-nafḥatu allatī taḍawwaʿat min qamīṣi Allāhi wa-l-nūru al-mushriqu min ufuqi ʿināyatihi wa-l-salāmu al-ẓāhiru al-lāʾiḥu min malakūti faḍlihi ʿalā alladhīna qāmū ʿalā iʿlāʾi kalimatihi wa-iẓhāri amrihi wa-ʿamilū bi-mā umirū bihi fī kitābih. Ulāʾika ʿibādun bihim jarati al-awāmiru wa-l-aḥkāmu bayna al-anāmi wa-thabata ḥukmu al-taqdīsi bayna al-aḥzāb. Bihim rufiʿati al-rāyātu wa-ẓaharati al-ʿalāmāt. Yuṣalliyanna ʿalayhimu al-malaʾu al-aʿlā wa-ʿan warāʾihim Māliku al-Asmāʾi wa-Fāṭiru al-Samāʾ.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to God, who is peerless in love and unique in affection. He is indeed the Lord of all servants, the Master of creation, who speaks whatever He wills in the beginning and the return. May the fragrance wafting from the garment of God, the light shining from the horizon of His loving care, and the peace manifest and radiant from the kingdom of His grace rest upon those who have arisen to exalt His Word and make His Cause manifest, and have acted as they were commanded in His Book. These are servants through whom the commandments and laws have gained currency among humanity and the rule of sanctity has been established among its peoples. Through them the banners have been raised and the signs have appeared. The Concourse on high will surely bless them, and beyond them, the Lord of Names and Creator of heaven.
:::

### 3

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و بعد قد اشرق من افق سمآء ودادکم ما تهیّجت به اریاح المحبّة انّه لکتاب ترشّح فیه انآء الفطرة فلمّا وجدت العرف و عرفت ما انتم علیه فی امر اللّه ربّی و ربّکم و ربّ من فی السّموات و الأرض قصدت المقام المحمود الّذی فیه استقرّ عرش مالک الوجود و سلطان الغیب و الشّهود حضرت و عرضت ما نطق به عندلیب خلوصکم علی غصن الوفآء اذاً توجّه الیّ وجه مالک الأسمآء تاللّه قد نطق بما طارت به الجبال ولکن مرآة قلبی ما انطبع علیها الّا علی قدر ضرّی و مسکنتی و فقری و فاقتی یا محبوب فؤادی کیف تقدر القطرة ان تحصی بحر البیان لعمر محبوبی و محبوبکم لا اتکلّم الّا بالحقّ براستی عرض مینمایم و آنمحبوب قلب شاهد و گواهند چه که بفضل اللّه آگاه بوده و هستند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-baʿdu qad ashraqa min ufuqi samāʾi widādikum mā tahayyajat bihi aryāḥu al-maḥabbah. Innahu la-kitābun tarashshaḥa fīhi ināʾu al-fiṭrah. Fa-lammā wajadtu al-ʿarfa wa-ʿaraftu mā antum ʿalayhi fī amri Allāhi rabbī wa-rabbikum wa-rabbi man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-arḍi qaṣadtu al-maqāma al-maḥmūda alladhī fīhi istaqarra ʿarshu Māliki al-Wujūdi wa-Sulṭāni al-Ghaybi wa-l-Shuhūd. Ḥaḍartu wa-ʿaraḍtu mā naṭaqa bihi ʿandalību khulūṣikum ʿalā ghuṣni al-wafāʾ. Idhan tawajjaha ilayya wajhu Māliki al-Asmāʾ. Ta-llāhi qad naṭaqa bi-mā ṭārat bihi al-jibālu wa-lākin mirʾāta qalbī mā inṭabaʿa ʿalayhā illā ʿalā qadri ḍurrī wa-maskanatī wa-faqrī wa-fāqatī. Yā maḥbūba fuʾādī kayfa taqdiru al-qaṭratu an tuḥṣiya baḥra al-bayān. La-ʿamri maḥbūbī wa-maḥbūbikum lā atakallamu illā bi-l-ḥaqq. Bi-rāstī ʿarḍ mī-namāyam va ān maḥbūb-i qalb shāhid va guvāhand chih kih bi-faḍl-i Allāh āgāh būdih va hastand.
:::

::: {.translation}
To continue: from the horizon of the heaven of your affection there has shone forth that which has stirred the winds of love. It is indeed a letter in which the vessel of your innate nature has overflowed. When I perceived its fragrance and recognized your condition in the Cause of God, my Lord and your Lord and the Lord of all who are in the heavens and on earth, I set out for the praised station where the throne of the Lord of existence, the Sovereign of the unseen and the seen, is established. I entered His presence and presented what the nightingale of your sincerity had sung upon the branch of faithfulness. Then the face of the Lord of Names turned toward me. By God, He spoke words that made the mountains take flight, yet nothing was imprinted upon the mirror of my heart except in the measure of my affliction, lowliness, poverty, and need. O beloved of my heart, how can a drop encompass the ocean of utterance? By the life of my Beloved and yours, I speak only the truth. I tell you truly, and that Beloved of the heart bears witness and testimony, for through the grace of God He has been and remains aware.
:::

### 4

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قال جلّت عظمته و عظم کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qāla jallat ʿaẓamatuhu wa-ʿaẓuma kibriyāʾuh.
:::

::: {.translation}
He said—exalted be His grandeur and great His majesty:
:::

### 5

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بنام مظلوم آفاق
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-nām-i Maẓlūm-i āfāq.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of the Wronged One of the world.
:::

### 6

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا علی الحمد للّه بصر عالم از کحل حکمت و بیان احبّای الهی روشنست اگرچه این روشنی را سحاب تیرهٴ اوهام خلق از ظهور و بروز منع نموده ولکن البتّه اریاح اراده این ابر را متفرّق نماید اوست قادر و توانا و قدرتش الیوم مستور ولکن در سرّ بفتح مدائن قلوب مشغول بیان رحمن مفتاحی است قوی و فاتح و آفتابیست مشرق و لائح و بحریست محیط بگشاید و نور بخشد و حیات عطا نماید طوبی از برای بصیریکه شکّ و ریب و اوهام و ظنون و سطوت و غضب اهل عالم او را از ذروهٴ علیا منع ننمود بیک کلمه عالم مضطرب و بکلمهٴ اخری ساکن و مطمئن و بیک عمل مشتعل و بعمل آخر برد و سلام اینست که از قلم اعلی در زبر و الواح اخلاق روحانیّه و اعمال مرضیّه و کلمهٴ طیّبه از جنود قویّهٴ الهیّه ذکر شده از جمیع مراتب گذشته اگر ناس بانصاف تمسّک نمایند هم خود بانوار یقین فائز گردند و آثار و حجج و براهین حقّ جلّ جلاله را بمثابهٴ آفتاب مشاهده نمایند و هم کرسیّ اقتدار حقّ مابین عالم ظاهراً باهراً مشاهده گردد
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿAlī, al-ḥamdu li-llāh, baṣar-i ʿālam az kuḥl-i ḥikmat va bayān-i aḥibbā-yi ilāhī rawshan ast. Agarchih īn rawshanī rā saḥāb-i tīrih-yi awhām-i khalq az ẓuhūr va burūz manʿ nimūdih va-lākin al-battih aryāḥ-i irādih īn abr rā mutafarriq namāyad. Ūst qādir va tavānā va qudratash al-yawm mastūr va-lākin dar sirr bi-fatḥ-i madāʾin-i qulūb mashghūl. Bayān-i Raḥmān miftāḥī ast qavī va fātiḥ va āftābī-st mushriq va lāʾiḥ va baḥrī-st muḥīṭ. Bi-gushāyad va nūr bakhshad va ḥayāt ʿaṭā namāyad. Ṭūbā az barā-yi baṣīrī kih shakk va rayb va awhām va ẓunūn va saṭvat va ghaḍab-i ahl-i ʿālam ū rā az dhurvih-yi ʿulyā manʿ nanimūd. Bi-yik kalimih ʿālam muḍṭarib va bi-kalimih-yi ukhrā sākin va muṭmaʾinn va bi-yik ʿamal mushtaʿil va bi-ʿamal-i ākhar bard va salām. Īn ast kih az Qalam-i Aʿlā dar zubur va alvāḥ akhlāq-i rūḥāniyyih va aʿmāl-i marḍiyyih va kalimih-yi ṭayyibih az junūd-i qaviyyih-yi ilāhiyyih dhikr shudih. Az jamīʿ-i marātib gudhashtih agar nās bi-inṣāf tamassuk namāyand ham khud bi-anvār-i yaqīn fāʾiz gardand va āthār va ḥujaj va barāhīn-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu rā bi-mathābih-yi āftāb mushāhadih namāyand va ham kursī-yi iqtidār-i Ḥaqq mābayn-i ʿālam ẓāhiran bāhiran mushāhadih gardad.
:::

::: {.translation}
O ʿAlī, praise be to God, the sight of the world is illumined by the kohl of the wisdom and utterance of the loved ones of God. Although the dark clouds of the people’s vain imaginings have prevented this light from appearing and becoming manifest, the winds of His will shall assuredly disperse these clouds. He is powerful and mighty, and His power, though concealed today, is secretly engaged in conquering the cities of hearts. The utterance of the All-Merciful is a mighty key that unlocks, a sun shining and radiant, and an all-encompassing ocean. It unlocks, sheds light, and bestows life. Blessed is the discerning one whom doubt and uncertainty, vain imaginings and conjectures, and the power and wrath of the people of the world have not kept from the loftiest summit. Through one word the world is thrown into turmoil, and through another it becomes still and assured; through one deed it is set ablaze, and through another it becomes coolness and peace. Thus, in the scriptures and tablets, the Most Exalted Pen has numbered spiritual character, pleasing deeds, and a good word among the mighty hosts of God. Beyond all these considerations, if people hold fast to fairness, they themselves will attain the lights of certitude and behold the signs, proofs, and testimonies of God—exalted be His glory—as clearly as the sun, and the throne of God’s power will also be seen, manifest and resplendent, amidst the world.
:::

### 7

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا اکبر دوستان را تکبیر برسان و از قبل مظلوم القا نما شما از سایر اهل عالم باید ممتاز باشید و در جمیع احیان بشطر امتیاز ناظر قدر خود را بدانید و مقام اولیای حقّ را که از اوّل امر بخدمت قیام نموده‌اند بشناسید قلم اعلی جمیعرا ذکر فرموده و بخلع عنایت مزیّن داشته ولکن از الواح نفوس مستقیمهٴ ثابته عرف امتیاز متضوّع طوبی لمن وجد و کان من العاملین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Akbar, dūstān rā takbīr birasān va az qibal-i Maẓlūm ilqā namā: shumā az sāʾir-i ahl-i ʿālam bāyad mumtāz bāshīd va dar jamīʿ-i aḥyān bi-shaṭr-i imtiyāz nāẓir. Qadr-i khud rā bidānīd va maqām-i awliyā-yi Ḥaqq rā kih az avval-i amr bi-khidmat qiyām nimūdih-and bishināsīd. Qalam-i Aʿlā jamīʿ rā dhikr farmūdih va bi-khilaʿ-i ʿināyat muzayyan dāshtih va-lākin az alvāḥ-i nufūs-i mustaqīmih-yi thābitih ʿarf-i imtiyāz mutaḍavviʿ. Ṭūbā li-man wajada wa-kāna mina al-ʿāmilīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Akbar, convey greetings of praise to the friends and tell them on behalf of the Wronged One: You must be distinguished from the other people of the world and at all times keep distinction in view. Know your own worth and recognize the station of the loved ones of God who have arisen to serve from the beginning of the Cause. The Most Exalted Pen has mentioned everyone and adorned them with robes of loving care, yet from the tablets of steadfast, unwavering souls the fragrance of distinction is diffused. Blessed is the one who has perceived it and is among those who act.
:::

### 8

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ایّها النّاظر الی اللّه اشهد انّک شربت رحیق حبّی فی اوّل ایّامی و اعترفت بما اعترف به اللّه و تمسّکت به و نشرت آثاره و کنت قائماً علی خدمته فی یوم فیه زلّت الأقدام کبّر من قبلی علی احبّائی فی الطّآء و من حولها و بشّرهم بعنایة اللّه ربّ العالمین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ayyuhā al-nāẓiru ilā Allāh, ashhadu annaka sharibta raḥīqa ḥubbī fī awwali ayyāmī wa-iʿtarafta bi-mā iʿtarafa bihi Allāhu wa-tamassakta bihi wa-nasharta āthārahu wa-kunta qāʾiman ʿalā khidmatihi fī yawmin fīhi zallati al-aqdām. Kabbir min qibalī ʿalā aḥibbāʾī fī al-Ṭāʾi wa-man ḥawlahā wa-bashshirhum bi-ʿināyati Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O you who look toward God, I testify that you drank the choice wine of My love in the earliest days of My revelation, acknowledged what God acknowledged, held fast to it, spread His writings, and stood ready to serve Him on a day when feet faltered. Convey greetings of praise on My behalf to My loved ones in Ṭāʾ and those around it, and give them the glad tidings of the loving care of God, the Lord of the worlds.
:::

### 9

::: {.original lang="ar"}
انّا نوصیهم بالتّقوی الخالص و بما یرتفع به امر اللّه العلیم الخبیر قل ان ارحموا علی انفسکم و علی سدرة الأمر و علی الدّمآء الّتی سفکت لاعلآء کلمة اللّه المطاعة اتّقوا اللّه یا قوم و کونوا من المنصفین لا تضیّعوا اعمالکم و ما ورد علیکم فی هذا النّبأ العظیم لکم ان تفتخروا علی من علی الأرض انّکم فزتم بما لا فاز به احد من الخلق یشهد بذلک من نطق امّ الکتاب بذکره العزیز البدیع لا تجعلوا انفسکم ملعب جهلآء الأرض ینبغی لکلّ عمل ینسب الیکم ان یکون مشرقاً کالشّمس بین العالم کذلک یعظکم اللّه حقّ الوعظ رحمةً من عنده انّه یحبّکم و یرید لکم ما ینبغی لمقاماتکم عند اللّه العلیّ العظیم ایّاکم ان تعملوا ما تتوقّف به الرّحمة فی سمآء المشیّة کذلک ینصحکم من کان اشفق بکم منکم انّ ربّکم الرّحمن لهو العلیم الحکیم البهآء المشرق من افق عنایتی و النّور اللّائح من سمآء رحمتی علیک و علی من معک و یحبّک فی سبیل اللّه مالک هذا الیوم المبارک المبین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Innā nūṣīhim bi-l-taqwā al-khāliṣi wa-bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi amru Allāhi al-ʿAlīmi al-Khabīr. Qul an irḥamū ʿalā anfusikum wa-ʿalā sidrati al-amri wa-ʿalā al-dimāʾi allatī sufikat li-iʿlāʾi kalimati Allāhi al-muṭāʿah. Ittaqū Allāha yā qawmu wa-kūnū mina al-munṣifīn. Lā tuḍayyiʿū aʿmālakum wa-mā warada ʿalaykum fī hādhā al-nabaʾi al-ʿaẓīm. Lakum an taftakhirū ʿalā man ʿalā al-arḍi annakum fuztum bi-mā lā fāza bihi aḥadun mina al-khalq. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man naṭaqa Ummu al-Kitābi bi-dhikrihi al-ʿAzīzu al-Badīʿ. Lā tajʿalū anfusakum malʿaba juhalāʾi al-arḍ. Yanbaghī li-kulli ʿamalin yunsabu ilaykum an yakūna mushriqan ka-l-shamsi bayna al-ʿālam. Kadhālika yaʿiẓukumu Allāhu ḥaqqa al-waʿẓi raḥmatan min ʿindihi innahu yuḥibbukum wa-yurīdu lakum mā yanbaghī li-maqāmātikum ʿinda Allāhi al-ʿAliyyi al-ʿAẓīm. Iyyākum an taʿmalū mā tatawaqqafu bihi al-raḥmatu fī samāʾi al-mashīʾah. Kadhālika yanṣaḥukum man kāna ashfaqa bikum minkum. Inna rabbakumu al-Raḥmāna la-huwa al-ʿAlīmu al-Ḥakīm. Al-Bahāʾu al-mushriqu min ufuqi ʿināyatī wa-l-nūru al-lāʾiḥu min samāʾi raḥmatī ʿalayka wa-ʿalā man maʿaka wa-yuḥibbuka fī sabīli Allāhi Māliki hādhā al-yawmi al-mubāraki al-mubīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
We counsel them to observe pure godliness and to do whatever exalts the Cause of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware. Say: Have mercy on yourselves, on the Tree of the Cause, and on the blood shed to exalt the Word of God, which all must obey. Fear God, O people, and be fair-minded. Do not squander your deeds and what you have endured for this mighty Announcement. You may well take pride before all who dwell on earth, for you have attained what no one else in creation has attained. To this bears witness He whose mention the Mother Book has voiced, the Almighty, the Wondrous. Do not make yourselves the playthings of the ignorant of the earth. Every deed attributed to you should shine like the sun amidst the world. Thus God admonishes you with true admonition, as a mercy from Him. He loves you and desires for you what befits your stations before God, the Most Exalted, the Most Great. Beware of doing anything that would hold back mercy in the heaven of His will. Thus counsels you One who is more compassionate toward you than you are toward yourselves. Your Lord, the All-Merciful, is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. May the glory shining from the horizon of My loving care and the light gleaming from the heaven of My mercy rest upon you and upon those who are with you and love you in the path of God, the Lord of this blessed and manifest Day. End.
:::

### 10

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انشآءاللّه جمیع دوستان الهی بقمیص تقدیس مزیّن شوند باید بشأنی ظاهر باشند که اگر در انجمن عالم بوعظ و نصح عباد قیام نمایند و بأعلی البیان تنطّق کنند نه خود در سرّ خجل باشند و نه من علی الأرض قادر بر اعتراض حال باید در لیالی و ایّام در تدبیر آن باشند که نفسیرا هدایت نمایند و از رحیق عرفان بچشانند این ایّام ایّامی نیست که فکر مختلف گردد و اراده متوقّف و قصد مشوب و اعمال منافی و اخلاق خشن باید جمیع اعمال و افعال و اخلاق مثل نقطهٴ واحده مشاهده شود یعنی مرجع کلّ معروف باشد تا مدلّ بر معروف حقیقی و حاکی از او گردد کلّ تحت لحاظ عنایت بوده و هستند ما من احد الّا و قد فاز باکلیل الذّکر من لدی اللّه المهیمن القیّوم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In shāʾ Allāh jamīʿ-i dūstān-i ilāhī bi-qamīṣ-i taqdīs muzayyan shavand. Bāyad bi-shaʾnī ẓāhir bāshand kih agar dar anjuman-i ʿālam bi-vaʿẓ va nuṣḥ-i ʿibād qiyām namāyand va bi-aʿlā al-bayān tanaṭṭuq kunand nah khud dar sirr khajil bāshand va nah man ʿalā al-arḍ qādir bar iʿtirāḍ. Ḥāl bāyad dar layālī va ayyām dar tadbīr-i ān bāshand kih nafsī rā hidāyat namāyand va az raḥīq-i ʿirfān bichashānand. Īn ayyām ayyāmī nīst kih fikr mukhtalif gardad va irādih mutavaqqif va qaṣd mashūb va aʿmāl munāfī va akhlāq khashin. Bāyad jamīʿ-i aʿmāl va afʿāl va akhlāq mithl-i nuqṭih-yi vāḥidih mushāhadih shavad yaʿnī marjaʿ-i kull maʿrūf bāshad tā mudill bar Maʿrūf-i Ḥaqīqī va ḥākī az ū gardad. Kull taḥt-i liḥāẓ-i ʿināyat būdih va hastand. Mā min aḥadin illā wa-qad fāza bi-iklīli al-dhikri min ladā Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm.
:::

::: {.translation}
God willing, all the friends of God will be adorned with the garment of sanctity. They should conduct themselves in such a way that, were they to arise in the assembly of the world to admonish and counsel its people and speak with the utmost eloquence, they would neither be inwardly ashamed nor give anyone on earth grounds for objection. Now, night and day, they should devise ways to guide a soul and give it a taste of the choice wine of recognition. These are not days for divided thought, faltering will, impure intent, inconsistent deeds, or harsh character. All deeds, actions, and qualities should be seen as a single point; that is, the focus of them all should be known, so that they may point to the true Object of recognition and reflect Him. All have been and remain beneath the gaze of His loving care. There is no one who has not attained the crown of remembrance from God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.
:::

### 11

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حال آنچه لازمست باید احبّای الهی بآن تمسّک نمایند ایّام راحت و فرح و عزّت را هم البتّه مشاهده کنند لازال میفرمایند اگر منادیرا بشناسند و لذّت بیان رحمن را بیابند عالم را معدوم شمرند و بما یرتفع به الأمر ناظر و متشبّث و متمسّک گردند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥāl ānchih lāzim ast bāyad aḥibbā-yi ilāhī bi-ān tamassuk namāyand. Ayyām-i rāḥat va faraḥ va ʿizzat rā ham al-battih mushāhadih kunand. Lā yazāl mī-farmāyand agar munādī rā bishināsand va lidhdhat-i bayān-i Raḥmān rā biyāband ʿālam rā maʿdūm shumurand va bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi al-amr nāẓir va mutashabbith va mutamassik gardand.
:::

::: {.translation}
Now the loved ones of God must hold fast to what is necessary. They will assuredly also witness days of ease, joy, and honor. He continually says that, if they recognize the Summoner and taste the sweetness of the All-Merciful’s utterance, they will count the world as nothing and direct their gaze toward whatever exalts the Cause, cleaving and holding fast to it.
:::

### 12

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری این عبد خدمت هر یک عرض سلام و تکبیر و فنا و نیستی میرساند و بکمال عجز و ابتهال از معادن جواهر محبّت الهی استدعا مینماید که بمقامات عالیهٴ خود ناظر باشند و آنچه سزاوار است عمل فرمایند العرض و العجز من العبد و القبول من احبّآء اللّه العزیز المحبوب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bārī īn ʿabd khidmat-i har yik ʿarḍ-i salām va takbīr va fanā va nīstī mī-rasānad va bi-kamāl-i ʿajz va ibtihāl az maʿādin-i javāhir-i maḥabbat-i ilāhī istidʿā mī-namāyad kih bi-maqāmāt-i ʿāliyih-yi khud nāẓir bāshand va ānchih sazāvār ast ʿamal farmāyand. Al-ʿarḍu wa-l-ʿajzu mina al-ʿabdi wa-l-qabūlu min aḥibbāʾi Allāhi al-ʿAzīzi al-Maḥbūb.
:::

::: {.translation}
In any case, this servant conveys to each one greetings of peace and praise, in self-effacement and nothingness, and with the utmost helplessness and supplication begs these mines of the jewels of divine love to keep their lofty stations in view and act as befits them. The plea and the helplessness are this servant’s; acceptance rests with the loved ones of God, the Almighty, the Beloved.
:::

### 13

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه ذکر نفسین مقبلین جناب آقا سیّد محمّد و استاد محمّد قلی علیهما بهآء اللّه فرموده بودند و هم‌چنین ذکر عمل ایشانرا فی سبیل اللّه در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد نسبت بهر یک آفتاب عنایت و قمر رأفت و نجم شفقت و کلمه علیا ظاهر و مشرق قوله جلّ و عزّ
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnkih dhikr-i nafsayn-i muqbilayn Janāb-i Āqā Siyyid Muḥammad va Ustād Muḥammad-Qulī ʿalayhimā bahāʾu Allāh farmūdih būdand va hamchunīn dhikr-i ʿamal-i īshān rā fī sabīli Allāh dar sāḥat-i amnaʿ-i aqdas-i aʿlā ʿarḍ shud. Nisbat bi-har yik āftāb-i ʿināyat va qamar-i raʾfat va najm-i shafaqat va kalimih-yi ʿulyā ẓāhir va mushriq. Qawluhu jalla wa-ʿazz.
:::

::: {.translation}
The mention you had made of the two devoted souls, the honored Āqā Siyyid Muḥammad and Ustād Muḥammad-Qulī—may the glory of God rest upon them both—and likewise of their work in the path of God, was presented in the most exalted, most holy, most inaccessible Court. For each of them the sun of loving care, the moon of tenderness, the star of compassion, and the exalted Word appeared and shone forth. His words—exalted and glorified be He:
:::

### 14

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المنادی فی العالم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismī al-Munādī fī al-ʿālam.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Summoner in the world.
:::

### 15

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا محمّد قد ذکرت لدی المظلوم مرّة بعد مرّة و ذکرناک فیکلّ مرّة ما یجد منه المخلصون عرف عنایتی ان افرح و کن من الشّاکرین و نذکرک فیهذا الحین کرّة اخری فضلاً من لدنّا انّ ربّک لهو العزیز الکریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Muḥammad, qad dhukirta ladā al-Maẓlūmi marratan baʿda marratin wa-dhakarnāka fī kulli marratin mā yajidu minhu al-mukhliṣūna ʿarfa ʿināyatī. An ifraḥ wa-kun mina al-shākirīn. Wa-nadhkuruka fī hādhā al-ḥīni karratan ukhrā faḍlan min ladunnā. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-Karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Muḥammad, you have been mentioned before the Wronged One time after time, and each time We have remembered you in words from which the sincere perceive the fragrance of My loving care. Rejoice and be among the thankful. At this moment We remember you once again as a bounty from Our presence. Your Lord is indeed the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.
:::

### 16

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ان احمد اللّه بما ذکر عملک فی الألواح و انزل لک ما یزیّنک بطراز الخلوص انّه لهو المقتدر القدیر قد فاز ما عملته فی سبیلی برضائی و طراز قبولی انّ ربّک لهو العلیم الحکیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
An iḥmadi Allāha bi-mā dhakara ʿamalaka fī al-alwāḥi wa-anzala laka mā yuzayyinuka bi-ṭirāzi al-khulūṣ. Innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadiru al-Qadīr. Qad fāza mā ʿamiltahu fī sabīlī bi-riḍāʾī wa-ṭirāzi qabūlī. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-ʿAlīmu al-Ḥakīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise God, for He has mentioned your work in the Tablets and sent down for you that which adorns you with the ornament of sincerity. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent. What you have done in My path has attained My good pleasure and the ornament of My acceptance. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
:::

### 17

::: {.original lang="ar"}
طوبی لک و لعملک و لمن عمل بما امر به فی کتابی المبین بقیامکم علی خدمتی و عملکم فی حبّی نطق الملأ الأعلی طوبی لمن وفی بمیثاق اللّه فی هذا الیوم المبارک البدیع البهآء المشرق الظّاهر اللّائح اللّمیع علیک و علی کلّ عبد مستقیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ṭūbā laka wa-li-ʿamalika wa-li-man ʿamila bi-mā umira bihi fī kitābī al-mubīn. Bi-qiyāmikum ʿalā khidmatī wa-ʿamalikum fī ḥubbī naṭaqa al-malaʾu al-aʿlā: Ṭūbā li-man wafā bi-mīthāqi Allāhi fī hādhā al-yawmi al-mubāraki al-badīʿ. Al-Bahāʾu al-mushriqu al-ẓāhiru al-lāʾiḥu al-lamīʿu ʿalayka wa-ʿalā kulli ʿabdin mustaqīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
Blessed are you and your work, and whoever has acted as commanded in My clear Book. Through your arising to serve Me and your work out of love for Me, the Concourse on high has proclaimed: “Blessed is the one who has been faithful to the Covenant of God on this blessed and wondrous Day.” May the glory, shining, manifest, radiant, and resplendent, rest upon you and upon every steadfast servant.
:::

### 18

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و هذا ما نزّل من جبروت الفضل لجناب استاد محمّد قلی علیه بهآء اللّه قوله جلّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila min jabarūti al-faḍli li-janābi Ustād Muḥammad-Qulī ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh. Qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuh.
:::

::: {.translation}
And this is what was sent down from the dominion of grace for the honored Ustād Muḥammad-Qulī, may the glory of God rest upon him. His words—exalted be His majesty:
:::

### 19

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المهیمن علی الظّاهر و الباطن
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismī al-Muhaymini ʿalā al-ẓāhiri wa-l-bāṭin.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Guardian over the outward and the inward.
:::

### 20

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا محمّد قبل قلی یذکرک المظلوم من شطره و یذکرک بعهده و ینزل لک ما عملته متمسّکاً بکتابه طوبی لک بما وفیت و عملت بما امرت به فی حبّه کم من عبد تمسّک بسبل الأوهام معرضاً عن سبیله و کم من عبد نبذ العالم عن ورائه مقبلاً الی انوار وجهه ان افرح بما ایّدک علی العمل بما یقرّبک فیکلّ الأحوال الی نفسه نعیماً لک بما اقبلت الی اللّه و وجدت عرف قمیصه انّا ذکرناک من قبل و من بعد انّ ربّک یجزی من تمسّک بحبل عنایته البهآء المشرق من افق سمآء الفضل علیک و علی من اتّبع امره انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Muḥammad qabla Qulī, yadhkuruka al-Maẓlūm min shaṭrihi wa-yudhakkiruka bi-ʿahdihi wa-yunazzilu laka mā ʿamiltahu mutamassikan bi-kitābihi. Ṭūbā laka bi-mā wafayta wa-ʿamilta bi-mā umirta bihi fī ḥubbihi. Kam min ʿabdin tamassaka bi-subuli al-awhām muʿriḍan ʿan sabīlihi wa-kam min ʿabdin nabadha al-ʿālama warāʾihi muqbilan ilā anwāri wajhihi. An ifraḥ bi-mā ayyadaka ʿalā al-ʿamali bi-mā yuqarribuka fī kulli al-aḥwāl ilā nafsihi. Naʿīman laka bi-mā aqbalta ilā Allāh wa-wajadta ʿarfa qamīṣihi. Innā dhakarnāka min qablu wa-min baʿd. Inna rabbaka yajzī man tamassaka bi-ḥabli ʿināyatihi. Al-Bahāʾ al-mushriq min ufuqi samāʾi al-faḍli ʿalayka wa-ʿalā man ittabaʿa amrahu. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Muḥammad-Qulī, the Wronged One remembers you from where He dwells, reminds you of His covenant, and sends down for you what you have done while holding fast to His Book. Blessed are you for having remained faithful and done what you were commanded out of love for Him. How many a servant has clung to the paths of delusion, turning away from His path, and how many a servant has cast the world behind him, turning toward the lights of His face! Rejoice that He has enabled you to do what draws you closer to Him in every circumstance. Happy are you for having turned to God and perceived the fragrance of His garment. We have remembered you before and afterward. Your Lord rewards whoever holds fast to the cord of His loving care. May the glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of grace rest upon you and upon whoever follows His command. End of quotation.
:::

### 21

::: {.original lang="fa"}
طوبی لهما و نعیماً لهما چه که عرف خلوص از ایشان بشهادة اللّه متضوّع و بروح و ریحان عمل نمودند آنچه را بآن امر شدند انشآءاللّه اینمقام اعلی را باسم حقّ جلّ جلاله حفظ فرمائید از حقّ منیع این خادم فانی سائل و آمل که ایشانرا باستقامت کبری فائز فرماید انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر تکبیر و سلام خدمت ایشان منوط باراده و عنایت آنمحبوبست
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ṭūbā lahumā va naʿīman lahumā, che ke ʿarf-e khulūṣ az īshān bi-shahādati Allāh mutaḍavviʿ va bi-rūḥ va rayḥān ʿamal namūdand ānche rā bi-ān amr shudand. In shāʾ Allāh īn maqām-e aʿlā rā bi-ism-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ḥifẓ farmāyīd. Az Ḥaqq-e manīʿ īn khādim-e fānī sāʾil va āmil ke īshān rā bi-istiqāmat-e kubrā fāʾiz farmāyad. Innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Takbīr va salām khidmat-e īshān manūṭ bi-irādih va ʿināyat-e ān maḥbūb ast.
:::

::: {.translation}
Blessed and happy are they both, for, as God bears witness, the fragrance of sincerity wafts from them, and with joy and gladness they have done what they were commanded. God willing, may you preserve this most exalted station in the name of the True One, exalted be His glory. This servant, who is passing away, asks and hopes that the exalted True One will grant them supreme steadfastness. He has power over all things. Conveying greetings and salutations to them depends upon the will and kindness of that beloved friend.
:::

### 22

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه در بارهٴ ورقهٴ مخدّره ح‌و علیها بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید عرض شد فرمودند نعم ما عمل من المعروف فی حقّها انشآءاللّه مؤیّد باشند بر اعمال طیّبه و ما یکون حاکیاً عن الحکمة المحضة منتسبین انشآءاللّه بعنایت حقّ فائز باشند و باستقامت کبری مزیّن تا جلاجل داهیه ایشانرا از صراط احدیّه منع ننماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke dar bārih-yi varaqih-yi mukhaddarih Ḥāʾ-Vāv, ʿalayhā bahāʾu Allāh, marqūm dāshtīd ʿarḍ shud. Farmūdand: niʿma mā ʿumila mina al-maʿrūfi fī ḥaqqihā. In shāʾ Allāh muʾayyad bāshand bar aʿmāl-e ṭayyibih va mā yakūnu ḥākiyan ʿani al-ḥikmati al-maḥḍah. Muntasibīn in shāʾ Allāh bi-ʿināyat-e Ḥaqq fāʾiz bāshand va bi-istiqāmat-e kubrā muzayyan tā jalājil-e dāhiyih īshān rā az ṣirāṭ-e aḥadiyyih manʿ nanamāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning the honored leaf Ḥāʾ-Vāv, may the glory of God rest upon her, was presented. He said: “Excellent is the kindness shown to her.” God willing, may they be assisted in performing good deeds and whatever reflects pure wisdom. God willing, may the relatives receive the loving care of the True One and be adorned with supreme steadfastness, so that the clamors of calamity may not keep them from the path of divine unity.
:::

### 23

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا علی قبل اکبر علیک بهائی و رحمتی و عنایتی ان انظر ثمّ اذکر فی امة رجعت الی مقرّها انّها بدّلت النّور بالنّار و باعت ملک النّاس بقطعة من الألماس مع کمال محبّت و اقبال و ادّعای عرفان داهیه بیک گل الماس او را فریب داد از حقّ معرض و بغیر او مقبل اینست شأن دنیا و اهل آن از اوّل امر معرض بوده و ابداً اطّلاع نداشته و ندارد چه که با ما نبوده خضوع و خشوع بیمعنی حضرات ق آن نفوس را بر آن داشت که اظهار ایمان نمایند انّه یعلم ما فی الصّدور و ما فی القلوب و هو العلیم الخبیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿAlī qabla Akbar, ʿalayka bahāʾī wa-raḥmatī wa-ʿināyatī. An unẓur thumma udhkur fī amatin rajaʿat ilā maqarrihā. Innahā baddalati al-nūra bi-al-nār wa-bāʿat malika al-nāsi bi-qiṭʿatin mina al-almās. Bā kamāl-e maḥabbat va iqbāl va iddiʿā-yi ʿirfān, dāhiyih bi-yik gul-e almās ū rā farīb dād. Az Ḥaqq muʿriḍ va bi-ghayr-e ū muqbil. Īn ast shaʾn-e dunyā va ahl-e ān. Az avval-e amr muʿriḍ būdih va abadan iṭṭilāʿ nadāshtih va nadārad, che ke bā mā nabūdih. Khuḍūʿ va khushūʿ-e bī-maʿnī-yi ḥaḍarāt-e Qāf ān nufūs rā bar ān dāsht ke iẓhār-e īmān namāyand. Innahu yaʿlamu mā fī al-ṣudūri wa-mā fī al-qulūbi wa-huwa al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
O ʿAlī-Akbar, upon you be My glory, My mercy, and My loving care. Consider, then speak of a woman who returned to her abode. She exchanged light for fire and sold the King of humanity for a piece of diamond. Despite all her love, devotion, and claims to recognition, the calamity deceived her with a diamond flower. She has turned away from the True One and toward another. Such is the condition of the world and its people. From the beginning of the Cause she has turned away and has never had, nor does she now have, any understanding, for she has not been with Us. The meaningless deference and humility of the gentlemen of Qāf induced those souls to profess belief. He knows what is within the breasts and what is within the hearts, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.
:::

### 24

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اگر یک ورقه از اوراق در افعال و اعمال و حرکات او تفکّر نماید تنطق و تقول انّی بریئة منها و عنکلّ ما عندها و تحفظ وجهها عن وجهها آن جناب میدانند قلم اعلی در ذکر آن نفوس متوقّف بود ولکن نظر بظلم و تعدّی و شرارهٴ نفس و هوی از قلم اعلی اینکلمات جاری و نازل و اینهم نظر بآنکه او را بشناسند و بر اعمال و افعال او اطّلاع یابند اعاذنا اللّه و ایّاکم منها و امثالها انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Agar yik varaqih az avrāq dar afʿāl va aʿmāl va ḥarakāt-e ū tafakkur namāyad, tanṭiqu wa-taqūlu innī barīʾatun minhā wa-ʿan kulli mā ʿindahā wa-taḥfaẓu wajhahā ʿan wajhihā. Ān janāb mīdānand Qalam-e Aʿlā dar dhikr-e ān nufūs mutavaqqif būd, va-lākin naẓar bi-ẓulm va taʿaddī va sharārih-yi nafs va havā az Qalam-e Aʿlā īn kalimāt jārī va nāzil, va īn ham naẓar bi-ānke ū rā bishināsand va bar aʿmāl va afʿāl-e ū iṭṭilāʿ yāband. Aʿādhanā Allāhu wa-iyyākum minhā wa-amthālihā. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
If a single leaf among the leaves reflects upon her actions, deeds, and conduct, she will speak and say, “I am free of her and of everything she possesses,” and will shield her face from hers. You know that the Most Exalted Pen had refrained from mentioning those souls. Yet, in view of the oppression, transgression, and flame of selfish desire, these words have flowed and descended from the Most Exalted Pen, and this too is so that they may recognize her and become acquainted with her actions and deeds. May God protect us and you from her and others like her. End of quotation.
:::

### 25

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اینفانی از حقّ جلّ جلاله سائل و آمل که دوستان آن ارض را بصراط مستقیم امانت و دیانت و صدق و صفا هدایت فرماید تا کلّ در ظلّ حقّ و عنایتش مستریح باشند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn fānī az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu sāʾil va āmil ke dūstān-e ān arḍ rā bi-ṣirāṭ-e mustaqīm-e amānat va diyānat va ṣidq va ṣafā hidāyat farmāyad tā kull dar ẓill-e Ḥaqq va ʿināyatash mustarīḥ bāshand.
:::

::: {.translation}
This passing soul asks and hopes that the True One, exalted be His glory, will guide the friends in that land to the straight path of trustworthiness, integrity, truthfulness, and purity, so that all may rest at ease beneath the shelter of the True One and His loving care.
:::

### 26

::: {.original lang="fa"}
وقتی اینکلمهٴ علیا از لسان مالک اسماء استماع شد فرمودند یا عبد حاضر از برای هر شیء مبدئی بوده و هست اینکه عوام گفته و میگویند بی‌مایه خمیر فطیر است حرفیست تمام و این قول حکیم عارف است الیوم اصحاب الهی مایهٴ احزاب عالمند باید کلّ از امانت و صدق و استقامت و اعمال و اخلاق ایشان اقتباس نمایند از حقّ بطلب عرف آگاهیرا بیابند و بما یرتفع به شؤونهم و مقاماتهم تمسّک نمایند انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Vaqtī īn kalimih-yi ʿulyā az lisān-e Mālik-e Asmāʾ istimāʿ shud. Farmūdand: yā ʿabd-e ḥāḍir, az barā-yi har shayʾ mabdaʾī būdih va hast. Īnke ʿavāmm guftih va mīgūyand bī-māyih khamīr faṭīr ast ḥarfīst tamām va īn qawl-e ḥakīm-e ʿārif ast. Al-yawm aṣḥāb-e ilāhī māyih-yi aḥzāb-e ʿālamand. Bāyad kull az amānat va ṣidq va istiqāmat va aʿmāl va akhlāq-e īshān iqtibās namāyand. Az Ḥaqq biṭalab ʿarf-e āgāhī rā biyāband va bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi shuʾūnuhum wa-maqāmātuhum tamassuk namāyand. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
On one occasion this exalted utterance was heard from the tongue of the Lord of Names. He said: “O servant who is present, everything has had and has an originating principle. The saying that ordinary people have repeated and still repeat, ‘Without leaven, dough remains unleavened,’ is entirely sound; it is the saying of a wise and discerning person. Today the companions of God are the leaven of the peoples of the world. All should draw upon their trustworthiness, truthfulness, steadfastness, deeds, and character. Ask the True One that they may perceive the fragrance of awareness and hold fast to what will elevate their standing and stations.” End of quotation.
:::

### 27

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه بعضی از معرضین بیان اعتراض نموده‌اند با ادّعای حقیّت اصحابشان بفجور و فحشا عامل و اصحاب نقطهٴ اولی بتقوی عامل و بطراز امانت و دیانت مزیّن اینکلمه از صراط حقّ و راستی خارج چه که از ورود جمال قدم به عراق که این عبد مطّلع است متّصلاً آیات و کلمات در سرّ سرّ نازل و ارسال میشد و جمیع امر بما اراده اللّه و نهی عمّا نهی عنه فی الکتاب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke baʿḍī az muʿriḍīn-e Bayān iʿtirāḍ namūdih-and bā iddiʿā-yi ḥaqqiyyat aṣḥābashān bi-fujūr va faḥshā ʿāmil va aṣḥāb-e Nuqṭih-yi Ūlā bi-taqvā ʿāmil va bi-ṭirāz-e amānat va diyānat muzayyan, īn kalimih az ṣirāṭ-e ḥaqq va rāstī khārij, che ke az vurūd-e Jamāl-e Qidam bi-ʿIrāq ke īn ʿabd muṭṭaliʿ ast muttaṣilan āyāt va kalimāt dar sirr-e sirr nāzil va irsāl mīshud va jamīʿ amr bi-mā arāda Allāh va nahy ʿammā nahā ʿanhu fī al-Kitāb.
:::

::: {.translation}
Some of the dissenters among the people of the Bayān have objected that, despite the claim to truth, His companions practice wickedness and indecency, whereas the companions of the Primal Point practice piety and are adorned with trustworthiness and integrity. This statement departs from the path of truth and honesty, for, as this servant knows, ever since the Ancient Beauty arrived in Iraq, verses and utterances were continually revealed and dispatched in the utmost secrecy, all enjoining what God willed and forbidding what He prohibited in the Book.
:::

### 28

::: {.original lang="fa"}
چندی قبل لسان عظمت باینکلمهٴ علیا ناطق از عراق و ارض سرّ و ارض سجن متّصل اهل بیان را نصیحت نمودیم و بما ینبغی لأمر اللّه امر فرمودیم هنوز بغی و فساد مرتفع نشده اکثری آلوده‌اند و بتقدیس و تنزیه فائز نه انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Chandī qabl Lisān-e ʿAẓamat bi-īn kalimih-yi ʿulyā nāṭiq: az ʿIrāq va Arḍ-e Sirr va Arḍ-e Sijn muttaṣil ahl-e Bayān rā naṣīḥat namūdīm va bi-mā yanbaghī li-amri Allāh amr farmūdīm. Hanūz baghy va fasād murtafiʿ nashudih. Aktharī ālūdih-and va bi-taqdīs va tanzīh fāʾiz nah. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Some time ago the Tongue of Grandeur spoke these exalted words: “From Iraq, the Land of Mystery, and the Land of the Prison, We continually counseled the people of the Bayān and commanded what befits the Cause of God. Still, rebellion and corruption have not ceased. Most remain defiled and have not attained purity and sanctity.” End of quotation.
:::

### 29

::: {.original lang="fa"}
آنمحبوب خود مطّلعند که چه اعمال شنیعه مابین اینفرقه ظاهر فی‌الحقیقه انسان قادر بر تقریر نه احدی اختیار زن و فرزند و مال و اموال خود را نداشت اکثری باغی و یاغی و طاغی ولکن خود را از اصحاب خلّص الهی میدانستند معدودی مقدّس از شئونات و شبهات دیده شدند و آنهم در اوّل امر و بعد خود آنجناب شاهد و گواهند که چه کردند و چه شد بقسمیکه حضرت اعلی روح ما سواه فداه اظهار حیرت فرمودند و در ظاهر چیزی نفرمودند چه که ناصر و معین موجود نه در ایّام آخر لوحی مرقوم داشتند و منتهای شکایت از آن نفوس فرموده‌اند و از اکثری عدم رضایت اظهار نموده‌اند ولکن ستر شد چه که اظهار آن مقتضی حکمت نه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ān maḥbūb khud muṭṭaliʿand ke che aʿmāl-e shanīʿih mābayn-e īn firqih ẓāhir. Fī al-ḥaqīqih insān qādir bar taqrīr nah. Aḥadī ikhtiyār-e zan va farzand va māl va amvāl-e khud rā nadāsht. Aktharī bāghī va yāghī va ṭāghī va-lākin khud rā az aṣḥāb-e khullaṣ-e ilāhī mīdānistand. Maʿdūdī muqaddas az shuʾūnāt va shubuhāt dīdih shudand va ān ham dar avval-e amr va baʿd khud-e ān janāb shāhid va guvāhand ke che kardand va che shud, bi-qismī ke Ḥaḍrat-e Aʿlā rūḥ-e mā sivāhu fidāh iẓhār-e ḥayrat farmūdand va dar ẓāhir chīzī nafarmūdand che ke nāṣir va muʿīn mawjūd nah. Dar ayyām-e ākhir lawḥī marqūm dāshtand va muntahā-yi shikāyat az ān nufūs farmūdih-and va az aktharī ʿadam-e riḍāyat iẓhār namūdih-and va-lākin satr shud che ke iẓhār-e ān muqtaḍī-yi ḥikmat nah.
:::

::: {.translation}
That beloved friend is himself aware of the atrocious deeds that appeared among this group. Truly, one cannot describe them. No one had control over his own wife, children, possessions, or property. Most were rebellious, insubordinate, and tyrannical, yet considered themselves among the sincere companions of God. A few were seen to be free of such conduct and suspicions, and that only at the beginning of the Cause. Afterward, you yourself witnessed what they did and what happened, to such an extent that the Most Exalted One—may the life of all else be sacrificed for Him—expressed astonishment. Outwardly, however, He said nothing, for there was no supporter or helper. In His last days He wrote a Tablet in which He complained most strongly of those souls and expressed dissatisfaction with the majority. It was, however, kept concealed, since wisdom did not permit its disclosure.
:::

### 30

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ناس ضعیفند چنانچه مشاهده شد با وجود اشراقات آفتاب حقیقت در وسط زوال و ظهور سدرهٴ منتهی از یمین بقعهٴ بیضا هر نفسی بهوای خود وهمی را بطراز یقین جلوه میداد باری اگر در اینمقامات گفتگو نمائیم اوراق و دفاتر کفایت ننماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Nās ḍaʿīfand, chunānchih mushāhidih shud bā vujūd-e ishrāqāt-e Āftāb-e Ḥaqīqat dar vasaṭ-e zavāl va ẓuhūr-e Sidrih-yi Muntahā az yamīn-e Buqʿih-yi Bayḍā har nafsī bi-havā-yi khud vahmī rā bi-ṭirāz-e yaqīn jilvih mīdād. Bārī agar dar īn maqāmāt guftugū namāyīm avrāq va dafātir kifāyat nanamāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
People are weak. As was witnessed, despite the radiance of the Sun of Truth at high noon and the appearance of the Tree beyond which there is no passing on the right side of the White Spot, each person, following his own desire, presented a delusion in the guise of certainty. In any event, were we to discuss these matters, sheets and volumes would not suffice.
:::

### 31

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و امّا در اینظهور اعظم حتّی اعدا شهادت داده و میدهند بر تقدیس و تنزیه و علوّ و سموّ یکی از علمای یزد گفته بود در اوّل هرج و مرج اعمال اینطایفه خارج از وصف و بیان حال مشاهده میشود در محفلها جمع میشوند و تلاوت آیات مینمایند و مناجات میخوانند و بکمال امانت و دیانت ظاهر و مشهود معلوم میشود از امر رئیس جدید است ملاحظه فرمائید چه مقدار از نفوس در اینظهور رایگان شربت شهادت آشامیدند و چه بدست خود خود را فدا نمودند با آنکه حقّ راضی نبود حال هم نفوسی هستند از جمیع عیوبات مقدّس و منزّه و مبرّا انّ ربّنا العلیم لهو الشّاهد الخبیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va ammā dar īn Ẓuhūr-e Aʿẓam ḥattā aʿdā shahādat dādih va mīdihand bar taqdīs va tanzīh va ʿuluvv va sumuvv. Yikī az ʿulamā-yi Yazd guftih būd dar avval-e harj va marj aʿmāl-e īn ṭāʾifih khārij az vaṣf va bayān. Ḥāl mushāhidih mīshavad dar maḥfilhā jamʿ mīshavand va tilāvat-e āyāt mīnamāyand va munājāt mīkhvānand va bi-kamāl-e amānat va diyānat ẓāhir va mashhūd. Maʿlūm mīshavad az amr-e raʾīs-e jadīd ast. Mulāḥiẓih farmāyīd che miqdār az nufūs dar īn Ẓuhūr rāygān sharbat-e shahādat āshāmīdand va che bi-dast-e khud khud rā fidā namūdand bā ānke Ḥaqq rāḍī nabūd. Ḥāl ham nufūsī hastand az jamīʿ-e ʿuyūbāt muqaddas va munazzah va mubarrā. Inna rabbanā al-ʿAlīma la-huwa al-Shāhidu al-Khabīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
In this Most Great Revelation, however, even the enemies have testified and continue to testify to purity, sanctity, loftiness, and exaltation. One of the divines of Yazd had said: “At the beginning of the turmoil, the deeds of this community were beyond description. Now they are seen gathering in assemblies, reciting verses and prayers, and displaying the utmost trustworthiness and integrity. Evidently this is at the command of the new leader.” Consider how many souls in this Revelation freely drank the cup of martyrdom, and how many sacrificed themselves by their own hands, although the True One did not approve. Even now there are souls who are pure, sanctified, and free from every fault. Our Lord, the All-Knowing, is indeed the Witness, the All-Informed.
:::

### 32

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این عبد یک کلمه از امانت و وفای بعهد ذکر مینماید که شاید بعضی متنبّه شوند و بیقین بدانند که للّه تحت قبابه عباد اولی امانة عظیمة و اولی اعمال طیّبة و اولی اخلاق روحانیّة در اسکندریّه چند نفر از احبّای الهی حسب الأمر بکسب مشغول و کسب در اینظهور اعظم از عبادت محسوب شده نسئله بأن یوفّق الکلّ علی ما اراد و
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn ʿabd yik kalimih az amānat va vafā-yi bi-ʿahd dhikr mīnamāyad ke shāyad baʿḍī mutanabbih shavand va bi-yaqīn bidānand ke li-llāhi taḥta qibābihi ʿibādun ulū amānatin ʿaẓīmatin wa-ulū aʿmālin ṭayyibatin wa-ulū akhlāqin rūḥāniyyah. Dar Iskandariyyih chand nafar az aḥibbā-yi ilāhī ḥasb al-amr bi-kasb mashghūl va kasb dar īn Ẓuhūr-e Aʿẓam az ʿibādat maḥsūb shudih. Nasʾaluhu bi-an yuwaffiqa al-kulla ʿalā mā arāda va
:::

::: {.translation}
This servant will relate one account of trustworthiness and fidelity to a pledge, so that perhaps some may take heed and know with certainty that beneath His canopies God has servants possessed of great trustworthiness, good deeds, and spiritual qualities. In Alexandria, several of the friends of God were engaged in earning a livelihood in accordance with the command, and in this Most Great Revelation earning a livelihood has been accounted worship. We ask Him to enable everyone to fulfill what He has willed, and
:::

### 33

::: {.original lang="fa"}
آن کلمه اینکه جناب آقا شیخ علی ابن جناب حاجی عبدالرّحیم علیهما بهآء اللّه به خرطوم تشریف بردند بجهت مؤانست با جناب محبوب قلب و فؤاد حاجی میرزا حیدر علی و جناب حبیب روحانی حا و سین علیهما بهآء اللّه چه که اسمین مسجونین نوشته بودند و یکنفر از اصحابرا خواسته بودند لأجل مؤانست و اطّلاع بر امورات حادثهٴ ارض مقصود و ما حولها و هم‌چنین ایران جناب شیخ مذکور مصمّم شدند و لوجه اللّه حرکت نمودند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ān kalimih īnke janāb-e Āqā Shaykh ʿAlī ibn-e janāb-e Ḥājī ʿAbd al-Raḥīm, ʿalayhimā bahāʾu Allāh, bi-Kharṭūm tashrīf burdand bi-jihat-e muʾānisat bā janāb-e maḥbūb-e qalb va fuʾād Ḥājī Mīrzā Ḥaydar ʿAlī va janāb-e ḥabīb-e rūḥānī Ḥāʾ va Sīn, ʿalayhimā bahāʾu Allāh, che ke ismayn-e masjūnayn nivishtih būdand va yik nafar az aṣḥāb rā khvāstih būdand li-ajl-e muʾānisat va iṭṭilāʿ bar umūrāt-e ḥādithih-yi Arḍ-e Maqṣūd va mā ḥawlahā va hamchunīn Īrān. Janāb-e Shaykh-e madhkūr muṣammam shudand va li-wajhi Allāh ḥarakat namūdand.
:::

::: {.translation}
The account is this: the honored Āqā Shaykh ʿAlī, son of the honored Ḥājī ʿAbd al-Raḥīm, may the glory of God rest upon them both, went to Khartoum to keep company with the beloved of the heart, the honored Ḥājī Mīrzā Ḥaydar ʿAlī, and the spiritual friend, the honored Ḥāʾ and Sīn, may the glory of God rest upon them both. For the two imprisoned names had written requesting that one of the companions come to keep them company and inform them of events in the Land of Desire and its surroundings, as well as in Iran. The aforementioned Shaykh resolved to go and set out for the sake of God.
:::

### 34

::: {.original lang="ar"}
مدّتی چون اوراق اشجار محبّت مجتمع و از هواء لطیف و آب نورانی خفیف تر و تازه بودند ناگاه باد خریف وزیدن گرفت و اسباب تفرقه بمیان آمد اسمین مذکورین علیهما ثنآء اللّه باین شطر توجّه نمودند و بما هو المقصود فائز گشتند و جناب شیخ در همان ارض بکسب مشغول
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Muddatī chun avrāq-e ashjār-e maḥabbat mujtamiʿ va az havā-yi laṭīf va āb-e nūrānī-yi khafīf tar va tāzih būdand. Nāgāh bād-e kharīf vazīdan girift va asbāb-e tafriqih bi-miyān āmad. Ismayn-e madhkūrayn, ʿalayhimā thanāʾu Allāh, bi-īn shaṭr tavajjuh namūdand va bi-mā huwa al-maqṣūd fāʾiz gashtand va janāb-e Shaykh dar hamān arḍ bi-kasb mashghūl.
:::

::: {.translation}
For a time they were gathered like leaves on the trees of love, fresh and flourishing from the gentle air and the light, luminous water. Suddenly the autumn wind began to blow, and circumstances arose that brought about separation. The two aforementioned names, may the praise of God rest upon them both, turned toward this region and attained their desire, while the honored Shaykh remained in that land earning a livelihood.
:::

### 35

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بعد از سنین متوالیات حسب الأمر مبرم جناب حاجی عبداللّه علیه ٦٦٩ \[بهآء اللّه\] بآنسمت توجّه نمودند لأجل مصاحبت با جناب شیخ و هم‌چنین اعانت نماید ایشانرا در اشغال ظاهره و تأیید کند در مراجعت ولکن نظر بتشتّت امور بطول انجامید تا آنکه حضرت شیخ علیه بهآء اللّه صعود فرمودند و بعد از صعود جناب حاجی عبداللّه مذکور در تمشیت امور پرداخت
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Baʿd az sinīn-e mutavāliyāt ḥasb al-amr-e mubram janāb-e Ḥājī ʿAbd Allāh, ʿalayhi 669 \[bahāʾu Allāh\], bi-ān samt tavajjuh namūdand li-ajl-e muṣāḥabat bā janāb-e Shaykh va hamchunīn iʿānat namāyad īshān rā dar ashghāl-e ẓāhirih va taʾyīd kunad dar murājaʿat, va-lākin naẓar bi-tashattut-e umūr bi-ṭūl anjāmīd tā ānke Ḥaḍrat-e Shaykh, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, ṣuʿūd farmūdand va baʿd az ṣuʿūd janāb-e Ḥājī ʿAbd Allāh-e madhkūr dar tamshiyat-e umūr pardākht.
:::

::: {.translation}
After a number of successive years, in accordance with the binding command, the honored Ḥājī ʿAbd Allāh, upon him be 669 \[the glory of God\], set out for that region to keep the honored Shaykh company, assist him in his worldly occupations, and help him return. Owing to the unsettled state of affairs, however, this was prolonged until the honored Shaykh, may the glory of God rest upon him, ascended. After his ascension, the aforementioned Ḥājī ʿAbd Allāh attended to the settling of his affairs.
:::

### 36

::: {.original lang="fa"}
قنسل ایران که در آنمدینه بود تفصیل امورات مرحوم و هم‌چنین امتعه و اموالش را بجناب کارپرداز اوّل دولت علیّهٴ ایران که مقیم قاهره است نوشت ایشان هم رسمیکه حسب القانون مجری شده از اموال و ترکه طلب نمودند جناب اسمین اعلیین محمّد و علی علیهما بهآء اللّه از اسکندریّه نوشتند که آنچه حقّ شماست میرسد بعضی از تجّار قاهره که اقبال نموده‌اند بجناب کارپرداز مذکور گفتند که این وجه بشما میرسد چه که قول حضرات صحیحست و مقدّس از شکّ و ریب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qonsol-e Irān ke dar ān madine būd tafṣil-e omūrāt-e marḥūm va hamchenin amteʿe va amvālash rā be janāb-e kārpardāz-e avval-e Dowlat-e ʿAliyye-ye Irān ke moqim-e Qāhere ast nevesht. Ishān ham rasmi ke ḥasb al-qānūn mojrā shode az amvāl va tarake ṭalab namūdand. Janāb-e esmayn-e aʿlayayn Moḥammad va ʿAli, ʿalayhimā bahāʾu’llāh, az Eskandariyye neveshtand ke ānche ḥaqq-e shomāst mirasad. Baʿżi az tojjār-e Qāhere ke eqbāl namūde-and be janāb-e kārpardāz-e madhkūr goftand ke in vajh be shomā mirasad che ke qowl-e ḥażarāt ṣaḥiḥ ast va moqaddas az shakk va reyb.
:::

::: {.translation}
The Iranian consul in that city wrote an account of the deceased’s affairs, as well as his goods and property, to the chief agent of the Imperial Government of Iran, who resides in Cairo. The latter requested from the property and estate the fee prescribed by law. The two most exalted names, the honored Muḥammad and ʿAlī, may the glory of God rest upon them both, wrote from Alexandria that whatever was rightfully his would reach him. Some merchants of Cairo who had embraced the Cause told the aforementioned agent, “This sum will reach you, for these gentlemen’s word is true and beyond doubt or question.”
:::

### 37

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بعد اسکندریّه منقلب و قاهره مضطرب و دمدمهٴ مدافع مرتفع و طنطنهٴ صفوف و الوف و بنادق ظاهر بشأنیکه جمیع ناس مضطرب و خائف و اضطراب تجاوز نمود تا باین اراضی رسید لولا فضل اللّه و رحمته لخسفت الأرض بمن علیها چه که نظر بغفلت و عصیان امّت مستحقّ بودند آنچه را که واقع شد
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Baʿd Eskandariyye monqaleb va Qāhere moẓṭareb va damdame-ye madāfeʿ mortafeʿ va ṭanṭane-ye ṣofūf va olūf va banādeq ẓāher be shaʾni ke jamiʿ-e nās moẓṭareb va khāʾef va eżṭerāb tajāvoz namūd tā be in arāżi rasid. Lawlā faḍlu’llāhi wa raḥmatuhu la-khasafati al-arḍu bi-man ʿalayhā, che ke naẓar be ghaflat va ʿeṣyān-e ommat mostaḥaqq būdand ānche rā ke vāqeʿ shod.
:::

::: {.translation}
Then Alexandria was thrown into turmoil and Cairo into agitation. The thunder of cannons rose, and the din of ranks, multitudes, and rifles broke out, so that everyone was alarmed and afraid. The unrest spread until it reached these lands. Were it not for God’s grace and mercy, the earth would have swallowed up those upon it, for, in view of the people’s heedlessness and rebellion, they deserved what befell them.
:::

### 38

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری اسکندریّه در ساعات معدوده عالیها سافلها مشاهده گشت چنانچه از قبل در بعضی از عرایض این فانی ذکر نموده و هم‌چنین از قلم اعلی نازل احبّای اسکندریّه و قاهره عریضه بساحت اقدس ارسال نمودند و تکلیف خود را خواستند و هم‌چنین بحضرت اسم‌اللّه م‌ه علیه منکلّ بهآء ابهاه که در آن اوقات در این ارض تشریف داشتند عریضه ارسال نمودند فرمودند احبّای الف و سین باقتضا حرکت نمایند و بشطر اقدس توجّه کنند و احبّای مصر در مقرّ خود ساکن و مستریح باشند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bāri Eskandariyye dar sāʿāt-e maʿdūde ʿāliyahā sāfilahā moshāhede gasht chenānche az qabl dar baʿżi az ʿarāyeż in fāni dhekr namūde va hamchenin az Qalam-e Aʿlā nāzel. Aḥebbā-ye Eskandariyye va Qāhere ʿariże be sāḥat-e aqdas ersāl namūdand va taklif-e khod rā khāstand va hamchenin be ḥażrat-e Esmo’llāh M-H, ʿalayhi min kulli bahāʾin abhāhu, ke dar ān owqāt dar in arż tashrif dāshtand ʿariże ersāl namūdand. Farmūdand aḥebbā-ye Alef va Sin be eqteżā ḥarakat namāyand va be shaṭr-e aqdas tavajjoh konand va aḥebbā-ye Meṣr dar maqarr-e khod sāken va mostariḥ bāshand.
:::

::: {.translation}
In short, within a few hours Alexandria was seen turned upside down, as this mortal one has previously mentioned in some letters, and as has also been revealed by the Most Exalted Pen. The friends in Alexandria and Cairo sent a petition to the Most Holy Court asking what they should do. They also sent a petition to his honor Ismu’llāh M-H, upon him be the most resplendent of all glory, who was then staying in this land. The instruction was given that the friends of Alif and Sīn should act as circumstances required and turn toward the Most Holy Presence, while the friends in Cairo should remain where they were and be at ease.
:::

### 39

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و بعد حضرات بارض مقصود وارد و غافلین و خائنین اسکندریّه را آتش زدند و اموال ناس را از هر قبیل چه سوختند و چه بتاراج بردند و اموال دوستانهم جمیع بتاراج رفت و مخزن ایشان منهدم و ویران و طرف خرطوم هم نار وغی مشتعل و شخصی علم عصیان برافراخت نظر باغتشاش مصر آن اطراف جمیع منقلب و مضطرب و جناب حاجی عبداللّه در آنجا محصور تا آنکه حکم خروج رسید و متوکّلاً علی اللّه بیرون آمد و از صدهزار بلا حقّ جلّ جلاله حفظش فرمود و الحمد للّه بارض مقصود وارد و مشرّف
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va baʿd ḥażarāt be arż-e maqṣūd vāred va ghāfelin va khāʾenin Eskandariyye rā ātash zadand va amvāl-e nās rā az har qabil che sūkhtand va che be tārāj bordand va amvāl-e dūstān ham jamiʿ be tārāj raft va makhzan-e ishān monhadem va virān va ṭaraf-e Kharṭūm ham nār-e vaghā moshtaʿel va shakhṣi ʿalam-e ʿeṣyān bar afrākht. Naẓar be eghteshāsh-e Meṣr ān aṭrāf jamiʿ monqaleb va moẓṭareb va janāb-e Ḥāji ʿAbdo’llāh dar ānjā maḥṣūr tā ānke ḥokm-e khorūj rasid va motavakkelan ʿala’llāh birūn āmad va az ṣad hezār balā Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ḥefẓash farmūd va al-ḥamdu li’llāh be arż-e maqṣūd vāred va mosharraf.
:::

::: {.translation}
After these gentlemen arrived in the land of their desire, the heedless and treacherous set Alexandria on fire, burning or plundering people’s possessions of every kind. All the friends’ property was also plundered, and their warehouse was demolished and laid waste. In the region of Khartoum, too, the fire of war was blazing, and someone raised the banner of rebellion. Owing to the disturbances in Egypt, all those regions were in turmoil and agitation, and the honored Ḥājī ʿAbd Allāh was besieged there until the order to leave arrived. He came out, placing his trust in God, and God, exalted be His glory, preserved him from a hundred thousand calamities. Praise be to God, he reached the land of his desire and was admitted to the sacred presence.
:::

### 40

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و امّا حضرات اسکندریّه مع آنکه کمال افلاس موجود و جناب کارپرداز قاهره هم معزول و خبر ورود کارپرداز جدید در اسلامبل واصل مع‌ذلک نظر بوعده‌ئی که شده بود جناب آقا سیّد علی علیه بهآء اللّه در صدد آن برآمدند که بوعده وفا نمایند و از فضل و عنایت حقّ وجهی موجود شد او را اخذ نمود و روانهٴ مصر گشت و مبلغ پنجاه جنیه انگلیزی برد و تسلیم نمود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va ammā ḥażarāt-e Eskandariyye maʿ-e ānke kamāl-e eflās mowjūd va janāb-e kārpardāz-e Qāhere ham maʿzūl va khabar-e vorūd-e kārpardāz-e jadid dar Eslāmbol vāṣel maʿa dhālek naẓar be vaʿde-i ke shode būd janāb-e Āqā Seyyed ʿAli, ʿalayhi bahāʾu’llāh, dar ṣadad-e ān bar āmadand ke be vaʿde vafā namāyand va az fażl va ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq vajhi mowjūd shod ū rā akhdh namūd va ravāne-ye Meṣr gasht va mablagh-e panjāh joneyh-e englisi bord va taslim namūd.
:::

::: {.translation}
As for the gentlemen from Alexandria, although they were utterly destitute, the agent in Cairo had been dismissed, and news had arrived of the new agent’s arrival in Istanbul, nevertheless, in view of the promise that had been made, the honored Āqā Siyyid ʿAlī, may the glory of God rest upon him, sought to fulfill it. Through God’s grace and favor, a sum became available. He took it and set out for Cairo, carrying fifty British pounds, which he handed over.
:::

### 41

::: {.original lang="fa"}
مؤمنین تجّار و خود جناب کارپرداز بسیار متحیّر و متعجّب و اوّل کارپرداز از اخذ آن ابا نمود قسم یاد کرد که من حرفی ندارم این صفات شما مرا کافیست و در مدح و ثنای شما همین قدر بس که همان نفوسیکه شما را دشمن میدارند بمدح شما ناطقند باری این فقره سبب اعلاء شد در آنجهات و جناب آقا سیّد علی علیه بهآء اللّه نوشته‌اند شرحی از محبّت دوستان مصر بقسمیکه طیور حبّ در افئدهٴ اولیا بحرکت و طیران میآید محبّت للّه فی‌الحقیقه حیات حقیقی بخشد و مرده را زنده نماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Moʾmenin-e tojjār va khod-e janāb-e kārpardāz besyār motaḥayyer va motaʿajjeb va avval kārpardāz az akhdh-e ān ebā namūd. Qasam yād kard ke man ḥarfi nadāram in ṣefāt-e shomā marā kāfist va dar madḥ va thanā-ye shomā hamin qadr bas ke hamān nofūsi ke shomā rā doshman midārand be madḥ-e shomā nāṭeqand. Bāri in faqare sabab-e eʿlā shod dar ān jahāt va janāb-e Āqā Seyyed ʿAli, ʿalayhi bahāʾu’llāh, neveshte-and sharḥi az maḥabbat-e dūstān-e Meṣr be qesmi ke ṭoyūr-e ḥobb dar afʾede-ye owliyā be ḥarakat va ṭayarān miāyad. Maḥabbat li’llāh fi’l-ḥaqiqe ḥayāt-e ḥaqiqi bakhshad va morde rā zende namāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
The believing merchants and the agent himself were greatly astonished and amazed. At first the agent refused to accept it, swearing, “I have no claim. These qualities of yours are enough for me. It is sufficient praise of you that the very people who regard you as enemies speak in your praise.” In short, this affair brought honor to the Cause in those regions. The honored Āqā Siyyid ʿAlī, may the glory of God rest upon him, has written an account of the love of the friends in Cairo such that the birds of love in the hearts of the faithful stir and take flight. Love for the sake of God truly bestows real life and brings the dead to life.
:::

### 42

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این وفای بعهد ایشان از سلطان اعمال عند غنیّ متعال مذکور و مسطور از حقّ جلّ جلاله میطلبم احبّای آن ارض و اراضی اخری را مؤیّد فرماید بر امانت و راستی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In vafā-ye be ʿahd-e ishān az solṭān-e aʿmāl ʿenda Ghaniyy-e Motaʿāl madhkūr va masṭūr. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu miṭalabam aḥebbā-ye ān arż va arāżi-ye okhrā rā moʾayyad farmāyad bar amānat va rāsti.
:::

::: {.translation}
Their fulfillment of this pledge is mentioned and recorded before the All-Sufficient, the Most Exalted, as a sovereign among deeds. I ask God, exalted be His glory, to confirm the friends in that land and in other lands in trustworthiness and truthfulness.
:::

### 43

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ارض سجن بمقامی مرتفع که جمیع اطراف باو ناظر بودند و هر یک از اصحاب اگر چیزی طلب مینمودند لأجل بیع و شری از مدن قریبه و بعیده بأنّه هو حاضر جواب میشنیدند و بعد بخیانت بعضی از نفوس و ظلمت ما فی قلوبهم از مقام اوّل بمقام ثانی راجع بل ثالث و مع‌ذلک نظر بآنکه مقرّ کرسی واقع علوّ و سموّ مقامات احباب علی قدر معلوم مابین عباد باقی و برقرار کار یک عیب دیگر پیدا کرده هر نفسیکه بسیار خبیث واقع میشود در آخر مقام دعوی حقّیّت هم مینماید ید قدرت انشآءاللّه عباد خود را حفظ فرماید و بما یحبّ و یرضی فائز نماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Arż-e Sejn be maqāmi mortafeʿ ke jamiʿ-e aṭrāf be ū nāẓer būdand va har yek az aṣḥāb agar chizi ṭalab minamūdand li-ajl-e beyʿ va sherā az modon-e qaribe va baʿide bi-annahu huwa ḥāḍir javāb mishenidand va baʿd be khiyānat-e baʿżi az nofūs va ẓolmat-e mā fi qolūbehem az maqām-e avval be maqām-e thāni rājeʿ bal thāleth va maʿa dhālek naẓar be ānke maqarr-e korsi vāqeʿ ʿolovv va somovv-e maqāmāt-e aḥbāb ʿalā qadr-e maʿlūm mābeyn-e ʿebād bāqi va barqarār. Kār yek ʿeyb-e digar peydā karde har nafsi ke besyār khabith vāqeʿ mishavad dar ākhar maqām daʿvā-ye ḥaqqiyyat ham minamāyad. Yad-e qodrat en shāʾa’llāh ʿebād-e khod rā ḥefẓ farmāyad va be mā yoḥebb va yarżā fāʾez namāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
The Prison Land had risen to such a station that all regions looked toward it. If any of the companions requested something from cities near or far for purposes of trade, they would hear the answer, “It is available.” Then, through the treachery of certain souls and the darkness of what was in their hearts, it fell from the first rank to the second, indeed to the third. Nevertheless, since it is the seat of the Throne, the loftiness and sublimity of the friends’ stations remain established among the people to a certain degree. Another defect has arisen in this affair: anyone who proves exceedingly malicious eventually even lays claim to divinity. God willing, may the hand of power preserve His servants and enable them to attain what He loves and approves.
:::

### 44

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در جمیع احوال جمیع جوارح و اعضا باید بکلمهٴ لا حول و لا قوّة الّا باللّه ناطق باشد در این اثنا لدی العرش حاضر و مقصود غیب و شهود باینکلمه ناطق بنویس بجناب علی قبل اکبر علیه بهائی و رحمتی و عنایتی یا علی مر احبّائی بما یرتفع به مقاماتهم بأمری قل یا اولیآء الرّحمن فی البلدان سخّروا مدائن القلوب بجنود الأعمال و الأخلاق هذا ما حکم به مولی العالم حین استوائه علی العرش الأعظم طوبی لعبد انجذب بندائی و عمل بما امر به فی کتابی المبین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar jamiʿ-e aḥvāl jamiʿ-e javāreḥ va aʿżā bāyad be kalame-ye lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi’llāh nāṭeq bāshad. Dar in athnā ladā al-ʿarsh ḥāżer va Maqṣūd-e gheyb va shohūd be in kalame nāṭeq: Benevis be janāb-e ʿAli qabl-e Akbar, ʿalayhi bahāʾī wa raḥmatī wa ʿināyatī. Yā ʿAliyy, mur aḥibbāʾī bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi maqāmātuhum bi-amrī. Qul yā awliyāʾa al-Raḥmāni fi’l-buldān, sakhkhirū madāʾina al-qulūbi bi-junūdi al-aʿmāli wa’l-akhlāq. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi Mawlā al-ʿālami ḥīna istiwāʾihi ʿalā al-ʿarshi al-aʿẓam. Ṭūbā li-ʿabdin injadhaba bi-nidāʾī wa ʿamila bi-mā umira bihi fī kitābiya al-mubīn. Entahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In every circumstance, all one’s limbs and members should proclaim the words, “There is no power or strength except through God.” At this moment I was present before the Throne, and the Desire of the unseen and the seen spoke these words: “Write to the honored ʿAlī before Akbar, upon him be My glory, My mercy, and My loving-kindness: O ʿAlī, by My command instruct My loved ones in what will exalt their stations. Say: O friends of the All-Merciful throughout the lands! Conquer the cities of hearts with the armies of deeds and character. This is what the Lord of the world has decreed upon His establishment on the Most Great Throne. Blessed is the servant who is enraptured by My call and acts according to what he has been commanded in My perspicuous Book.” End of quotation.
:::

### 45

::: {.original lang="fa"}
از این قبیل بیانات محکمات لاتحصی از لسان مالک وری استماع شد طوبی للعاملین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Az in qabil bayānāt-e moḥkamāt lā toḥṣā az lesān-e Mālek-e varā estemāʿ shod. Ṭūbā li’l-ʿāmilīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Countless firm utterances of this kind were heard from the tongue of the Lord of creation. Blessed are those who act.
:::

### 46

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه در بارهٴ محبوب فؤاد جناب حاجی میرزا حیدر علی علیه بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید و ذکر خدمات ایشانرا فی سبیل اللّه فرمودند بعد از عرض در ساحت اقدس اینکلمه مکرّر از لسان عظمت جاری فرمودند علیه بهآء اللّه علیه بهآء اللّه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Inke dar bāre-ye maḥbūb-e foʾād janāb-e Ḥāji Mirzā Ḥeydar ʿAli, ʿalayhi bahāʾu’llāh, marqūm dāshtid va dhekr-e khadamāt-e ishān rā fi sabil-e Allāh farmūdand baʿd az ʿarż dar sāḥat-e aqdas in kalame mokarrar az lesān-e ʿaẓamat jāri farmūdand: ʿAlayhi bahāʾu’llāh, ʿalayhi bahāʾu’llāh.
:::

::: {.translation}
Concerning what you wrote about the beloved of the heart, the honored Ḥājī Mīrzā Ḥaydar ʿAlī, may the glory of God rest upon him, and your mention of his services in the path of God: after this was presented in the Most Holy Court, these words repeatedly flowed from the tongue of grandeur: “Upon him be the glory of God. Upon him be the glory of God.”
:::

### 47

::: {.original lang="fa"}
خبر مازندران را آنمحبوب بتفصیل مرقوم داشته‌اند و این ایّام از هر شطری عرایض رسیده و حاوی ذکر خدمت ایشان در ق‌و ولکن بعد از عرض بر حسب ظاهر چند یوم در اینفقره امری از مطلع ظاهر نه و بعد یومی از ایّام اینکلمهٴ علیا از مشرق بیان مالک اسماء ظاهر قوله جلّت عظمته و جلّ کبریائه یا عبد حاضر اگر بگوئیم بحکمت واقع شده مشاهده میشود قباع خنازیر و ضوضای جهلا مرتفع و اگر تمام هم بجهة ضوضا ناظر باشیم ستر این خدمت باهر را دوست نداشته و نداریم لذا از مصدر امر الهی این حکم جاری میگوئیم بنطق و بیان ملجأ بوده و حقّ جلّ جلاله نظر بفضل و عنایت او را محلّ و مصدر اعلای کلمه فرموده و این اعلاء اگرچه سبب ضوضا شد ولکن نظر بالجاء بأسی نبوده و نیست بلکه لدی العرش مقبول انّا زیّنّا عمله بطراز القبول و ذکرناه فی الواح شتّی انّ ربک لهو العطوف الغفور الرّحیم الکریم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Khabar-e Māzandarān rā ān maḥbūb be tafṣil marqūm dāshte-and va in ayyām az har shaṭri ʿarāyeż reside va ḥāvi-ye dhekr-e khedmat-e ishān dar Q-V va lāken baʿd az ʿarż bar ḥasb-e ẓāher chand yowm dar in faqare amri az maṭlaʿ ẓāher na va baʿd yowmi az ayyām in kalame-ye ʿolyā az mashreq-e bayān-e Mālek-e asmāʾ ẓāher, qawluhu jallat ʿaẓamatuhu wa jalla kibriyāʾuhu: Yā ʿabd-e ḥāżer, agar begūʾim be ḥekmat vāqeʿ shode moshāhede mishavad qobāʿ-e khanāzir va żowżā-ye johalā mortafeʿ va agar tamām ham be jahat-e żowżā nāẓer bāshim satr-e in khedmat-e bāher rā dūst nadāshte va nadārim. Ledhā az maṣdar-e amr-e elāhi in ḥokm jāri: Migūʾim be noṭq va bayān moljaʾ būde va Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu naẓar be fażl va ʿenāyat ū rā maḥall va maṣdar-e eʿlā-ye kalame farmūde va in eʿlā agarche sabab-e żowżā shod va lāken naẓar be eljāʾ baʾsi nabūde va nist balke ladā al-ʿarsh maqbūl. Innā zayyannā ʿamalahu bi-ṭirāzi al-qabūli wa dhakarnāhu fī alwāḥin shattā. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-ʿAṭūfu al-Ghafūru al-Raḥīmu al-Karīm. Entahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
That beloved one has written the news of Māzandarān in detail. In recent days letters have arrived from every direction, mentioning his service in Q-V. After these were presented, however, for several days no command concerning this matter outwardly appeared from the Dayspring. Then, one day, these exalted words appeared from the dawning-place of the utterance of the Lord of Names—His words, exalted be His grandeur and magnified be His majesty: “O servant in attendance! If We say that it was done with wisdom, it is evident that the grunting of swine and the clamor of the ignorant have arisen. Yet if We were to consider only the clamor, We have not wished, nor do We wish, to conceal this manifest service. Therefore, from the Source of the divine command this decree proceeds: We say that he was compelled to speak and explain, and God, exalted be His glory, through His grace and favor, made him the locus and source of the exaltation of the Word. Although this exaltation caused an uproar, since he was compelled, there was and is no blame; rather, it is accepted before the Throne. We have adorned his deed with the ornament of acceptance and have mentioned him in various Tablets. Your Lord is indeed the Compassionate, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful, the Generous.” End of quotation.
:::

### 48

::: {.original lang="fa"}
عرض اینفانی آنکه صورت این عریضه اگر نوشته شود و بتصحیح فائز و باطراف ارسال گردد خالی از نفع نبوده و نیست چه که مزیّن است بآیات و کلمات حقّ جلّ جلاله که فی‌الحقیقه سبب اشتعال عالم و امم است شاید حلاوت آنرا بیابند و بما یحبّه اللّه قیام نمایند و شاید عرف اعمال و اخلاق طیّبه در اطراف متضوّع شود و ناس غافل را آگاهی بخشد الأمر بیده و ما انا الّا عبد منیب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
ʿArż-e in fāni ānke ṣūrat-e in ʿariże agar neveshte shavad va be taṣḥiḥ fāʾez va be aṭrāf ersāl gardad khāli az nafʿ nabūde va nist che ke mozayyan ast be āyāt va kalemāt-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ke fi’l-ḥaqiqe sabab-e eshteʿāl-e ʿālam va omam ast. Shāyad ḥalāvat-e ān rā beyāband va be mā yoḥebbuhu Allāh qiyām namāyand va shāyad ʿarf-e aʿmāl va akhlāq-e ṭayyebe dar aṭrāf motażavveʿ shavad va nās-e ghāfel rā āgāhi bakhshad. Al-amru bi-yadihi wa mā anā illā ʿabdun munīb.
:::

::: {.translation}
This mortal one submits that it would not be without benefit if a copy of this letter were made, corrected, and sent to various regions, for it is adorned with the verses and words of God, exalted be His glory, which truly set the world and its peoples aflame. Perhaps they will taste its sweetness and arise to do what God loves. Perhaps the fragrance of good deeds and noble character will spread abroad and awaken the heedless. The command is in His hand, and I am only a servant who turns to Him.
:::

### 49

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و آنچه از الواح مخصوص احبّای ارض میم خواسته‌اند همان ایّام نازل و نظر بانقلابات و حکمت در ارسال آن تأخیر رفت این ایّام امر بارسال فرمودند و انشآءاللّه ارسال میشود آنچه آنمحبوب فؤاد در بارهٴ ایشان مرقوم فرمودند فی‌الحقیقه سبب مسرّت قلب شد و عالم عالم محبّت ظاهر انشآءاللّه آنمحبوب و ایشان در جمیع احیان بما اراده اللّه ناطق و بر خدمت امر قائم باشند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va ānche az alvāḥ-e makhṣūṣ-e aḥebbā-ye arż-e Mim khāste-and hamān ayyām nāzel va naẓar be enqelābāt va ḥekmat dar ersāl-e ān taʾkhir raft. In ayyām amr be ersāl farmūdand va en shāʾa’llāh ersāl mishavad. Ānche ān maḥbūb-e foʾād dar bāre-ye ishān marqūm farmūdand fi’l-ḥaqiqe sabab-e masarrat-e qalb shod va ʿālam ʿālam-e maḥabbat ẓāher. En shāʾa’llāh ān maḥbūb va ishān dar jamiʿ-e aḥyān be mā arādahu Allāh nāṭeq va bar khedmat-e amr qāʾem bāshand.
:::

::: {.translation}
As for the Tablets requested specifically for the friends in the land of Mīm, they were revealed in those same days, but owing to the upheavals and considerations of wisdom, their dispatch was delayed. In recent days the order has been given to send them, and, God willing, they will be sent. What that beloved of the heart wrote about them truly brought joy to the heart, and a world of love became manifest. God willing, may that beloved one and those friends at all times speak what God wills and arise to serve the Cause.
:::

### 50

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و دستخطّ ثانی آنحضرت که تاریخ آن غرّهٴ شهر رمضان المبارک بود گوش تازه بخشید و بنغمهٴ جدیده در محبّت مالک احدیّه مترنّم و بعد از استماع و ادراک قصد مقام مقدّس از ذکر و بیان نموده و تفصیل بعد از اذن عرض شد اذاً جری فرات الرّحمة و الألطاف و ماج بحر الفضل علی شأن لا یذکر بالبیان قال و قوله الحقّ
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va dastkhaṭṭ-e thāni-ye ān ḥażrat ke tārikh-e ān ghorre-ye shahr-e Ramażān al-mobārak būd gūsh-e tāze bakhshid va be naghme-ye jadide dar maḥabbat-e Mālek-e aḥadiyye motarannem va baʿd az estemāʿ va edrāk qaṣd-e maqām-e moqaddas az dhekr va bayān namūde va tafṣil baʿd az edhn ʿarż shod. Idhan jarā Furātu al-raḥmati wa’l-alṭāfi wa māja baḥru al-faḍli ʿalā shaʾnin lā yudhkaru bi’l-bayān. Qāla wa qawluhu al-ḥaqq.
:::

::: {.translation}
Your second letter, dated the first of the blessed month of Ramadan, bestowed fresh hearing and sang a new melody of love for the Lord of oneness. After hearing and grasping it, I made my way to the station sanctified above mention and description, and, permission having been granted, presented the details. Then the Euphrates of mercy and loving-kindness flowed, and the ocean of grace surged in a manner that words cannot describe. He said—and His word is the truth:
:::

### 51

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المظلوم الفرید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-Maẓlūmi al-Farīd.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Wronged One, the Peerless.
:::

### 52

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ایّها النّاظر الی شطر السّجن و النّاطق بثنآء المقصود و الشّارب من رحیقی المختوم علیک بهآء اللّه المهیمن القیّوم قد حضر العبد الحاضر بما ارسلته الیه و عرض تلقآء المظلوم ما غنّت حمامة فؤادک فی ثنآء اللّه و ذکره طوبی للسانک و لبیانک و لمن یسمع قولک فی امر اللّه العزیز الودود قد انزلنا علی المقرّبین ما لو یلقی علی التّراب لتطلع منه شمس العلم و البیان کذلک نطقت یراعة الرّحمن و النّاس اکثرهم لا یفقهون انت الّذی حضرت و رأیت البحر و امواجه و الشّمس و انوارها و سمعت ما تکلّم به مکلّم الطّور اذ کان مستویاً علی عرش الظّهور انّ ربّک یذکر من اقبل الیه و نطق بثنائه و قام علی خدمة امره العزیز الممنوع لا تحزن عمّا یعملون المقبلون لعمری لو انصفوا و عرفوا لعملوا بما امروا به فی الواح شتّی من لدی اللّه مالک الوری کذلک نطق امّ الکتاب من قبل و اللّوح المحفوظ فیهذا المقام المحمود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ayyuhā al-nāẓir ilā shaṭr al-sijn wa-l-nāṭiq bi-thanāʾ al-Maqṣūd wa-l-shārib min raḥīqī al-makhtūm, ʿalayka bahāʾ Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Qad ḥaḍara al-ʿabd al-ḥāḍir bi-mā arsaltahu ilayhi wa ʿaraḍa tilqāʾ al-Maẓlūm mā ghannat ḥamāmat fuʾādika fī thanāʾ Allāh wa dhikrihi. Ṭūbā li-lisānika wa li-bayānika wa li-man yasmaʿu qawlaka fī amr Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Wadūd. Qad anzalnā ʿalā al-muqarrabīn mā law yulqā ʿalā al-turāb la-taṭluʿa minhu shams al-ʿilm wa-l-bayān. Kadhālika naṭaqat yarāʿat al-Raḥmān wa-l-nāsu aktharuhum lā yafqahūn. Anta alladhī ḥaḍarta wa raʾayta al-baḥr wa amwājahu wa-l-shams wa anwārahā wa samiʿta mā takallama bihi Mukallim al-Ṭūr idh kāna mustawiyan ʿalā ʿarsh al-ẓuhūr. Inna rabbaka yadhkuru man aqbala ilayhi wa naṭaqa bi-thanāʾihi wa qāma ʿalā khidmat amrihi al-ʿazīz al-mamnūʿ. Lā taḥzan ʿammā yaʿmalūna al-muqbilūn. La-ʿamrī law anṣafū wa ʿarafū la-ʿamilū bi-mā umirū bihi fī alwāḥ shattā min ladā Allāh Mālik al-warā. Kadhālika naṭaqa Umm al-Kitāb min qablu wa-l-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ fī hādhā al-maqām al-maḥmūd.
:::

::: {.translation}
O you who turn your gaze toward the prison, speak in praise of the Desired One, and drink of My sealed wine! Upon you be the glory of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. The servant in attendance has arrived with what you sent him and has presented before the Wronged One what the dove of your heart has sung in praise and remembrance of God. Blessed are your tongue and your utterance, and whoever hears your words concerning the Cause of God, the Almighty, the All-Loving. We have sent down to those brought near what, if cast upon the dust, would cause the sun of knowledge and utterance to rise from it. Thus has the Pen of the All-Merciful spoken, yet most people do not understand. You are the one who came into Our presence and saw the ocean and its waves, and the sun and its lights, and heard what He who spoke on Sinai uttered while seated upon the throne of revelation. Your Lord remembers whoever has turned to Him, spoken His praise, and arisen to serve His mighty, unassailable Cause. Do not grieve over what those who have turned toward Us are doing. By My life, had they been fair and attained recognition, they would have acted as they were commanded in various Tablets from God, the Sovereign of all creation. Thus spoke the Mother Book before, and the Preserved Tablet in this praiseworthy station.
:::

### 53

::: {.original lang="ar"}
کبّر من قبلی احبّائی و ذکّرهم بما ینفعهم و یحفظهم و یرفعهم الی ملکوتی الّذی جعله اللّه مطاف من فی الغیب و الشّهود قل یا اولیائی انّا نوصیکم بأعمال یجد منها الملأ الأعلی عرف التّقدیس لعمری بها یرتفع امری و مقاماتکم فیظلّ قباب عنایتی و خبآء مجدی و فسطاط رحمتی الّتی سبقت الوجود قل انّا نکون معکم فیکلّ الأحوال نسمع و نری و انا السّامع البصیر انّا نری و نستر نسمع و نصمت لو نفصّل لک ما ظهر و سیظهر تأخذک الأحزان فاسئل اللّه بأن یبدّله بسلطان من عنده انّ ربّک لهو القویّ القدیر البهآء و النّور علیک و علی اولیائی و علی الّذین وفوا بمیثاق اللّه و عهده فی هذا الیوم العزیز البدیع انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Kabbir min qibalī aḥibbāʾī wa dhakkirhum bi-mā yanfaʿuhum wa yaḥfaẓuhum wa yarfaʿuhum ilā malakūtī alladhī jaʿalahu Allāh maṭāf man fī al-ghayb wa-l-shuhūd. Qul yā awliyāʾī innā nūṣīkum bi-aʿmāl yajidu minhā al-Malaʾ al-Aʿlā ʿarf al-taqdīs. La-ʿamrī bihā yartafiʿu amrī wa maqāmātukum fī ẓill qibāb ʿināyatī wa khibāʾ majdī wa fusṭāṭ raḥmatī allatī sabaqat al-wujūd. Qul innā nakūnu maʿakum fī kull al-aḥwāl nasmaʿu wa narā wa anā al-Sāmiʿ al-Baṣīr. Innā narā wa nasturu nasmaʿu wa naṣmutu. Law nufaṣṣil laka mā ẓahara wa sa-yaẓhar taʾkhudhuka al-aḥzān fa-sʾal Allāh bi-an yubaddilahu bi-sulṭān min ʿindihi. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-Qawī al-Qadīr. Al-bahāʾ wa-l-nūr ʿalayka wa ʿalā awliyāʾī wa ʿalā alladhīna wafaw bi-mīthāq Allāh wa ʿahdihi fī hādhā al-yawm al-ʿazīz al-badīʿ. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Convey to My loved ones, on My behalf, the greeting of magnification, and remind them of what will benefit and protect them and raise them to My Kingdom, which God has made the center around which all in the unseen and visible realms revolve. Say: O My friends, We counsel you to perform deeds from which the Concourse on high may perceive the fragrance of holiness. By My life, through such deeds My Cause is exalted, as are your stations beneath the domes of My care, the canopy of My glory, and the pavilion of My mercy, which has preceded all existence. Say: We are with you in every condition; We hear and see, and I am the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. We see and conceal; We hear and remain silent. Were We to detail for you what has appeared and will appear, sorrows would seize you. Ask God, then, to transform it through a power from Himself. Your Lord is indeed the Strong, the All-Powerful. Glory and light be upon you, upon My friends, and upon those who have remained faithful to God’s covenant and pledge in this mighty, wondrous Day. End.
:::

### 54

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این فانی خدمت آنمحبوب عرض مینماید که اگرچه جواب دستخطّها تأخیر میشود ولکن بعد جمیع مطالب واحداً بعد واحد از سماء مشیّت الهی نازل و ارسال میگردد از حسن حظّ آنکه سبب تأخیر خدمت آنحضرت مشهود و واضح و مبرهنست در هر حال امید عفو است و دیگر از آنحضرت این خادم فانی مطمئن است چه که مطّلع و آگاهند اینکه بشارت وصول الواح الهیرا مرقوم داشتید و هم‌چنین اجتماع دوستان و القاء آن بر ایشان و ذکر مراتب شوق و ذوق و جذب و انجذاب حزبه تعالی فی‌الحقیقه مسرّت بی‌اندازه عنایت فرمود انشآءاللّه در جمیع احوال از حلاوت بیان رحمن قسمت برند و بما ینبغی قیام نمایند چه‌قدر محبوبست از آن نفوس منجذبهٴ مشتعله ظهور اعمال و اخلاق طیّبهٴ مرضیّه آفاق عالم انسان باین انوار روشن و منیر عمل مقبل مستقیم بمثابهٴ شجر است اصلش در ارض استقامت و فرعش الی ما شآء اللّه و اثمارش بدوام ملک و ملکوت فی‌الحقیقه جز مرآت علم الهی احصای اینمراتب ننموده و نخواهد نمود هنیئاً لحضرتکم و لهم از حقّ میطلبیم جمیع اهل عالم را از این نعمت طیّبه و مائدهٴ سمائیّه قسمت عطا فرماید و محروم ننماید انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn fānī khedmat-e ān maḥbūb ʿarż mīnamāyad ke agarche javāb-e dastkhaṭṭ-hā taʾkhīr mīshavad valīkan baʿd jamīʿ-e maṭāleb vāḥedan baʿd vāḥed az samā-ye mashiyyat-e elāhī nāzel va ersāl mīgardad. Az ḥosn-e ḥaẓẓ ānke sabab-e taʾkhīr khedmat-e ān ḥażrat mashhūd va vāżeḥ va mobarhan ast. Dar har ḥāl omīd-e ʿafv ast va dīgar az ān ḥażrat īn khādem-e fānī moṭmaʾenn ast che ke moṭṭaleʿ va āgāhand. Īnke beshārat-e voṣūl-e alvāḥ-e elāhī rā marqūm dāshtīd va hamchenīn ejtemāʿ-e dūstān va elqā-ye ān bar īshān va dhekr-e marāteb-e showq va dhowq va jadhb va enjedhāb-e ḥezb-e taʿālā fī-l-ḥaqīqe masarrat-e bī-andāze ʿenāyat farmūd. In shāʾ Allāh dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl az ḥalāvat-e bayān-e Raḥmān qesmat barand va bi-mā yanbaghī qiyām namāyand. Che-qadr maḥbūb ast az ān nofūs-e monjadhebe-ye moshtaʿele ẓohūr-e aʿmāl va akhlāq-e ṭayyebe-ye marżiyye. Āfāq-e ʿālam-e ensān be īn anvār rowshan va monīr. ʿAmal-e moqbel-e mostaqīm be-mathābe-ye shajar ast aṣlash dar arż-e esteqāmat va farʿash ilā mā shāʾ Allāh va athmārash be-davām-e molk va malakūt. Fī-l-ḥaqīqe joz merʾāt-e ʿelm-e elāhī eḥṣā-ye īn marāteb nanamūde va nakhāhad namūd. Hanīʾan li-ḥaḍratikum wa lahum. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm jamīʿ-e ahl-e ʿālam rā az īn neʿmat-e ṭayyebe va māʾede-ye samāʾiyye qesmat ʿaṭā farmāyad va maḥrūm nanamāyad. Innahu ʿalā kull shayʾ qadīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
This transient one submits to that beloved friend that, although replies to the letters are delayed, all the matters raised are subsequently revealed, one by one, from the heaven of the divine will and dispatched. Fortunately, the reason for the delay is evident, clear, and established to you. In every circumstance, forgiveness is hoped for; moreover, this transient servant feels assured concerning you, since you are informed and aware. What you wrote conveying the glad news of the arrival of the divine Tablets, the gathering of the friends and the reading of the Tablets to them, and the degrees of longing, joy, attraction, and rapture among His exalted company truly bestowed boundless happiness.
