God willing, may they partake in every circumstance of the sweetness of the All-Merciful’s utterance and arise to do what is fitting. How welcome is the appearance of good, pleasing deeds and qualities from those enraptured, enkindled souls! The horizons of the human world are bright and radiant with these lights. The deed of a steadfast believer is like a tree: its root is in the soil of steadfastness, its branches reach as far as God wills, and its fruits endure as long as the earthly and heavenly kingdoms. In truth, none but the Mirror of divine knowledge has reckoned, or will ever reckon, these degrees. May this blessing be yours and theirs! We ask God to grant all the people of the world a share of this goodly bounty and heavenly banquet, and not to deprive them. He is powerful over all things.
:::

### 55

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه اظهار تشکّر و بهجت و سرور از مائدهٴ ثانیه و شمس جدیدهٴ مشرقه و نعمت مکرّره فرمودند ارکانرا بهجت بسیار لطیفی بل الطف عمّا یحصی عطا نمود در ذکر اشراق الواح الهی از افق عنایت مرّهٴ اخری این کلمه را مرقوم داشتید قولکم دیگر این لاشیء این کرّه چنان جرعه‌نوش شده و از این عطیّهٴ کبری محظوظ گشته که خود را مالک بر من علی الأرض یافته بعد از عرض این کلمه در ساحت امنع اقدس لسان الهی باین کلمهٴ مبارکه ناطق قوله جلّ و عزّ این بیان جناب علی قبل اکبر بمثابهٴ شاخهٴ محبّت است که بعشق الهی پیوند شده انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke eẓhār-e tashakkor va bahjat va sorūr az māʾede-ye thāniye va shams-e jadīde-ye moshreqe va neʿmat-e mokarrarre farmūdand arkān rā bahjat-e besyār laṭīfī bal alṭaf ʿammā yuḥṣā ʿaṭā namūd. Dar dhekr-e eshrāq-e alvāḥ-e elāhī az ofoq-e ʿenāyat marre-ye okhrā īn kalame rā marqūm dāshtīd qowlokom dīgar īn lā-shayʾ īn karre chenān jorʿe-nūsh shode va az īn ʿaṭiyye-ye kobrā maḥẓūẓ gashte ke khod rā mālek bar man ʿalā al-arḍ yāfte. Baʿd az ʿarż-e īn kalame dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas lesān-e elāhī be īn kalame-ye mobārake nāṭeq qawluhu jalla wa ʿazza īn bayān-e Jenāb-e ʿAlī qabl-e Akbar be-mathābe-ye shākhe-ye maḥabbat ast ke be ʿeshq-e elāhī peyvand shode. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Your expression of gratitude, delight, and joy for the second banquet, the newly risen sun, and the renewed bounty bestowed upon every limb a most exquisite joy—indeed, more exquisite than can be reckoned. In mentioning the renewed dawning of the divine Tablets from the horizon of grace, you wrote these words: “Furthermore, this nothingness has this time drunk so deeply and so enjoyed this supreme gift that he has found himself sovereign over all who are on earth.” After these words were presented in the most exalted, most holy court, the divine Tongue spoke these blessed words—exalted and glorified be He: “This utterance of Jinab-i ‘Ali before Akbar is like a branch of love grafted onto divine love.” End.
:::

### 56

::: {.original lang="fa"}
صدهزار روح و بحور آن فدای اینکلمهٴ مبارکه که بمثابهٴ آفتاب از افق عنایت طالع شده سبّح بحمد ربّک و کن من الشّاکرین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ṣad-hezār rūḥ va boḥūr-e ān fadā-ye īn kalame-ye mobārake ke be-mathābe-ye āftāb az ofoq-e ʿenāyat ṭāleʿ shode. Sabbiḥ bi-ḥamd rabbika wa kun min al-shākirīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
May a hundred thousand souls, and oceans of them, be sacrificed for this blessed utterance, which has risen like the sun from the horizon of grace. Glorify your Lord with praise and be among the thankful.
:::

### 57

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در ذکر دوستان الهی مرقوم داشتید که ایشان هم از کوثر بیان رحمن منجذب شدند بشأنیکه مجذوب‌وار بثنای الهی ناطق گشتند و هم‌چنین بنفی شعور و ادراک و انسانیّت از نفوس معرضه از اهل بیان بعد از عرض این فقره این کلمهٴ تامّهٴ مطاعه از مطلع بیان احدیّه اشراق فرمود فرمودند یا عبد حاضر انشآءاللّه دوستان الهی همیشه جمع باشند و بذکر و ثنای حقّ مشغول هر نفسی از بحر اعظم آشامید عالم را در ظلّ خود مشاهده نماید این طیور را پرواز حقّ آموخته و فوق طیور ادراک و عقول طیران نمایند طوبی لهم طوبی لهم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar dhekr-e dūstān-e elāhī marqūm dāshtīd ke īshān ham az Kowthar-e bayān-e Raḥmān monjadheb shodand be-shaʾnī ke majdhūb-vār be thanā-ye elāhī nāṭeq gashtand va hamchenīn be nafy-e shoʿūr va edrāk va ensāniyyat az nofūs-e moʿreże az ahl-e Bayān baʿd az ʿarż-e īn feqre īn kalame-ye tāmme-ye moṭāʿe az maṭlaʿ-e bayān-e aḥadiyye eshrāq farmūd. Farmūdand yā ʿAbd-e Ḥāżer in shāʾ Allāh dūstān-e elāhī hamīshe jamʿ bāshand va be dhekr va thanā-ye Ḥaqq mashghūl. Har nafsī az baḥr-e aʿẓam āshāmīd ʿālam rā dar ẓell-e khod moshāhede namāyad. Īn ṭoyūr rā parvāz Ḥaqq āmūkhte va fowq-e ṭoyūr-e edrāk va ʿoqūl ṭayarān namāyand. Ṭūbā lahum ṭūbā lahum. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
You wrote, in speaking of the friends of God, that they too were so enraptured by the Kawthar of the All-Merciful’s utterance that, like souls transported, they began to voice the praise of God; you also wrote denying awareness, understanding, and humanity to those among the people of the Bayan who have turned away. After this passage was presented, this perfect, authoritative utterance shone forth from the Dayspring of the utterance of divine unity. He said: “O servant in attendance! God willing, may the friends of God always be gathered together and occupied with the remembrance and praise of God. Any soul who has drunk from the Most Great Ocean will behold the world beneath his shadow. God has taught these birds to fly, and they soar above the birds of understanding and intellect. Blessed are they! Blessed are they!” End.
:::

### 58

::: {.original lang="ar"}
فدای وجودیکه حلاوت بیانرا بیابد و شموس شفقت و الطاف را از آفاق سماء کلمات کتاب الهی مشاهده نماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Fadā-ye vojūdī ke ḥalāvat-e bayān rā beyābad va shomūs-e shafaqat va alṭāf rā az āfāq-e samā-ye kalemāt-e Ketāb-e elāhī moshāhede namāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
May I be sacrificed for the one who tastes the sweetness of the utterance and beholds the suns of compassion and loving-kindness shining from the horizons of the heaven of the words of the divine Book.
:::

### 59

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ حرکت و مشورت مرقوم داشتند فی‌الحقیقه کون آنمحبوب در آن ایّام در آن ارض لازم بود امید هست از عنایت حقّ جلّ جلاله که آن ارض مبارکه را از شئونات مردودهٴ معرضین از اهل بیان مقدّس فرماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāre-ye ḥarekat va mashverat marqūm dāshtand fī-l-ḥaqīqe kown-e ān maḥbūb dar ān ayyām dar ān arż lāzem būd. Omīd hast az ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ke ān arż-e mobārake rā az shoʾūnāt-e mardūde-ye moʿreżīn az ahl-e Bayān moqaddas farmāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to what you wrote concerning departure and consultation, that beloved friend’s presence in that land during those days was indeed necessary. It is hoped that, through His grace, God—glorified be His glory—will sanctify that blessed land from the reprehensible conduct of those among the people of the Bayan who have turned away.
:::

### 60

::: {.original lang="fa"}
سبحان‌اللّه چه مقدار مردم غافلند هر ذیشعور و درایتی متحیّر است از آن نفوس مجعوله جهل را بر کرسیّ قلوب مقرّ داده‌اند و علم و انصاف را خارج باب داشته‌اند افّ لهم و لمن ضلّ و اضلّهم و لداهیة تمشی و لا تعرف الی من و لها هاویة تستعیذ الهاویة منها
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Sobḥān Allāh che meqdār mardom ghāfeland. Har dhī-shoʿūr va derāyatī motaḥayyer ast az ān nofūs-e majʿūle. Jahl rā bar korsī-ye qolūb maqarr dāde-and va ʿelm va enṣāf rā khārej-e bāb dāshte-and. Uffin lahum wa li-man ḍalla wa aḍallahum wa li-dāhiyatin tamshī wa lā taʿrifu ilā man wa lahā hāwiyatun tastaʿīdhu al-hāwiyatu minhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Glory be to God! How heedless people are! Everyone endowed with awareness and discernment is astonished at those counterfeit souls. They have enthroned ignorance in their hearts and kept knowledge and fairness outside the door. Fie upon them, upon the one who has gone astray and led them astray, and upon a calamity that walks without knowing toward whom, and that has an abyss from which the abyss itself seeks refuge!
:::

### 61

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا میرزا لطف‌اللّه علیه بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید در پیشگاه حضور مالک قدم عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان الرّحمن فی ملکوت البیان قوله جلّ اجلاله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāre-ye Jenāb-e Āqā Mīrzā Loṭf-Allāh ʿalayhi bahāʾ Allāh marqūm dāshtīd dar pīshgāh-e ḥożūr-e Mālek-e Qedam ʿarż shod. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi lisān al-Raḥmān fī malakūt al-bayān qawluhu jalla ijlāluhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning Jinab-i Aqa Mirza Lutfu’llah—upon him be the glory of God—was presented in the presence of the Lord of Eternity. This is what the Tongue of the All-Merciful uttered in the kingdom of utterance—His words, exalted be His majesty:
:::

### 62

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی النّاصح المشفق الخبیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-Nāṣiḥ al-Mushfiq al-Khabīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Counselor, the Compassionate, the All-Aware.
:::

### 63

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا ایّها المقبل الی الوجه ایّام ایّام اللّه است بیک آن آن قرون و اعصار معادله نمینماید ذرّهٴ این یوم بمثابهٴ خورشید مشاهده میگردد و قطره‌اش مانند دریا اگر نفسی یک نفس فی حبّ اللّه و لخدمته برآرد او از سیّد اعمال از قلم اعلی مسطور اگر فضائل این یوم ذکر شود کلّ منصعق مشاهده شوند الّا من شآء ربّک لذا محبوب آنکه در این یوم در صدد آن باشی که بانوار شمس رضای حقّ فائز شوی یک کلمه از صدهزار اولاد بهتر و برتر و پاینده‌تر است انشآءاللّه باینمقام بلند اعلی فائز گردی تا ذکرت بدوام ملک و ملکوت پاینده ماند در هیچ حال مأیوس مباش بذیل حقّ متشبّث باش و باو متوکّل قل یا الهی انا الّذی اقبلت الیک بروحی و ذاتی و نفسی و ما عندی و وضعت املی و رجائی و مشیّتی و ارادتی امام کرسیّ عظمتک ایّدنی علی ما اردته بجودک و فضلک انت تعلم بأنّی لا علم لی بما ینفعنی و یضرّنی قدّر لی ما هو خیر لی انّک انت الشّاهد العالم المشفق العلیم الحکیم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ayyuhā al-muqbil ilā al-Wajh ayyām ayyām-e Allāh ast. Be yek ān-e ān qorūn va aʿṣār moʿādele namīnamāyad. Dharre-ye īn yowm be-mathābe-ye khorshīd moshāhede mīgardad va qaṭre-ash mānand-e daryā. Agar nafsī yek nafas fī ḥubb Allāh wa li-khidmatihi barārad ū az sayyed-e aʿmāl az Qalam-e Aʿlā masṭūr. Agar fażāʾel-e īn yowm dhekr shavad koll monṣaʿeq moshāhede shavand illā man shāʾa rabbuka. Ledhā maḥbūb ānke dar īn yowm dar ṣadad-e ān bāshī ke be anvār-e shams-e reżā-ye Ḥaqq fāʾez shavī. Yek kalame az ṣad-hezār owlād behtar va bartar va pāyande-tar ast. In shāʾ Allāh be īn maqām-e boland-e aʿlā fāʾez gardī tā dhekrat be-davām-e molk va malakūt pāyande mānad. Dar hīch ḥāl maʾyūs mabāsh be dheyl-e Ḥaqq motashabbeth bāsh va be ū motavakkel. Qul yā ilāhī anā alladhī aqbaltu ilayka bi-rūḥī wa dhātī wa nafsī wa mā ʿindī wa waḍaʿtu amalī wa rajāʾī wa mashiyyatī wa irādatī amāma kursī ʿaẓamatika. Ayyidnī ʿalā mā aradtahu bi-jūdika wa faḍlika. Anta taʿlamu bi-annī lā ʿilma lī bi-mā yanfaʿunī wa yaḍurrunī. Qaddir lī mā huwa khayrun lī. Innaka anta al-Shāhid al-ʿĀlim al-Mushfiq al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O you who turn toward the Face! These days are the days of God. Centuries and ages cannot equal a single moment of them. An atom of this Day is seen as a sun, and its drop as an ocean. If a soul draws a single breath in the love of God and in His service, it is recorded by the Most Exalted Pen among the foremost of deeds. Were the virtues of this Day to be recounted, all would be seen struck senseless, except those whom your Lord wills. It is therefore desirable that on this Day you strive to attain the rays of the sun of God’s good pleasure. One word is better, loftier, and more enduring than a hundred thousand children. God willing, may you attain this lofty, most exalted station, so that your remembrance may endure as long as the earthly and heavenly kingdoms. Never despair in any circumstance. Cling to the hem of God’s garment and place your trust in Him. Say: “O my God, I am the one who has turned to You with my spirit, my being, my self, and all that I possess, and has laid my aspiration, my hope, my will, and my desire before the throne of Your grandeur. Through Your generosity and grace, assist me to accomplish what You have willed. You know that I have no knowledge of what benefits me or harms me. Ordain for me what is best for me. You are indeed the Witness, the Knowing, the Compassionate, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.” End.
:::

### 64

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جناب حاجی آقا علیه بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید بعد از عرض در ساحت اقدس این لوح مبارک از سماء مشیّت نازل انشآءاللّه از بحر بیان رحمن بیاشامند و بانوار معرفتش منوّر گردند قوله جلّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāre-ye Jenāb-e Ḥājī Āqā ʿalayhi bahāʾ Allāh marqūm dāshtīd baʿd az ʿarż dar sāḥat-e aqdas īn lowḥ-e mobārak az samā-ye mashiyyat nāzel. In shāʾ Allāh az baḥr-e bayān-e Raḥmān biyāshāmand va be anvār-e maʿrefatash monavvar gardand. Qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
After what you wrote concerning Jinab-i Haji Aqa—upon him be the glory of God—was presented in the Most Holy Court, this blessed Tablet descended from the heaven of the divine will. God willing, may he drink from the ocean of the All-Merciful’s utterance and be illumined by the lights of His knowledge. His words—exalted be His grandeur:
:::

### 65

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو الأقدس الأعظم الأبهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-Aqdas al-Aʿẓam al-Abhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Most Holy, the Most Great, the All-Glorious.
:::

### 66

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انّ النّور ینادی و النّار تنادی طوبی لأذن سمعت و فازت بما اراده اللّه فی یومه العزیز البدیع انّه اتی لحیوة العالم و الأمم ارادوا قتله فویل لهم انّ ربّک لهو الشّاهد الخبیر قل تاللّه انّ الطّور یطوف حولی و الأنوار سجدت لهذا النّور اللّمیع من النّاس من نطق بالهوی و منهم من قام علی الافترآء و منهم من تمسّک بالّذین نقضوا میثاق اللّه و عهده کذلک قضی الأمر و انا من الشّاهدین یا ملأ الأرض دعوا ما عندکم رجآء ما عند اللّه کذلک یأمرکم من ینطق بالحقّ انّه لا اله الّا هو المقتدر القدیر طوبی لک بما ذکرت لدی المظلوم و نزل لک من عنده ما یغنیک فیکلّ عالم من عوالم ربّک ان انت من الرّاسخین تمسّک بکتاب اللّه و ما نزّل من عنده انّ ربّک لهو المؤیّد الغفور الرّحیم قد شهدت الکتب لکتابی و هو هذا الهیکل الّذی استوی علی العرش رغماً لکلّ عالم بعید کذلک نطق قلمی الأعلی فضلاً من عندی ان افرح بهذا الفضل العظیم البهآء المشرق من افق ملکوتی علی الّذین نبذوا سوائی و تمسّکوا بعنایتی و تشبّثوا بذیلی المنیر انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Inna al-nūra yunādī wa-al-nāra tunādī. Ṭūbā li-udhunin samiʿat wa-fāzat bi-mā arādahu Allāhu fī yawmihi al-ʿazīzi al-badīʿ. Innahu atā li-ḥayāti al-ʿālami wa-al-umamu arādū qatlahu, fa-waylun lahum. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-shāhidu al-khabīr. Qul ta-Allāhi inna al-Ṭūra yaṭūfu ḥawlī wa-al-anwāru sajadat li-hādhā al-nūri al-lamīʿ. Mina al-nāsi man naṭaqa bi-al-hawā wa-minhum man qāma ʿalā al-iftirāʾ wa-minhum man tamassaka bi-alladhīna naqaḍū mīthāqa Allāhi wa-ʿahdahu. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru wa-anā mina al-shāhidīn. Yā malaʾa al-arḍi daʿū mā ʿindakum rajāʾa mā ʿinda Allāh. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum man yanṭiqu bi-al-ḥaqq. Innahu lā ilāha illā huwa al-muqtadiru al-qadīr. Ṭūbā laka bi-mā dhukirta ladā al-Maẓlūmi wa-nazala laka min ʿindihi mā yughnīka fī kulli ʿālamin min ʿawālimi rabbika in anta mina al-rāsikhīn. Tamassak bi-kitābi Allāhi wa-mā nuzzila min ʿindihi. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-muʾayyidu al-ghafūru al-raḥīm. Qad shahidati al-kutubu li-kitābī wa-huwa hādhā al-haykalu alladhī istawā ʿalā al-ʿarshi raghman li-kulli ʿālimin baʿīd. Kadhālika naṭaqa qalamī al-aʿlā faḍlan min ʿindī. An ifraḥ bi-hādhā al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīm. Al-bahāʾu al-mushriqu min ufuqi malakūtī ʿalā alladhīna nabadhū siwāʾī wa-tamassakū bi-ʿināyatī wa-tashabbathū bi-dhaylī al-munīr. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
The light calls out, and the fire calls out. Blessed is the ear that has heard and attained what God has intended in His mighty, wondrous Day. He has come to bring life to the world, yet the peoples have sought to kill Him. Woe to them! Your Lord is indeed the Witness, the All-Aware. Say: “By God, the Mount circles around Me, and the lights have bowed down before this resplendent Light.” Among the people are those who speak out of desire, those who arise to fabricate falsehoods, and those who cling to the ones who have broken God’s covenant and His pledge. Thus has the matter been decreed, and I am among the witnesses. People of the earth, relinquish what you possess in the hope of what is with God. Thus commands you the One who speaks the truth. There is no god but Him, the All-Powerful, the Almighty. Blessed are you, for you have been mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One, and He has sent down for you what will suffice you in every world among the worlds of your Lord, if you remain steadfast. Hold fast to the Book of God and to what has been sent down from Him. Your Lord is indeed the One who strengthens, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. The Scriptures have borne witness to My Book, which is this Temple that has ascended the throne despite every wayward scholar. Thus has My Most Exalted Pen spoken, as a favor from Me. Rejoice in this great favor. May the glory shining from the horizon of My kingdom rest upon those who have cast aside all but Me, held fast to My loving care, and clung to My luminous robe. End.
:::

### 67

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انوار فضل احاطه فرمود و فجر عنایت دمید صدهزار طوبی از برای نفوسیکه الیوم بمقصود فائز شدند و شئونات و ظهورات ایّام معدوده ایشانرا از مقام باقی منع ننمود تکبیر و سلام این عبد خدمت جناب میرزا و ایشان و هر یک از دوستان الهی اگر ممکن شود در هر صباح و مساء بلکه در هر ساعت بل در هر آن معلّق بعنایت آنمحبوبست
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Anvār-e faḍl eḥāṭeh farmūd va fajr-e ʿināyat damīd. Ṣad-hizār ṭūbā az barā-ye nofūsī keh al-yawm beh maqṣūd fāʾiz shodand va shuʾūnāt va ẓuhūrāt-e ayyām-e maʿdūdeh īshān-rā az maqām-e bāqī manʿ nanamūd. Takbīr va salām-e īn ʿabd khedmat-e Jināb-e Mīrzā va īshān va har yek az dūstān-e ilāhī, agar momken shavad dar har ṣabāḥ va masāʾ balkeh dar har sāʿat bal dar har ān, moʿallaq beh ʿināyat-e ān maḥbūb ast.
:::

::: {.translation}
The lights of grace have encompassed all, and the dawn of loving care has broken. A hundred thousand blessings upon those souls who have attained the Desired One today, and whom the circumstances and appearances of these numbered days have not kept from the everlasting station. The conveyance of this servant’s greetings and salutations to Jinab-i Mirza, to them, and to each of the friends of God—if possible, every morning and evening, indeed every hour, even every moment—depends upon the kindness of that beloved friend.
:::

### 68

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه ذکر جناب رضا قلیخان علیه ٦٦٩ \[بهآء اللّه\] فرموده بودند امام وجه من لا یعزب عن علمه من شیء عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان الشّفقة و الکرم و الفضل قوله جلّ شأنه و عظم کرمه یا علی قبل اکبر علیک رحمتی الّتی سبقت البشر حقّ جلّ جلاله جمیع عالمرا از برای معرفت خود خلق فرموده و از برای کلّ راحت خواسته و اسبابیهم بمقتضیات حکمتش ظاهر فرموده لعمری اگر اهل ارض بانوار نیّر سماء علم منوّر شوند یعنی بآنچه از افق اعلی و ذروهٴ علیا نازل تمسّک نمایند و عمل کنند کلّ خود را در کمال سرور و امنیّت و راحت مشاهده نمایند آنچه در بارهٴ ایشان عمل نمودید لدی العرش محبوب از قبل مظلوم تکبیر برسان بگو محزون مباش از آنچه بر تو وارد شد بر حقّ اعظم از آن وارد قسم بانوار وجه الهی این عالم باینعظمت که مشاهده میشود لایق یکنفر از دوستان الهی نبوده و نیست ان استقم علی الأمر انّه یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید انشآءاللّه در کلّ احیان باو ناظر باشند و بذیلش متشبّث انّه یقدّر له ما اراد و هو المشفق الکریم البهآء علیه و الصّبر له و الاصطبار لک و الأمر لی و انا الآمر الحکیم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn-keh dhekr-e Jināb-e Riḍā Qulī Khān, ʿalayhi 669 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\], farmūdeh būdand, imāma wajhi man lā yaʿzubu ʿan ʿilmihi min shayʾ, ʿarḍ shod. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi lisānu al-shafaqati wa-al-karami wa-al-faḍl. Qawluhu jalla shaʾnuhu wa-ʿaẓuma karamuhu: Yā ʿAlī qabla Akbar, ʿalayka raḥmatī allatī sabaqati al-bashar. Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu jamīʿ-e ʿālam-rā az barā-ye maʿrefat-e khod khalq farmūdeh va az barā-ye koll rāḥat khvāsteh va asbābī ham beh moqtaḍayāt-e ḥekmatash ẓāher farmūdeh. La-ʿamrī agar ahl-e arḍ beh anvār-e nayyer-e samā-ye ʿelm monavvar shavand, yaʿnī beh āncheh az ofoq-e aʿlā va dhorveh-ye ʿulyā nāzel tamassok namāyand va ʿamal konand, koll khod-rā dar kamāl-e sorūr va amniyyat va rāḥat moshāhedeh namāyand. Āncheh dar bāreh-ye īshān ʿamal namūdīd ladā al-ʿarsh maḥbūb. Az qebal-e Maẓlūm takbīr berasān. Begū maḥzūn mabāsh az āncheh bar to vāred shod. Bar Ḥaqq aʿẓam az ān vāred. Qasam beh anvār-e vajh-e ilāhī, īn ʿālam beh īn ʿaẓamat keh moshāhedeh mīshavad lāyeq-e yek nafar az dūstān-e ilāhī nabūdeh va nīst. An istaqim ʿalā al-amr. Innahu yafʿalu mā yashāʾu wa-yaḥkumu mā yurīd. In shāʾ Allāh dar koll-e aḥyān beh ū nāẓer bāshand va beh dhaylash motashabbeth. Innahu yuqaddiru lahu mā arāda wa-huwa al-mushfiqu al-karīm. Al-bahāʾu ʿalayhi wa-al-ṣabru lahu wa-al-iṣṭibāru laka wa-al-amru lī wa-anā al-āmiru al-ḥakīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you had written concerning Jinab-i Rida Quli Khan—upon him be 669 \[the glory of God\]—was presented before the face of Him from whose knowledge nothing is hidden. This is what the Tongue of compassion, generosity, and grace spoke. His words—exalted be His station and great His generosity: “O Ali before Akbar, upon you be My mercy, which has preceded humankind. God, exalted be His glory, has created the entire world for the knowledge of Himself. He has desired comfort for all and has provided the means in accordance with the requirements of His wisdom. By My life, if the people of the earth were illumined by the lights of the sun of the heaven of knowledge—that is, if they held fast to what has been sent down from the most exalted horizon and the loftiest summit, and acted upon it—they would all find themselves in perfect joy, security, and comfort. What you have done for him is pleasing before the Throne. Convey greetings from the Wronged One. Say: ‘Do not grieve over what has befallen you. Something greater has befallen God. I swear by the lights of the divine countenance, this world, with all the greatness it appears to possess, has never been and is not now worthy of a single one of the friends of God. Remain steadfast in the Cause. He does what He wills and decrees what He desires.’ God willing, may he look to Him at all times and cling to His robe. He ordains for him whatever He desires, and He is the Compassionate, the Generous. Glory be upon him, patience be his, perseverance be yours, and command be Mine. I am the Ordainer, the All-Wise.” End.
:::

### 69

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا سیّد محمّد طبیب علیه بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید و هم‌چنین مراتب ذهن و ذکا و اقبال و کمال و استعداد ایشان اینمراتب بتمامه در حین زوال یوم یکشنبه شهر صفر مقرّ عرش تلقاء وجه عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان العظمة قوله جلّ کبریائه انشآءاللّه بعنایت حقّ فائز باشند و بانوار معرفتش منیر و از رحیقش مشروب و از مائده‌اش مرزوق حبّذا هذا الیوم المبارک العزیز عرفش عالم را احاطه نموده و نسیمش بر کلّ مرور کرده طوبی لمن انتبه من هذا النّسیم و عرف و قام و قال مقبلاً الی الأفق الأعلی قد کنت نائماً یا الهی هزّتنی نسمات عنایتک و اقامتنی امام افق فضلک اسئلک بأن تؤیّدنی علی خدمتک و الاستقامة علی امرک انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام الوجود من الغیب و الشّهود یا علی لحاظ عنایت باو متوجّه بشّره بما نطق به المظلوم فی سجنه العظیم ترقّی از برای وجود بوده و هست در جمیع عوالم هذا حقّ لا ریب فیه البهآء علیک و علیه و علی من تمسّک بالمعروف و ما یرتفع به امر اللّه ربّ العالمین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn-keh dar bāreh-ye Jināb-e Āqā Siyyid Muḥammad Ṭabīb, ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh, marqūm dāshtīd va hamchenīn marāteb-e dhehn va dhakā va eqbāl va kamāl va esteʿdād-e īshān, īn marāteb beh tamāmeh dar ḥīn-e zavāl-e yawm-e yekshanbeh shahr-e Ṣafar, maqarr-e ʿarsh, telqāʾ-e vajh ʿarḍ shod. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi lisānu al-ʿaẓama. Qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu: In shāʾ Allāh beh ʿināyat-e Ḥaqq fāʾiz bāshand va beh anvār-e maʿrefatash monīr va az raḥīqash mashrūb va az māʾedeh-ash marzūq. Ḥabbadhā hādhā al-yawmu al-mubāraku al-ʿazīz. ʿArfash ʿālam-rā eḥāṭeh namūdeh va nasīmash bar koll morūr kardeh. Ṭūbā li-man intabaha min hādhā al-nasīmi wa-ʿarafa wa-qāma wa-qāla muqbilan ilā al-ufuqi al-aʿlā: Qad kuntu nāʾiman yā ilāhī. Hazzatnī nasamātu ʿināyatika wa-aqāmatnī imāma ufuqi faḍlika. Asʾaluka bi-an tuʾayyidanī ʿalā khidmatika wa-al-istiqāmati ʿalā amrika. Innaka anta al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾu wa-fī qabḍatika zimāmu al-wujūdi mina al-ghaybi wa-al-shuhūd. Yā ʿAlī, leḥāẓ-e ʿināyat beh ū motavajjeh. Bashshirhu bi-mā naṭaqa bihi al-Maẓlūmu fī sijnihi al-ʿaẓīm. Taraqqī az barā-ye vojūd būdeh va hast dar jamīʿ-e ʿavālem. Hādhā ḥaqqun lā rayba fīhi. Al-bahāʾu ʿalayka wa-ʿalayhi wa-ʿalā man tamassaka bi-al-maʿrūfi wa-mā yartafiʿu bihi amru Allāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning Jinab-i Aqa Siyyid Muhammad the physician—upon him be the glory of God—and likewise the particulars of his understanding, intelligence, devotion, accomplishments, and capacity were all presented in His presence at the seat of the Throne, at noon on Sunday in the month of Safar. This is what the Tongue of grandeur spoke. His words—exalted be His majesty: “God willing, may he receive God’s loving care, be illumined by the lights of His knowledge, drink His choice wine, and be nourished from His table. How blessed is this mighty, hallowed Day! Its fragrance has encompassed the world, and its breeze has passed over all. Blessed is the one who has been awakened by this breeze, recognized, arisen, and said, turning toward the most exalted horizon: ‘I was asleep, O my God. The breezes of Your loving care stirred me and raised me up before the horizon of Your grace. I ask You to strengthen me to serve You and to remain steadfast in Your Cause. You are powerful to do whatever You will, and within Your grasp are the reins of existence, both unseen and seen.’ O Ali, the gaze of loving care is directed toward him. Give him the glad tidings of what the Wronged One has spoken in His mighty prison. Progress has ever been and remains possible for existence in all the worlds. This is a truth beyond doubt. Glory be upon you, upon him, and upon whoever holds fast to what is right and to that through which the Cause of God, the Lord of the worlds, is exalted.” End.
:::

### 70

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه جواب سؤال ایشان مختصر از ملکوت اعلی نازل آنمحبوب میدانند که در اینمراتب و مقامات نازل شده آنچه که من علی الأرض را کفایت نماید و این ایّام قلم اعلی یحبّ ان ینطق فیکلّ شأن انّه لا اله الّا هو المهیمن القیّوم از حقّ جلّ جلاله این خادم فانی سائل و آمل که ایشانرا در جمیع احوال مؤیّد فرماید بر آنچه که سبب اعلاء کلمة اللّه است
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn-keh javāb-e suʾāl-e īshān mokhtaṣar az malakūt-e aʿlā nāzel, ān maḥbūb mīdānand keh dar īn marāteb va maqāmāt nāzel shodeh āncheh keh man ʿalā al-arḍ-rā kefāyat namāyad, va īn ayyām qalam-e aʿlā yuḥibbu an yanṭiqa fī kulli shaʾnin: Innahu lā ilāha illā huwa al-muhayminu al-qayyūm. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu īn khādem-e fānī sāʾel va āmel keh īshān-rā dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl moʾayyad farmāyad bar āncheh keh sabab-e eʿlā-ye kalimat Allāh ast.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to the brevity of the answer to his question sent down from the kingdom on high, that beloved friend knows that concerning these matters and stations, enough has been sent down to suffice everyone on earth. In these days, the Most Exalted Pen wishes to proclaim under all circumstances: “There is no god but Him, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.” This transitory servant asks and hopes of God, exalted be His glory, that He may strengthen him under all conditions to do whatever will exalt the Word of God.
:::

### 71

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جنابان آقا خداداد و آقا شاه‌ویردی علیهما بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید فی‌الحقیقه ایشان بعنایت حقّ فائزند بعد از عرض در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی لسان کبریا باین کلمات عالیات ناطق قوله جلّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn-keh dar bāreh-ye jinābān Āqā Khodādād va Āqā Shāh-Vīrdī, ʿalayhimā Bahāʾ Allāh, marqūm dāshtīd, fī al-ḥaqīqeh īshān beh ʿināyat-e Ḥaqq fāʾizand. Baʿd az ʿarḍ dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e aʿlā, lesān-e kebriyā beh īn kalemāt-e ʿāliyāt nāṭeq. Qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
Concerning what you wrote about Aqa Khodadad and Aqa Shah-Virdi—upon them both be the glory of God—they have indeed received God’s loving care. After it was presented in the most inaccessible, most holy, most exalted Court, the Tongue of majesty spoke these lofty words. His words—exalted be His majesty:
:::

### 72

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو الشّاهد السّمیع
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-shāhidu al-samīʿ.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Witness, the All-Hearing.
:::

### 73

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا خداداد قلم اعلی شهادت میدهد بر اینکه هر هنگام ذکرت عرض شد بکلمهٴ الهی و ذکرش فائز شدی از حقّ سائل شو ترا تأیید فرماید بر عرفان اینمقام کریم کبیر از اوّل اقبالت بافق اعلی در هر یوم که ذکرت شده لوحی مخصوص نازل و من غیر آن لحاظ عنایت بتو متوجّه بوده ان اشکر اللّه ربّک و ربّ من فی الأرض و السّمآء الّذی اخذ یدک و انقذک من ظلمات الأرض و ادخلک فیظلّ سدرة عنایته و رفع ذکرک بین عباده المقرّبین فضل و رحمتش لازال سبقت داشته و دارد انّه نجّاک و هداک الی سوآء الصّراط و سقاک خمر الطّهور بید عطائه و جعلک من اهل المقام کن قائماً علی خدمتی و ناطقاً بثنائی و متمسّکاً بفضلی الّذی احاط الآفاق انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Khodādād, qalam-e aʿlā shahādat mīdahad bar īn-keh har hangām dhekrat ʿarḍ shod beh kalemeh-ye ilāhī va dhekrash fāʾiz shodī. Az Ḥaqq sāʾel show to-rā taʾyīd farmāyad bar ʿerfān-e īn maqām-e karīm-e kabīr. Az avval-e eqbālat beh ofoq-e aʿlā dar har yawm keh dhekrat shodeh lowḥī makhṣūṣ nāzel va men gheyr-e ān leḥāẓ-e ʿināyat beh to motavajjeh būdeh. An ishkur Allāha rabbaka wa-rabba man fī al-arḍi wa-al-samāʾ, alladhī akhadha yadaka wa-anqadhaka min ẓulumāti al-arḍi wa-adkhalaka fī ẓilli sidrati ʿināyatihi wa-rafaʿa dhikraka bayna ʿibādihi al-muqarrabīn. Faḍl va raḥmatash lā-zāl sabqat dāshteh va dārad. Innahu najjāka wa-hadāka ilā sawāʾi al-ṣirāṭi wa-saqāka khamra al-ṭuhūri bi-yadi ʿaṭāʾihi wa-jaʿalaka min ahli al-maqām. Kun qāʾiman ʿalā khidmatī wa-nāṭiqan bi-thanāʾī wa-mutamassikan bi-faḍlī alladhī aḥāṭa al-āfāq. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Khodadad, the Most Exalted Pen bears witness that whenever mention of you was presented, you received the divine Word and His remembrance. Ask God to enable you to recognize this noble and great station. From the time you first turned toward the most exalted horizon, a special Tablet has been sent down every day on which you have been mentioned, and beyond this, the gaze of loving care has been directed toward you. Give thanks to God, your Lord and the Lord of all who are on earth and in heaven, who has taken your hand, rescued you from the darkness of the earth, brought you beneath the shade of the Lote Tree of His loving care, and exalted your remembrance among His servants who are near to Him. His grace and mercy have ever taken precedence and continue to do so. He has delivered you, guided you to the straight path, given you pure wine to drink from the hand of His bounty, and made you one of the people of this station. Arise to serve Me, speak My praise, and hold fast to My grace, which has encompassed the horizons. End.
:::

### 74

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و هم‌چنین این آیات مشرقات از سماء مشیّت حقّ جلّ جلاله در بارهٴ جناب حاجی شاه‌ویردی علیه بهآء اللّه نازل قوله جلّت عظمته
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va hamchenīn īn āyāt-e moshreqāt az samā-ye mashiyyat-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu dar bāreh-ye Jināb-e Ḥājī Shāh-Vīrdī, ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh, nāzel. Qawluhu jallat ʿaẓamatuhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
Likewise, these radiant verses were sent down from the heaven of the will of God, exalted be His glory, concerning Jinab-i Haji Shah-Virdi—upon him be the glory of God. His words—exalted be His grandeur:
:::

### 75

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المشفق الکریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-ismī al-mushfiqi al-karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Compassionate, the Generous.
:::

### 76

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا شاهویردی فائز شدی بآنچه که اهل عالم از آن غافل و محجوبند الّا من شآء اللّه سلکت و اقبلت و توجّهت الی ان بلغت الی مطلع الهدایة و سمعت ما تکلّم به لسان اللّه المقتدر العلیم الحکیم کم من ولیّ مات فی حسرة لقائی و کم من حبیب قصد مقامی و کم من امیر ناح فی فراقی و کم من انیس انفق روحه لوصالی و انّک قصدت و عزمت متوکّلاً علی اللّه الی ان حضرت فی ساحة طافه الرّوح الأمین و سمعت من المظلوم ما سمعت اذن المقرّبین ان اشکر اللّه بما ایّدک و قرّبک الی بحر الحیوان و انزل لک ما لا یعادله شیء من الأشیآء و اسمعک ما سمع الکلیم در عنایت حقّ تفکّر نمائید تا شما را از جمیع احزان محدودهٴ دوروزه فارغ و آزاد نماید لایق این فضل توجّه است و لایق توجّه فراغت از احزان البهآء علیک و علی من معک انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Shāh-Vīrdī, fāʾiz shodī beh āncheh keh ahl-e ʿālam az ān ghāfel va maḥjūband, illā man shāʾa Allāh. Salakta wa-aqbalta wa-tawajjahta ilā an balaghta ilā maṭlaʿi al-hidāyati wa-samiʿta mā takallama bihi lisānu Allāhi al-muqtadiri al-ʿalīmi al-ḥakīm. Kam min waliyyin māta fī ḥasrati liqāʾī wa-kam min ḥabībin qaṣada maqāmī wa-kam min amīrin nāḥa fī firāqī wa-kam min anīsin anfaqa rūḥahu li-wiṣālī. Wa-innaka qaṣadta wa-ʿazamta mutawakkilan ʿalā Allāhi ilā an ḥaḍarta fī sāḥatin ṭāfahu al-rūḥu al-amīn, wa-samiʿta mina al-Maẓlūmi mā samiʿat udhunu al-muqarrabīn. An ishkur Allāha bi-mā ayyadaka wa-qarrabaka ilā baḥri al-ḥayawāni wa-anzala laka mā lā yuʿādiluhu shayʾun mina al-ashyāʾi wa-asmaʿaka mā samiʿa al-Kalīm. Dar ʿināyat-e Ḥaqq tafakkor namāyīd tā shomā-rā az jamīʿ-e aḥzān-e maḥdūdeh-ye do-rūzeh fāregh va āzād namāyad. Lāyeq-e īn faḍl tavajjoh ast va lāyeq-e tavajjoh farāghat az aḥzān. Al-bahāʾu ʿalayka wa-ʿalā man maʿak. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Shah-Virdi, you have attained that of which the people of the world are unaware and from which they are veiled, except those whom God wills. You journeyed, turned toward Him, and directed yourself to Him until you reached the Dawning-place of guidance and heard what the Tongue of God, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, spoke. How many a devoted soul died longing to meet Me; how many a loving soul sought My station; how many a prince lamented separation from Me; and how many a companion gave his life to attain union with Me! You set out and resolved, placing your trust in God, until you entered a court around which the faithful Spirit circled, and heard from the Wronged One what the ears of those brought near have heard. Give thanks to God for strengthening you, bringing you near to the ocean of life, sending down for you that which nothing can equal, and causing you to hear what Moses heard. Reflect upon God’s loving care, that it may free and release you from all the circumscribed sorrows of these fleeting days. This grace calls for turning toward Him, and turning toward Him calls for freedom from sorrows. Glory be upon you and upon those who are with you. End.
:::

### 77

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این خادم فانی لازال از برای جنابان که از قلم اعلی بابناء خلیل و ورّاث کلیم نامیده شده‌اند خیر و برکت و عنایت و استقامت و فضل و ذکر جاودانی طلب نموده و مینماید و البتّه وقتی مقرون باجابت گردد چه که بشهادت قلم اعلی و شهادت آنمحبوب اکثری اوقات را در خدمت امر مصروف داشته و دارند چنین نفوسرا همهٴ عالم ذاکر شده و خواهند شد این اشیاء متفرّقه و الوان مختلفه عنقریب معدوم و ما عند اللّه لیبقی طوبی لهم فی‌الحقیقه مؤیّدند از جمله تأیید آنکه آنمحبوب از ایشان اظهار رضایت نموده‌اند انشآءاللّه لازال موفّق باشند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn khādem-e fānī lā-zāl az barā-ye jinābān keh az qalam-e aʿlā beh abnā-ye Khalīl va vorrāth-e Kalīm nāmīdeh shodeh-and kheyr va barakat va ʿināyat va esteqāmat va faḍl va dhekr-e jāvedānī ṭalab namūdeh va mīnamāyad va albatteh vaqtī maqrūn beh ejābat gardad, cheh keh beh shahādat-e qalam-e aʿlā va shahādat-e ān maḥbūb aktharī-ye owqāt-rā dar khedmat-e Amr maṣrūf dāshteh va dārand. Chonīn nofūs-rā hameh-ye ʿālam dhāker shodeh va khvāhand shod. Īn ashyā-ye motefarreqeh va alvān-e mokhtalefeh ʿan-qarīb maʿdūm, wa-mā ʿinda Allāhi la-yabqā. Ṭūbā lahum. Fī al-ḥaqīqeh moʾayyadand. Az jomleh-ye taʾyīd ān-keh ān maḥbūb az īshān eẓhār-e riḍāyat namūdeh-and. In shāʾ Allāh lā-zāl movaffaq bāshand.
:::

::: {.translation}
This transitory servant has always sought, and continues to seek, goodness, blessing, loving care, steadfastness, grace, and everlasting remembrance for these two gentlemen, whom the Most Exalted Pen has named the sons of Abraham and the heirs of Moses. Surely, at some time this prayer will be answered, for, as the Most Exalted Pen and that beloved friend testify, they have devoted and continue to devote most of their time to serving the Cause. The whole world has remembered and will remember such souls. These scattered things and varied colors will soon pass away, but what is with God will surely endure. Blessed are they! They are indeed divinely assisted. Among the signs of this assistance is that that beloved friend has expressed satisfaction with them. God willing, may they always be aided to succeed.
:::

### 78

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه جناب آقا خداداد علیه ٦٦٩ \[بهآء اللّه\] فرموده‌اند قریب یک سنه میشود آنچه ارسال نموده‌اند جواب از این عبد نرفته الأمر کما قال ولکن این عبد نظر باطمینان از ایشان و هم‌چنین نظر بآنکه در اکثر از الواح ذکرشان از قلم اعلی جاری این عبد در جواب مراسلات بعضی که تازه بشریعه اقبال نموده‌اند مشغول و خود ایشان نظر بخدمت و استقامتیکه در امر دارند البتّه راضیند بآنچه واقعشده حقّ تعالی شأنه شاهد و گواهست که لازال ذکرشان و قیامشان و خدمتشان نصب عین بوده و هست و امید است از فضل الهی جوابهم ارسال شود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn-keh Jināb-e Āqā Khodādād, ʿalayhi 669 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\], farmūdeh-and qarīb-e yek saneh mīshavad āncheh ersāl namūdeh-and javāb az īn ʿabd narafteh, al-amru kamā qāl. Va-līkin īn ʿabd naẓar beh eṭmīnān az īshān va hamchenīn naẓar beh ān-keh dar akthar az alvāḥ dhekrashān az qalam-e aʿlā jārī, īn ʿabd dar javāb-e morāsalāt-e baʿḍī keh tāzeh beh sharīʿeh eqbāl namūdeh-and mashghūl, va khod-e īshān naẓar beh khedmat va esteqāmatī keh dar Amr dārand albatteh rāḍī-and beh āncheh vāqeʿ shodeh. Ḥaqq taʿālā shaʾnuhu shāhed va govāh ast keh lā-zāl dhekrashān va qiyāmashān va khedmatashān naṣb-e ʿayn būdeh va hast va omīd ast az faḍl-e ilāhī javāb ham ersāl shavad.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to Jinab-i Aqa Khodadad’s statement—upon him be 669 \[the glory of God\]—that nearly a year has passed without this servant sending a reply to what he has sent, the matter is as he has said. However, because of my confidence in him, and because mention of him flows from the Most Exalted Pen in most of the Tablets, this servant has been occupied with answering the letters of some who have newly turned toward the water’s edge. In view of his service and steadfastness in the Cause, he himself is surely content with what has occurred. God, exalted be His station, bears witness that the remembrance of him, his efforts, and his service have always been and remain before my eyes. It is hoped that, through divine grace, a reply will also be sent.
:::

### 79

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا محمّد و آقا علی اصغر علیهما بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتند الحمد للّه ایشان بذکر الهی از قبل و بعد فائز شده‌اند قد نزّل ذکرهما من سمآء عنایة ربّنا و ربّکم و محبوبنا و محبوبکم و رقما من القلم الأعلی هذا من فضل مقصودنا و مقصودکم این کلمات عالیات در اینمقام از لسان مالک وری جاری و نازل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāre-ye Janāb-i Āqā Muḥammad va Āqā ʿAlī-Aṣghar, ʿalayhimā bahāʾuʾllāh, marqūm dāshtand, al-ḥamdu li-llāh, īshān be-dhekr-e ilāhī az qabl va baʿd fāʾez shode-and. Qad nuzzila dhikruhumā min samāʾi ʿināyati rabbinā va rabbikum va maḥbūbinā va maḥbūbikum va ruqimā minaʾl-qalamiʾl-aʿlā. Hādhā min faḍli maqṣūdinā va maqṣūdikum. Īn kalemāt-e ʿāliyāt dar īn maqām az lesān-e Mālek-e varā jārī va nāzel.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to what was written concerning Jinab-i Aqa Muhammad and Aqa ʿAli-Asghar—upon them both be the glory of God—praise be to God, they have been favored with divine remembrance both before and since. Their remembrance has indeed been sent down from the heaven of the loving care of our Lord and your Lord, our Beloved and your Beloved, and they have been inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen. This is through the grace of the One we seek and you seek. At this point these exalted words flowed from the tongue of the Sovereign of all creation and were revealed:
:::

### 80

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قوله جلّ و عزّ یا محمّد طوبی لک بما وفیت بعهدک و طوبی لمن عمل فیه ما کان مقبولاً لدی العرش قد زیّن عملک بطراز القبول فی هذا المقام العزیز المحمود ان اشکر اللّه بهذا الفضل و قل لک الحمد یا مالک الغیب و الشّهود و نذکر علی قبل اصغر و نکبّر علیه و نبشّره برحمتی التّی سبقته طوبی له بما فاز بذکری من قبل و من بعد و شرب رحیقی المختوم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qawluhu jalla va ʿazza: Yā Muḥammad, ṭūbā laka bimā wafayta bi-ʿahdika va ṭūbā li-man ʿamila fīhi mā kāna maqbūlan ladāʾl-ʿarsh. Qad zuyyina ʿamaluka bi-ṭirāziʾl-qabūli fī hādhāʾl-maqāmiʾl-ʿazīziʾl-maḥmūd. Aniʾshkuriʾllāha bi-hādhāʾl-faḍli va qul: Lakaʾl-ḥamdu yā Mālikaʾl-ghaybi vaʾl-shuhūd. Va nadhkuru ʿAlī qabla Aṣghar va nukabbiru ʿalayhi va nubashshiruhu bi-raḥmatiyaʾllatī sabaqat-hu. Ṭūbā lahu bimā fāza bi-dhikrī min qablu va min baʿdu va shariba raḥīqiyaʾl-makhtūm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
His words, glorified and exalted is He: “O Muhammad! Blessed are you for having fulfilled your covenant, and blessed is whoever has done within it what was acceptable before the Throne. Your deed has been adorned with the ornament of acceptance in this mighty and praiseworthy station. Give thanks to God for this favor and say: ‘Praise be to You, O Sovereign of the unseen and the seen!’ We also remember ʿAli before Asghar, convey Our greetings to him, and give him the glad tidings of My mercy, which has preceded him. Blessed is he for having attained My remembrance before and since, and for having drunk My sealed wine.” End of quotation.
:::

### 81

::: {.original lang="ar"}
عمل آن حضرت بسیار مقبول افتاد و عمل جناب آقا محمّد هم بطراز قبول فائز قد شهد بذلک آیات اللّه ربّنا و ربّ العالمین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
ʿAmal-e ān ḥaḍrat besyār maqbūl oftād va ʿamal-e Janāb-i Āqā Muḥammad ham be-ṭarāz-e qabūl fāʾez. Qad shahidat bi-dhālika āyātuʾllāhi rabbinā va rabbiʾl-ʿālamīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
That gentleman’s deed was most acceptable, and the deed of Jinab-i Aqa Muhammad was also favored with the ornament of acceptance. The verses of God, our Lord and the Lord of the worlds, have indeed borne witness to this.
:::

### 82

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا میرزا محمّد علی و اهل ایشان علیهما بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید بعد از عرض در ساحت اقدس امواج بحر بیان الهی بصورت این کلمات باهرات ظاهر و لائح قال جلّت عظمته
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke dar bāre-ye Janāb-i Āqā Mīrzā Muḥammad-ʿAlī va ahl-e īshān, ʿalayhimā bahāʾuʾllāh, marqūm dāshtīd, baʿd az ʿarḍ dar sāḥat-e aqdas, amvāj-e baḥr-e bayān-e ilāhī be-ṣūrat-e īn kalemāt-e bāherāt ẓāher va lāʾeḥ. Qāla jallat ʿaẓamatuhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
Concerning what you wrote about Jinab-i Aqa Mirza Muhammad-ʿAli and his wife—upon them both be the glory of God—after it was presented at the Most Holy Court, the waves of the ocean of divine utterance appeared and shone forth in the form of these radiant words. He said, exalted is His grandeur:
:::

### 83

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی العزیز العظیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-ʿAzīzi al-ʿAẓīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Almighty, the Magnificent.
:::

### 84

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا محمّد قبل علی قد سمعنا ذکرک فی کتاب من احبّنی و احبّه اللّه و انزلنا لک آیات لا تعادلها ما فی خزائن الملوک طوبی لمن فاز الیوم بعرفان اللّه الّذی اذا ظهر نطقت الأشیآء قد اتی الوعد و هذا هو الموعود انّا اظهرنا الأمر و انزلنا الآیات و دعونا الکلّ الی اللّه المهیمن القیّوم من النّاس من نبذ الهدی و اخذ الهوی بما اتّبع کلّ غافل محجوب قد ورد علی المظلوم فی سبیل اللّه ما ناح به الملأ الأعلی و سکّان مدائن الأسمآء ولکنّ القوم اکثرهم لا یفقهون فیکلّ الأحوال قمنا علی الأمر علی شأن ما منعتنا مدافع العالم و لا صفوف الجنود و اوّل من اعترض علینا علمآء الأرض قد نقضوا میثاق اللّه و عهده و قاموا علینا کما قاموا من قبل علی محمّد رسول اللّه و من قبله علی الرّوح ینادیهم المیزان و هم لا یسمعون و ینذرهم الصّراط و هم لا یشعرون قد تمسّکوا بالظّنون و الأوهام معرضین عن انوار الیقین کذلک یقصّ لک قلمی الأعلی فی هذا السّجن الممنوع ان احفظ آیاتی ثمّ اقرأها بربوات اهل البهآء هذا ما یأمرک من عنده کتاب محفوظ البهآء علیک و علی ضلعک الّتی فازت برحیق محبّة ربّها العزیز الودود انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Muḥammad qabla ʿAlī, qad samiʿnā dhikraka fī kitābi man aḥabbanī va aḥabbahuʾllāh, va anzalnā laka āyātin lā tuʿādiluhā mā fī khazāʾiniʾl-mulūk. Ṭūbā li-man fāzaʾl-yawma bi-ʿirfāniʾllāhiʾlladhī idhā ẓahara naṭaqatiʾl-ashyāʾu: Qad atāʾl-waʿdu va hādhā huwaʾl-mawʿūd. Innā aẓharnāʾl-amra va anzalnāʾl-āyāti va daʿawnāʾl-kulla ilāʾllāhiʾl-muhayminiʾl-qayyūm. Minaʾl-nāsi man nabadhaʾl-hudā va akhadhaʾl-hawā bimāʾttabaʿa kulla ghāfilin maḥjūb. Qad warada ʿalāʾl-maẓlūmi fī sabīliʾllāhi mā nāḥa bihiʾl-malaʾuʾl-aʿlā va sukkānu madāʾiniʾl-asmāʾ, va lākinnaʾl-qawma aktharuhum lā yafqahūn. Fī kulliʾl-aḥwāli qumnā ʿalāʾl-amri ʿalā shaʾnin mā manaʿatnā madāfiʿuʾl-ʿālami va lā ṣufūfuʾl-junūd. Va awwalu man iʿtaraḍa ʿalaynā ʿulamāʾuʾl-arḍ. Qad naqaḍū mīthāqaʾllāhi va ʿahdahu va qāmū ʿalaynā kamā qāmū min qablu ʿalā Muḥammadin rasūliʾllāhi va min qablihi ʿalāʾl-Rūḥ. Yunādīhimuʾl-mīzānu va hum lā yasmaʿūn, va yundhiruhumuʾl-ṣirāṭu va hum lā yashʿurūn. Qad tamassakū biʾl-ẓunūni vaʾl-awhāmi muʿriḍīna ʿan anwāriʾl-yaqīn. Kadhālika yaquṣṣu laka qalamī al-aʿlā fī hādhāʾl-sijniʾl-mamnūʿ. Aniʾḥfaẓ āyātī thummaʾqraʾhā bi-rabawāti ahliʾl-bahāʾ. Hādhā mā yaʾmuruka man ʿindahu kitābun maḥfūẓ. Al-bahāʾu ʿalayka va ʿalā ḍilʿikaʾllatī fāzat bi-raḥīqi maḥabbati rabbihāʾl-ʿazīziʾl-wadūd. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Muhammad before ʿAli! We have heard mention of you in a letter from one who has loved Me and whom God has loved, and We have sent down for you verses that nothing in the treasuries of kings can equal. Blessed is whoever has attained today the recognition of God, at whose appearance all things declared: “The promise has come, and this is the Promised One!” We have indeed manifested the Cause, sent down the verses, and summoned everyone to God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Among the people are those who have cast aside guidance and embraced desire because they have followed every heedless and veiled soul. In the path of God, the Wronged One has suffered what has caused the Concourse on high and the inhabitants of the cities of names to lament; yet most of the people do not understand. Under all circumstances We arose to uphold the Cause in such a way that neither the cannons of the world nor the ranks of armies could hinder Us. The first to oppose Us were the religious scholars of the earth. They broke God’s covenant and His pledge and rose against Us, just as they had previously risen against Muhammad, the Messenger of God, and, before Him, against the Spirit. The Balance calls to them, but they do not hear; the Path warns them, but they do not perceive. They have clung to conjectures and illusions, turning away from the lights of certainty. Thus does My Most Exalted Pen recount to you in this inaccessible prison. Preserve My verses, then recite them upon the heights among the people of Baha. This is what He with whom is a preserved Book commands you. Glory be upon you and upon your wife, who has attained the choice wine of the love of her Lord, the Almighty, the All-Loving. End of quotation.
:::

### 85

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا محبوب فؤادی حسب الأمر این آیات عظیمهٴ منیعه را بر ایشان القا نمائید و از قبل حقّ تکبیر برسانید شاید از نفحات بیان سلطان امکان بفرح حقیقی فائز شوند و از فزع اکبر محفوظ مانند اینعبد هم خدمت ایشان تکبیر و سلام عرض مینماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā maḥbūb-e foʾādī, ḥasb-e amr īn āyāt-e ʿaẓīme-ye manīʿe rā bar īshān elqā namāʾīd va az qebal-e Ḥaqq takbīr beresānīd. Shāyad az nafaḥāt-e bayān-e Solṭān-e emkān be-faraḥ-e ḥaqīqī fāʾez shavand va az fazaʿ-e akbar maḥfūẓ mānand. Īn ʿabd ham khedmat-e īshān takbīr va salām ʿarḍ mīnamāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
O beloved of my heart! In accordance with the command, convey these mighty and exalted verses to them and deliver greetings on behalf of God, that through the breezes of the utterance of the Sovereign of all existence they may attain true joy and remain safe from the most great terror. This servant also offers them greetings and peace.
:::

### 86

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ذکر جناب آقا سیّد علی علیه بهآء اللّه از اهل خا فرموده بودند و هم‌چنین ذکر اشتعالشان را بنار محبّت الهی بعد از حضور و اذن و عرض آفتاب عنایت بصورت اینکلمات عالیات تجلّی فرمود قوله جلّ اجلاله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhekr-e Janāb-i Āqā Siyyid ʿAlī, ʿalayhi bahāʾuʾllāh, az ahl-e Khā farmūde būdand va hamchenīn dhekr-e eshteʿāl-e shān rā be-nār-e maḥabbat-e ilāhī. Baʿd az ḥoḍūr va edhn va ʿarḍ, āftāb-e ʿenāyat be-ṣūrat-e īn kalemāt-e ʿāliyāt tajallī farmūd. Qawluhu jalla ijlāluhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
Mention had been made of Jinab-i Aqa Siyyid ʿAli—upon him be the glory of God—of Kha, and likewise of his being aflame with the fire of divine love. After entering the Presence, obtaining permission, and presenting the matter, the sun of loving care shone forth in the form of these exalted words. His words, exalted is His majesty:
:::

### 87

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی النّاطق من افق الملکوت
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-nāṭiqi min ufuqiʾl-malakūt.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, speaking from the horizon of the Kingdom.
:::

### 88

::: {.original lang="ar"}
کتاب انزله المظلوم لمن اقبل الی اللّه فی یوم بشّر به رسل اللّه من قبل و کلّ کتاب منزول یا علی فاذکر ما اقامک علی هذا الأمر و ما ایقظک فی هذا الیوم و من اسمعک ندآء المظلوم الّذی رأی فی سبیل اللّه ما ناح به المقرّبون و من اخبرک بهذا المسجون و من حدّثک هذا الأمر الّذی به ارتفع حفیف سدرة المنتهی و انار الأفق الأعلی و نطقت الأشیآء فیملکوت الانشآء قد اتی من کان مستوراً فی علم اللّه و مسطوراً من قلم الأمر فی کتابه المختوم طوبی لک بما سمعت و عرفت و اقبلت الی من اتی من سمآء الأمر بسلطان مشهود دع النّاس بأهوائهم و تشبّث بذیل عنایة ربّک مالک الوجود انّا نوصیک و الّذین آمنوا بما یفرح به قلب المظلوم و یرتفع امر اللّه العزیز الودود انّه لو یجد عرف اخلاقه و ما امر به عباده فی کتابه لیفرح کذلک نطق لسان البیان فی ملکوت العرفان فضلاً من عنده و هو الحقّ علّام الغیوب البهآء علیک و علی من اشتعل بنار محبّة اللّه فی ایّامه و علی کلّ قائم نبذ القعود فیهذا الیوم الموعود ثمّ الذّکر و البهآء علی من انتبه من نسمات الوحی التّی تمرّ من شطر سجنی العزیز المحبوب انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Kitābun anzalahuʾl-maẓlūmu li-man aqbala ilāʾllāhi fī yawmin bashshara bihi rusuluʾllāhi min qablu va kullu kitābin munzūl. Yā ʿAlī, faʾdhkur mā aqāmaka ʿalā hādhāʾl-amri va mā ayqaẓaka fī hādhāʾl-yawmi va man asmaʿaka nidāʾaʾl-maẓlūmiʾlladhī raʾā fī sabīliʾllāhi mā nāḥa bihiʾl-muqarrabūn, va man akhbaraka bi-hādhāʾl-masjūni va man ḥaddathaka hādhāʾl-amraʾlladhī bihiʾrtafaʿa ḥafīfu sidratiʾl-muntahā va anāraʾl-ufuquʾl-aʿlā va naṭaqatiʾl-ashyāʾu fī malakūtiʾl-inshāʾ. Qad atā man kāna mastūran fī ʿilmiʾllāhi va masṭūran min qalamiʾl-amri fī kitābihiʾl-makhtūm. Ṭūbā laka bimā samiʿta va ʿarafta va aqbalta ilā man atā min samāʾiʾl-amri bi-sulṭānin mashhūd. Daʿiʾl-nāsa bi-ahwāʾihim va tashabbath bi-dhayli ʿināyati rabbika mālikiʾl-wujūd. Innā nūṣīka vaʾlladhīna āmanū bimā yafraḥu bihi qalbuʾl-maẓlūmi va yartafiʿu amruʾllāhiʾl-ʿazīziʾl-wadūd. Innahu law yajidu ʿarfa akhlāqihi va mā amara bihi ʿibādahu fī kitābihi la-yafraḥ. Kadhālika naṭaqa lisānuʾl-bayāni fī malakūtiʾl-ʿirfāni faḍlan min ʿindihi va huwaʾl-ḥaqqu ʿallāmuʾl-ghuyūb. Al-bahāʾu ʿalayka va ʿalā man ishtaʿala bi-nāri maḥabbatiʾllāhi fī ayyāmihi va ʿalā kulli qāʾimin nabadhaʾl-quʿūda fī hādhāʾl-yawmiʾl-mawʿūd. Thummaʾl-dhikru vaʾl-bahāʾu ʿalā man intabaha min nasamātiʾl-waḥyiʾllatī tamurru min shaṭri sijnī al-ʿazīziʾl-maḥbūb. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
A Tablet that the Wronged One has sent down for one who has turned toward God on a Day whose glad tidings were proclaimed beforehand by the Messengers of God and every revealed Book. O ʿAli! Call to mind what raised you up to uphold this Cause, what awakened you on this Day, and who caused you to hear the call of the Wronged One, who has witnessed in the path of God what has made those brought near to Him lament. Who informed you of this Prisoner, and who told you of this Cause, through which the rustling of the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary rose, the most exalted horizon shone, and all things spoke in the kingdom of creation? He has come who was concealed in the knowledge of God and inscribed by the Pen of the Cause in His sealed Book. Blessed are you for having heard, recognized, and turned toward Him who has come from the heaven of the Cause with manifest sovereignty. Leave the people to their desires and cling to the hem of the loving care of your Lord, the Sovereign of existence. We exhort you and those who have believed to do what will gladden the heart of the Wronged One and exalt the Cause of God, the Almighty, the All-Loving. Should He perceive the fragrance of His own character and of what He has commanded His servants in His Book, He will indeed rejoice. Thus has the Tongue of Utterance spoken in the kingdom of recognition, as a grace from Him. He is the Truth, the Knower of all hidden things. Glory be upon you, upon whoever has been set ablaze with the fire of the love of God in His days, and upon everyone who has arisen and cast aside inaction on this promised Day. Remembrance and glory also be upon whoever has awakened through the breezes of revelation that pass from the direction of My mighty and beloved prison. End of quotation.
:::

### 89

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در اینحین مبارک بشأنی آیات نازل و بیّنات باهر که فی‌الحقیقه صدهزار مثل این عبد از ذکر و وصف و تحریر و تقریرش عاجز و قاصر العظمة للّه ربّنا و ربّکم و مقصودنا و مقصودکم و مقصود من فی الملک و الجبروت نمیدانم این خلقرا چه سکری اخذ نموده امّت قبل استدلال مینمودند که چند فقره در کتاب نازل که حقّ جلّ جلاله از امور بعد خبر داده و این امور واقع گشته و نظر بوقوع آن او را از حجّت و برهان میشمردند و حال آن جناب و جمیع دوستان شاهد و گواهند که اموراتیکه هیچ عاقلی تصوّر آن نمینمود از قلم اعلی بکمال تصریح نازل و جمیع واحداً بعد واحد از قوّه بفعل آمد و از باطن بظاهر جلوه نمود بلکه آنچه از بعد ظاهر شده و یا بشود واحداً بعد واحد ذکرش در کتاب نازل و در ظاهر ظاهر مشاهده شد اینفقره هم محدود نبوده چه که از یک و دو و سه و فوق آن و فوق فوق آن ظاهر و باهر مع‌ذلک کلّ غافل نائم میّت الّا من حفظته ید الفضل آیا احدی میتواند بگوید در هیچ ظهوری آیاتش اکمل و یا بیّناتش اظهر و یا سدرهٴ حجّت اثمر از این سدرهٴ مبارکهٴ باسقه بوده لا وربّی مگر بالمرّه از انصاف عاری باشد این خادم آنچه عرض نموده و یا مینماید در پرده بوده و هست چه که اذن بر عرایض بعضی از امور نداشته و ندارد ختم اللّه علی فمه الأمر بیده یفعل و یحکم کیف یشآء و هو المقتدر المختار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar īn ḥīn-e mobārak be-shaʾnī āyāt nāzel va bayyenāt bāher ke fīʾl-ḥaqīqe ṣad hezār methl-e īn ʿabd az dhekr va vaṣf va taḥrīr va taqrīr-ash ʿājez va qāṣer. Al-ʿaẓamatu li-llāhi rabbinā va rabbikum va maqṣūdinā va maqṣūdikum va maqṣūdi man fīʾl-mulki vaʾl-jabarūt. Nemīdānam īn khalq rā che sokrī akhdh namūde. Ommat-e qabl estedlāl mīnamūdand ke chand feqre dar ketāb nāzel ke Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu az omūr-e baʿd khabar dāde va īn omūr vāqeʿ gashte va naẓar be-voqūʿ-e ān ū rā az ḥojjat va borhān mīshomordand. Va ḥāl ān janāb va jamīʿ-e dūstān shāhed va govāhand ke omūrātī ke hīch ʿāqelī taṣavvor-e ān nemīnamūd az Qalam-e Aʿlā be-kamāl-e taṣrīḥ nāzel va jamīʿ vāḥedan baʿd-e vāḥed az qovve be-feʿl āmad va az bāṭen be-ẓāher jelve namūd. Balke ānche az baʿd ẓāher shode va yā beshavad vāḥedan baʿd-e vāḥed dhekr-ash dar ketāb nāzel va dar ẓāher ẓāher moshāhede shod. Īn feqre ham maḥdūd nabūde che ke az yek va do va se va fowq-e ān va fowq-e fowq-e ān ẓāher va bāher. Maʿa dhālek koll ghāfel, nāʾem, mayyet, illā man ḥafiẓat-hu yaduʾl-faḍl. Āyā aḥadī mītavānad begūyad dar hīch ẓohūrī āyāt-ash akmal va yā bayyenāt-ash aẓhar va yā sedre-ye ḥojjat athmar az īn sedre-ye mobārake-ye bāseqe būde? Lā va rabbī, magar beʾl-marre az enṣāf ʿārī bāshad. Īn khādem ānche ʿarḍ namūde va yā mīnamāyad dar parde būde va hast, che ke edhn bar ʿarāyeḍ-e baʿḍī az omūr nadāshte va nadārad. Khatamaʾllāhu ʿalā famihi. Al-amru bi-yadihi yafʿalu va yaḥkumu kayfa yashāʾu va huwaʾl-muqtadiruʾl-mukhtār.
:::

::: {.translation}
At this blessed time, verses are being revealed and clear proofs are shining forth to such a degree that a hundred thousand like this servant would truly be powerless and unable to recount, describe, record, or explain them. Grandeur belongs to God, our Lord and your Lord, the One we seek and you seek, and the One sought by all who dwell in the earthly world and the realm of power. I do not know what intoxication has seized these people. The former community used to argue that a few passages had been revealed in the Book in which God, exalted be His glory, foretold future events, and that these events had taken place; because they had occurred, they counted this as evidence and proof. Now you and all the friends bear witness that events no rational person could have imagined were revealed with complete explicitness by the Most Exalted Pen, and all, one after another, passed from potentiality into actuality and emerged from concealment into manifestation. Indeed, whatever has since appeared or may yet appear has, one after another, been mentioned in the Book and has been visibly witnessed in the outward world. Nor has this been limited, for not one, two, or three instances, but more than these and far more still, have become manifest and evident. Nevertheless, all are heedless, asleep, and dead, except those whom the hand of grace has protected. Can anyone say that in any revelation its verses have been more perfect, its clear proofs more evident, or its tree of proof more fruitful than this blessed, towering Tree? No, by my Lord—not unless he is utterly devoid of fairness. Whatever this servant has submitted or submits has been and remains veiled, for he has not had, and does not have, permission to report certain matters. God has sealed his mouth. The command is in His hand; He acts and decrees as He wills, and He is the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.
:::

### 90

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ذکر مخدوم معظّم حضرت زین ب ر الّذی هاجر الی اللّه و فاز فی ارض السّرّ فرمودید انشآءاللّه در جمیع احوال بعنایات مخصوصهٴ حقّ و فیوضاتش فائز باشند لازال امام عین بوده و هستند هیچوقت فراموش نشده و نخواهند شد انشآءاللّه در جمیع قرون و اعصار باسم حقّ و خدمت حقّ مذکور باشند بعض احیان مخصوص ذکرشان از لسان مالک قدم جاری یا محبوب فؤادی از جمیع مراتب گذشته شجر وفا شجر مبارکیست اثمارش محبوب و آثار و اسرارش باقی و دائم اگر خوب ملاحظه شود اوست قائد جنود حبّ و اوست پیشرو اهل ودّ و راستی از صمیم قلب خدمت ایشان تکبیر و سلام عرض مینمایم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhekr-e makhdūm-e moʿaẓẓam Ḥaḍrat-e Zayn bā rā, alladhī hājara ilāʾllāhi va fāza fī arḍiʾl-sirr, farmūdīd. In shāʾaʾllāh dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl be-ʿenāyāt-e makhṣūṣe-ye Ḥaqq va foyūḍāt-ash fāʾez bāshand. Lā zāl emām-e ʿayn būde va hastand. Hīch vaqt farāmūsh nashode va nakhāhand shod. In shāʾaʾllāh dar jamīʿ-e qorūn va aʿṣār be-nām-e Ḥaqq va khedmat-e Ḥaqq madhkūr bāshand. Baʿḍ-e aḥyān makhṣūṣ dhekr-e shān az lesān-e Mālek-e qedam jārī. Yā maḥbūb-e foʾādī, az jamīʿ-e marāteb godhashte, shajar-e vafā shajar-e mobārakīst. Athmār-ash maḥbūb va āthār va asrār-ash bāqī va dāʾem. Agar khūb molāḥeẓe shavad, ūst qāʾed-e jonūd-e ḥobb va ūst pīshrow-e ahl-e vodd va rāstī. Az ṣamīm-e qalb khedmat-e īshān takbīr va salām ʿarḍ mīnamāyam.
:::

::: {.translation}
You mentioned the honored gentleman, his honor Zayn B. R., who migrated toward God and attained His presence in the Land of Mystery. God willing, may he under all circumstances receive God’s special favors and outpourings of grace. He has always been and remains before our eyes. He has never been forgotten and never will be. God willing, may he be remembered throughout all centuries and ages in association with God’s name and service to Him. At times, mention of him in particular flows from the tongue of the Sovereign of Eternity. O beloved of my heart! Beyond all other considerations, the tree of faithfulness is a blessed tree. Its fruits are cherished, and its effects and mysteries are lasting and enduring. If one considers carefully, it is the commander of the hosts of love and the leader of the people of affection and truthfulness. From the depths of my heart I offer him greetings and peace.
:::

### 91

::: {.original lang="fa"}
عریضهٴ ایشان خدمت حضرت غصن اللّه الأعظم روحی و ذاتی و کینونتی لتراب قدومه الفدآء رسید و انشآءاللّه جواب عنایت میفرمایند اینکه در بعض امور توقّف رفته نظر بحکمت است ایّام ایّامیست که اگر امتیاز ظاهر شود بسا میشود سبب ضرّ گردد یعنی از برای نفس ممتازه اعدا نظر بآنکه حال بیقین مبین دانسته‌اند که حقّ جلّ جلاله فتنه و فساد و اذیّت و قتل را منع فرموده‌اند لذا در بعض امور فی‌الجمله متوقّفند ولکن در سرّ سرّ مترصّد اگر فی‌الحقیقه نفسیرا منشأ اثر کلّی در آنجهات بدانند بتشبّثات مختلفه تقصیری بر حسب ظاهر اثبات مینمایند مانند تقصیریکه آن طیر ظالم از برای کبک بیچاره ثابت نمود و او را درید مقصود اینفانی آنکه باینجهات بعض اوامر الهیّه متوقّف
:::

::: {.transliteration}
ʿArīḍe-ye īshān khedmat-e Ḥaḍrat-e Ghoṣnuʾllāhiʾl-Aʿẓam, rūḥī va dhātī va kaynūnatī li-turābi qudūmihiʾl-fidāʾ, resīd va in shāʾaʾllāh javāb ʿenāyat mīfarmāyand. Īnke dar baʿḍ-e omūr tavaqqof rafte naẓar be-ḥekmat ast. Ayyām ayyāmīst ke agar emtīāz ẓāher shavad basā mīshavad sabab-e ḍorr gardad, yaʿnī az barā-ye nafs-e momtāze. Aʿdā naẓar be-ānke ḥāl be-yaqīn-e mobīn dāneste-and ke Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu fetne va fasād va adhiyyat va qatl rā manʿ farmūde-and, ledhā dar baʿḍ-e omūr fīʾl-jomle motavaqqef-and, va lāken dar serr-e serr motaraṣṣed. Agar fīʾl-ḥaqīqe nafsī rā manshaʾ-e athar-e kollī dar ān jahāt bedānand, be-tashabbothāt-e mokhtalefe taqṣīrī bar ḥasab-e ẓāher ethbāt mīnamāyand, mānand-e taqṣīrī ke ān ṭayr-e ẓālem az barā-ye kabk-e bīchāre thābet namūd va ū rā darīd. Maqṣūd-e īn fānī ānke be-īn jahāt baʿḍ-e avāmer-e ilāhiyye motavaqqef.
:::

::: {.translation}
His letter reached His Holiness the Most Great Branch of God—may my spirit, my self, and my being be sacrificed for the dust beneath His feet—and, God willing, He will graciously provide a reply. The delay in certain matters is out of wisdom. These are days when, if distinction becomes apparent, it may well cause harm—that is, to the distinguished person. Since the enemies now know with clear certainty that God, exalted be His glory, has forbidden sedition, disorder, harassment, and killing, they are somewhat restrained in certain matters; in the utmost secrecy, however, they lie in wait. If they truly recognize someone as a source of substantial influence in those regions, they resort to various devices to establish some outward fault against that person, like the fault that the cruel bird established against the helpless partridge before tearing it apart. What this transitory servant means is that, for these reasons, certain divine directives are being held in abeyance.
:::

### 92

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه در بارهٴ امة‌اللّه هدهد علیها بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید وقتی از اوقات مخصوص این فانی مجدّد ذکر ایشانرا نموده و بطراز عنایت حقّ جلّ جلاله فائز شدند و لسان عظمت باینکلمهٴ علیا ناطق قوله تعالی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke dar bāre-ye Amatuʾllāh Hudhud, ʿalayhā bahāʾuʾllāh, marqūm dāshtīd, vaqtī az avqāt makhṣūṣ īn fānī mojaddad dhekr-e īshān rā namūde va be-ṭarāz-e ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu fāʾez shodand va lesān-e ʿaẓamat be-īn kaleme-ye ʿolyā nāṭeq. Qawluhu taʿālā:
:::

::: {.translation}
Concerning what you wrote about the handmaid of God, Hudhud—upon her be the glory of God—on one occasion this transitory servant again made particular mention of her, and she was favored with the ornament of the loving care of God, exalted be His glory. The Tongue of Grandeur spoke these exalted words. His words, exalted is He:
:::

### 93

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ایّها النّاظر الی وجهی و القائم علی خدمة امری بشّرها من قبلی و کبّر علیها امراً من لدن ربّک المشفق الکریم انّا ذکرناها من قبل و بنت اسمی الأصدق الّذی اقبل و توجّه الی شطر اللّه امراً من عنده الی ان دخل السّجن و قام لدی الباب و سمع ندآء اللّه المقتدر العزیز الوهّاب انّا نکبّر علیها و علی امّها و علی امائی اللّائی اقبلن الی اللّه مالک الرّقاب و نوصیهنّ بالعمل الخالص و ما ینبغی لأیّام اللّه ربّ الأرباب کذلک ماج بحر البیان اذ یمشی الرّحمن فی اعلی المقام انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ayyuhā al-nāẓiru ilā wajhī wa-al-qāʾimu ʿalā khidmati amrī, bashshirhā min qibalī wa-kabbir ʿalayhā amran min ladun rabbika al-mushfiqi al-karīm. Innā dhakarnāhā min qablu wa-binta ismī al-Aṣdaq alladhī aqbala wa-tawajjaha ilā shaṭri Allāhi amran min ʿindihi ilā an dakhala al-sijna wa-qāma ladā al-bābi wa-samiʿa nidāʾa Allāhi al-muqtadiri al-ʿazīzi al-wahhāb. Innā nukabbiru ʿalayhā wa-ʿalā ummihā wa-ʿalā imāʾī allāʾī aqbalna ilā Allāhi māliki al-riqāb, wa-nūṣīhinna bi-al-ʿamali al-khāliṣi wa-mā yanbaghī li-ayyāmi Allāhi rabbi al-arbāb. Kadhālika māja baḥru al-bayāni idh yamshī al-Raḥmānu fī aʿlā al-maqām. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O you who look toward My face and arise to serve My Cause! Give her glad tidings on My behalf and convey to her My greeting of glory, at the bidding of your compassionate, generous Lord. We previously remembered her and the daughter of him who bears My name, the Most Truthful, who turned and directed himself toward God at His command, until he entered the prison, stood at the gate, and heard the call of God, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Bestowing. We bestow Our greeting of glory upon her, upon her mother, and upon My handmaids who have turned toward God, the Master of all, and We exhort them to pure deeds and whatever befits the days of God, the Lord of lords. Thus has the ocean of utterance surged as the All-Merciful walks in the highest station. End.
:::

### 94

::: {.original lang="ar"}
الحمد للّه فازت بما ارادت قد ذکرت و نزّلت لها و لبنتها ما تضوّع به عرف عنایة ربّنا الکریم آخر دستخطّ آنمحبوب جان بمناجات مع اللّه منتهی در حین عرض آن چون باینکلمهٴ آنجناب رسید که عرض نموده‌اند الهی و محبوبی معزّز بدار نفسیرا که امر ترا معزّز بدارد و علّت اعزاز و اعلای امر تو گردد در اینمقام شمس این بیان از افق ارادهٴ مالک امکان اشراق نمود قوله جلّ اجلاله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Al-ḥamdu li-llāh, fāzat bi-mā arādat. Qad dhukirat wa-nuzzilat lahā wa-li-bintihā mā taḍawwaʿa bihi ʿarfu ʿināyati rabbinā al-karīm. Ākhar-e dastkhaṭṭ-e ān maḥbūb-e jān be-monājāt maʿa Allāh montahī. Dar ḥīn-e ʿarż-e ān chūn be-īn kalame-ye ān janāb resīd ke ʿarż namūde-and, Ilāhī va maḥbūbī, moʿazzaz bedār nafsī-rā ke amr-e to-rā moʿazzaz bedārad va ʿellat-e eʿzāz va eʿlā-ye amr-e to gardad, dar īn maqām shams-e īn bayān az ofoq-e erāde-ye Mālek-e emkān eshrāq namūd. Qawluhu jalla ijlāluhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to God, she attained what she desired. She was indeed remembered, and there was revealed for her and her daughter that through which the fragrance of our generous Lord’s loving care was diffused. The letter of that beloved of the soul concludes with a supplication to God. While it was being presented, when the reading reached these words you had written, “My God and my Beloved, honor the soul who honors Your Cause and becomes the means of exalting and elevating Your Cause,” at this point the sun of this utterance shone from the horizon of the will of the Lord of all existence. His words, exalted be His majesty:
:::

### 95

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ایّها الشّارب رحیق بیانی انّا اعززناک و نصرناک و رفعناک و ذکرناک لتذکر امر ربّک العزیز الکریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ayyuhā al-shāribu raḥīqa bayānī, innā aʿzaznāka wa-naṣarnāka wa-rafaʿnāka wa-dhakarnāka li-tadhkura amra rabbika al-ʿazīzi al-karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
O you who drink the choice wine of My utterance! We have indeed honored you, aided you, exalted you, and remembered you, so that you may make mention of the Cause of your Lord, the Almighty, the Generous.
:::

### 96

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این عزّت تغییر نیابد و جنود عالم بر ستر آن قادر نه چه که حقّ عنایت فرموده و از جانب حقّ است و زود است که آثارش در ارض ظاهر شود تمسّک بذکری و قم علی خدمة امری بالرّوح و الرّیحان و الحکمة و البیان کذلک یأمرک الرّحمن من هذا المقام العزیز المنیع آن جناب و بعضی از دوستان که صادق و محرمند و بطراز محبّت فی‌الحقیقه مزیّن مشورت نمائید و بآنچه سبب اتّحاد و اتّفاق است قیام کنید لعمری سوف یرفع اللّه من یحبّه و یظهر مقامه بین خلقه انّه ولیّ من والاه و ناصر من نصره فی یومه العزیز البدیع انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn ʿezzat taghyīr nayābad va jonūd-e ʿālam bar satr-e ān qāder na, che ke Ḥaqq ʿenāyat farmūde va az jāneb-e Ḥaqq ast va zūd ast ke āthārash dar arż ẓāher shavad. Tamassak bi-dhikrī wa-qum ʿalā khidmati amrī bi-al-rūḥi wa-al-rayḥāni wa-al-ḥikmati wa-al-bayān. Kadhālika yaʾmuruka al-Raḥmānu min hādhā al-maqāmi al-ʿazīzi al-manīʿ. Ān janāb va baʿżī az dūstān ke ṣādeq va maḥramand va be-ṭerāz-e maḥabbat fī al-ḥaqīqe mozayyan, mashverat namāyīd va be-ānche sabab-e etteḥād va ettefāq ast qiyām konīd. La-ʿamrī sawfa yarfaʿu Allāhu man yuḥibbuhu wa-yuẓhiru maqāmahu bayna khalqihi. Innahu waliyyu man wālāhu wa-nāṣiru man naṣarahu fī yawmihi al-ʿazīzi al-badīʿ. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
This honor will not change, nor can the armies of the world conceal it, for God has bestowed it and it comes from God; soon its effects will appear on earth. Hold fast to My remembrance and arise to serve My Cause with joy and gladness, wisdom and utterance. Thus does the All-Merciful command you from this mighty, unassailable station. Consult with some of the friends who are sincere and trustworthy and truly adorned with love, and undertake whatever will foster unity and concord. By My life! God will exalt whoever loves Him and reveal his station among His creatures. He is indeed the protector of whoever befriends Him and the helper of whoever helps Him in His mighty, wondrous Day. End.
:::

### 97

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در اینمقام بحر بیان بشأنی موّاج که حفظ و خیال و قوّه از این عبد رفت انّا للّه و انّا الیه راجعون و الأمر بید اللّه دیگر نمیدانم کاد ان یطیر الجسد و کیف الرّوح بعد از عرض مناجات و تنزیل آیات و اظهار عنایات و ظهورات رحمت و بروزات فضل ذکر نفوس مقبلهٴ مستقیمه علیهم بهآء اللّه و عنایته که در دستخطّ آن محبوب بود در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد هذا ما اشرقت به شمس الحقیقة من افق سمآء البیان قوله جلّت عظمته و عظم احسانه و کبر کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar īn maqām baḥr-e bayān be-shaʾnī mavvāj ke ḥefẓ va khayāl va qovve az īn ʿabd raft. Innā li-llāhi wa-innā ilayhi rājiʿūn, wa-al-amru bi-yadi Allāh. Dīgar nemīdānam. Kāda an yaṭīra al-jasadu wa-kayfa al-rūḥ. Baʿd az ʿarż-e monājāt va tanzīl-e āyāt va eẓhār-e ʿenāyāt va ẓohūrāt-e raḥmat va borūzāt-e fażl, dhekr-e nofūs-e moqbele-ye mostaqīme, ʿalayhim bahāʾu Allāhi wa-ʿināyatuhu, ke dar dastkhaṭṭ-e ān maḥbūb būd dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e aʿlā ʿarż shod. Hādhā mā ashraqat bihi shamsu al-ḥaqīqati min ufuqi samāʾi al-bayān. Qawluhu jallat ʿaẓamatuhu wa-ʿaẓuma iḥsānuhu wa-kabura kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
At this point the ocean of utterance surged so mightily that this servant lost his memory, thought, and strength. We belong to God and to Him we return, and the matter is in God’s hands. I know no more. The body almost took flight—how much more the spirit! After the supplication had been presented, verses revealed, loving care expressed, mercy manifested, and grace displayed, mention of the steadfast souls who had turned toward Him—upon them be God’s glory and loving care—whose names appeared in that beloved one’s letter was presented in the most unassailable, most holy, most exalted court. This is what the Sun of Truth shone forth with from the horizon of the heaven of utterance. His words, exalted be His grandeur, great His beneficence, and immense His majesty:
:::

### 98

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المذکور فی الصّحف و الزّبر و الألواح
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-ismī al-madhkūri fī al-ṣuḥufi wa-al-zuburi wa-al-alwāḥ.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, mentioned in the Scriptures, the Books, and the Tablets.
:::

### 99

::: {.original lang="ar"}
کتاب نزّل من لدی اللّه مالک القدم علی الأحزاب و الأمم طوبی لسمیع سمع و لبصیر رأی و ویل لکلّ منکر مرتاب ان یا قلمی الأعلی ان اذکر الّذین تشبّثوا بأذیال ردآء عنایة ربّک مالک الأسمآء بذکر تنجذب به القلوب و الأرواح ان اذکر عبدی العظیم الّذی اعترف بهذا النّبأ الأعظم و شرب رحیق العرفان من ایادی عطآء ربّک الرّحمن الّذی ینطق فیکلّ شأن انّه لا اله الّا انا العزیز الوهّاب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Kitābun nuzzila min ladā Allāhi māliki al-qidami ʿalā al-aḥzābi wa-al-umam. Ṭūbā li-samīʿin samiʿa wa-li-baṣīrin raʾā wa-waylun li-kulli munkirin murtāb. An yā qalamī al-aʿlā, an udhkur alladhīna tashabbathū bi-adhyāli ridāʾi ʿināyati rabbika māliki al-asmāʾi bi-dhikrin tanjadhibu bihi al-qulūbu wa-al-arwāḥ. An udhkur ʿabdī al-ʿAẓīm alladhī iʿtarafa bi-hādhā al-nabaʾi al-aʿẓami wa-shariba raḥīqa al-ʿirfāni min ayādī ʿaṭāʾi rabbika al-Raḥmāni alladhī yanṭiqu fī kulli shaʾnin, innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿazīzu al-wahhāb.
:::

::: {.translation}
A Book sent down from God, the Lord of eternity, to the peoples and nations. Blessed is the hearer who has heard and the discerning one who has seen, and woe to every doubting denier! O My Most Exalted Pen! Remember those who have clung to the hem of the robe of the loving care of your Lord, the Lord of Names, with a remembrance that will draw hearts and spirits to Him. Remember My servant ʿAẓīm, who acknowledged this Most Great Announcement and drank the choice wine of recognition from the hands of the bounty of your Lord, the All-Merciful, who proclaims in every circumstance, “There is indeed no God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Bestowing.”
:::

### 100

::: {.original lang="ar"}
انّا ذکرناک من قبل من شطر البقعة البیضآء من سدرة المنتهی بذکر تضوّع منه عرف البقآء بین الأحزاب ان اشکر اللّه بهذا الذّکر الأعظم فی سجنی الأعظم و قل لک الحمد یا مطلع الوحی و منزل الآیات لعمری لا تعادل بحرف من آیاتی کنوز الأرض کلّها یشهد بذلک من عنده امّ الکتاب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Innā dhakarnāka min qablu min shaṭri al-buqʿati al-bayḍāʾi min Sidrati al-Muntahā bi-dhikrin taḍawwaʿa minhu ʿarfu al-baqāʾi bayna al-aḥzāb. An ushkur Allāha bi-hādhā al-dhikri al-aʿẓami fī sijnī al-aʿẓami wa-qul laka al-ḥamdu yā maṭliʿa al-waḥyi wa-munzila al-āyāt. La-ʿamrī lā tuʿādalu bi-ḥarfin min āyātī kunūzu al-arḍi kulluhā. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man ʿindahu Ummu al-Kitāb.
:::

::: {.translation}
We previously remembered you from the direction of the White Spot, from the Tree beyond which there is no passing, with a remembrance from which the fragrance of eternity spread among the peoples. Thank God for this most great remembrance in My Most Great Prison, and say, “Praise be to You, O Dawning-Place of revelation and Revealer of verses!” By My life! All the treasures of the earth cannot equal a single letter of My verses. To this bears witness He with whom is the Mother Book.
:::

### 101

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل یا ملأ الأحزاب تاللّه انّ الکتاب ینطق فی قطب العالم و یدع الأمم الی مالک القدم ولکنّ القوم فی نوم عجاب قل اتی من خضعت له کتب الأرض کلّها ان اعتبروا یا اولی الأبصار اتّقوا الرّحمن یا ملأ الامکان ان انصفوا فیهذا الأمر الّذی اذا ظهر نفخ فی الصّور و مرّت الجبال قل فاتوا یا ملأ الأرض بما عندکم و نزن ما عندنا و عندکم بهذا المیزان الّذی وضع بالعدل امراً من لدی اللّه ربّ الأرباب هذا یوم فیه ینادی المیزان بأعلی النّدآء بأنّی انا الممیّز العلیم من لدن مالک الأدیان
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul yā malaʾa al-aḥzāb, ta-Allāhi inna al-kitāba yanṭiqu fī quṭbi al-ʿālami wa-yadʿu al-umama ilā māliki al-qidami wa-lākinna al-qawma fī nawmin ʿujāb. Qul atā man khaḍaʿat lahu kutubu al-arḍi kulluhā. An iʿtabirū yā ulī al-abṣār. Ittaqū al-Raḥmāna yā malaʾa al-imkān. An anṣifū fī hādhā al-amri alladhī idhā ẓahara nufikha fī al-ṣūri wa-marrati al-jibāl. Qul faʾtū yā malaʾa al-arḍi bi-mā ʿindakum wa-nazin mā ʿindanā wa-ʿindakum bi-hādhā al-mīzāni alladhī wuḍiʿa bi-al-ʿadli amran min ladā Allāhi rabbi al-arbāb. Hādhā yawmun fīhi yunādī al-mīzānu bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾi bi-annī anā al-mumayyizu al-ʿalīmu min ladun māliki al-adyān.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: O peoples! By God, the Book speaks at the pivot of the world and summons the nations to the Lord of eternity, yet the people are sunk in an astonishing sleep. Say: He has come before whom all the books of the earth have bowed. Take heed, you who have insight! Be mindful of the All-Merciful, O inhabitants of the realm of existence! Judge fairly this Cause, at whose appearance the trumpet was sounded and the mountains passed away. Say: O peoples of the earth, bring what you possess, and We will weigh what We possess and what you possess in this Balance, which has been established with justice at the command of God, the Lord of lords. This is a day when the Balance calls out at the top of its voice, “I am indeed the discerning, the all-knowing, from the Lord of religions.”
:::

### 102

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر من سمّی بحیدر من هذا المنظر الأکبر لیبشّره برحمتی و عنایتی و یقرّبه الی مقام جعله اللّه مطاف الفردوس الأعلی و اهل ملکوت الأسمآء فی العشیّ و الاشراق لعمری لو تطّلع بما عند ربّک لیأخذک الفرح و الابتهاج علی شأن تعجز عن ذکره الأقلام کن قائماً علی خدمة امری و ناطقاً بثنائی و ناظراً الی افقی و متشبّثاً بأذیال ردآء عنایتی کذلک امرناک من قبل و فی هذا اللّوح الّذی لاحت من افقه شمس الحکمة و البیان یا حیدر وصّ عبادی بأخلاقی و ما نزّل فی کتابی انّ ربّک لهو الآمر العزیز العلّام ایّاک ان تمنعک شئونات الخلق عن الحقّ ضع ما سوائی ثمّ ولّ وجهک الی شطری و قل اشهد انّک کنت مسطوراً من القلم الأعلی و مکنوناً فی علم اللّه مالک الرّقاب ان احمد اللّه بما ذکرت لدی المظلوم و انزل لک ما انارت به الآفاق
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru man summiya bi-Ḥaydar min hādhā al-manẓari al-akbari li-yubashshirahu bi-raḥmatī wa-ʿināyatī wa-yuqarribahu ilā maqāmin jaʿalahu Allāhu maṭāfa al-firdawsi al-aʿlā wa-ahli malakūti al-asmāʾi fī al-ʿashiyyi wa-al-ishrāq. La-ʿamrī law taṭṭaliʿu bi-mā ʿinda rabbika la-yaʾkhudhuka al-faraḥu wa-al-ibtihāju ʿalā shaʾnin taʿjizu ʿan dhikrihi al-aqlām. Kun qāʾiman ʿalā khidmati amrī wa-nāṭiqan bi-thanāʾī wa-nāẓiran ilā ufuqī wa-mutashabbithan bi-adhyāli ridāʾi ʿināyatī. Kadhālika amarnāka min qablu wa-fī hādhā al-lawḥi alladhī lāḥat min ufuqihi shamsu al-ḥikmati wa-al-bayān. Yā Ḥaydar, waṣṣi ʿibādī bi-akhlāqī wa-mā nuzzila fī kitābī. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-āmiru al-ʿazīzu al-ʿallām. Iyyāka an tamnaʿaka shuʾūnātu al-khalqi ʿani al-Ḥaqq. Ḍaʿ mā siwāʾī thumma walli wajhaka ilā shaṭrī wa-qul ashhadu annaka kunta masṭūran mina al-qalami al-aʿlā wa-maknūnan fī ʿilmi Allāhi māliki al-riqāb. An iḥmadi Allāha bi-mā dhukirta ladā al-maẓlūmi wa-unzila laka mā anārat bihi al-āfāq.
:::

::: {.translation}
We also remember him who is named Ḥaydar from this Most Great Outlook, that it may gladden him with My mercy and loving care and draw him near to a station that God has made the place around which the highest Paradise and the inhabitants of the Kingdom of Names circle at evening and at dawn. By My life! Were you to learn what is with your Lord, joy and gladness would seize you in a manner that pens are powerless to describe. Arise to serve My Cause, speak My praise, look toward My horizon, and cling to the hem of the robe of My loving care. Thus have We commanded you before and in this Tablet, from whose horizon the sun of wisdom and utterance has shone. O Ḥaydar! Exhort My servants to adopt My character and follow what has been sent down in My Book. Your Lord is indeed the Ordainer, the Almighty, the All-Knowing. Beware lest the affairs of creation keep you from the True One. Set aside all but Me, then turn your face toward Me and say, “I bear witness that You were inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen and concealed in the knowledge of God, the Master of all.” Praise God that you were mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One and that there was sent down for you that through which the horizons were illumined.
:::

### 103

::: {.original lang="ar"}
