یا علی قبل اکبر علیک بهائی و رحمتی ان افرح بما توجّه الیک البحر الأعظم من هذا المقام الأنور الأقدم و اراد ان یذکر عمّک و ابنه لیفرحا بذکر اللّه فی یوم فیه اسودّت الوجوه و زلّت الأقدام طوبی لمقبل سمع و اقبل ویل لمعرض اعرض عن الّذی ذکره فی اللّیالی و الأیّام انّا نبشّرهما و نکبّر من هذا المقام علیهما لیقوما علی خدمة امری الّذی خضعت له الأعناق و نذکر احبّآء اللّه و اولیائه فی ارض السّین و النّون و نبشّرهم بالشّمس و اشراقها و البحر و امواجه و السّمآء و ارتفاعها و الأنجم و انوارها و ما رقم لهم من قلمی الأعلی فی الصّحیفة الحمرآء کذلک یجزی اللّه عباده فضلاً من عنده و هو العزیز الفضّال
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿAlī qabla Akbar, ʿalayka bahāʾī wa-raḥmatī. An ifraḥ bi-mā tawajjaha ilayka al-baḥru al-aʿẓamu min hādhā al-maqāmi al-anwari al-aqdami wa-arāda an yadhkura ʿammaka wa-ibnahu li-yafraḥā bi-dhikri Allāhi fī yawmin fīhi iswaddati al-wujūhu wa-zallati al-aqdām. Ṭūbā li-muqbilin samiʿa wa-aqbala, waylun li-muʿriḍin aʿraḍa ʿani alladhī dhakarahu fī al-layālī wa-al-ayyām. Innā nubashshiruhumā wa-nukabbiru min hādhā al-maqāmi ʿalayhimā li-yaqūmā ʿalā khidmati amrī alladhī khaḍaʿat lahu al-aʿnāq. Wa-nadhkuru aḥibbāʾa Allāhi wa-awliyāʾahu fī arḍi al-sīni wa-al-nūni wa-nubashshiruhum bi-al-shamsi wa-ishrāqihā wa-al-baḥri wa-amwājihi wa-al-samāʾi wa-irtifāʿihā wa-al-anjumi wa-anwārihā wa-mā ruqima lahum min qalamī al-aʿlā fī al-ṣaḥīfati al-ḥamrāʾ. Kadhālika yajzī Allāhu ʿibādahu faḍlan min ʿindihi wa-huwa al-ʿazīzu al-faḍḍāl.
:::

::: {.translation}
O ʿAlī, whose name precedes Akbar! Upon you be My glory and My mercy. Rejoice that the Most Great Ocean has turned toward you from this most luminous, most ancient station and has wished to remember your paternal uncle and his son, that they may rejoice in the remembrance of God on a day when faces have darkened and feet have slipped. Blessed is the receptive one who has heard and turned toward Him; woe to the one who has turned away from Him whom he remembered by night and day! We give them both glad tidings and bestow upon them Our greeting of glory from this station, that they may arise to serve My Cause, before which all necks have bowed. We also remember God’s loved ones and His friends in the lands of Sīn and Nūn, and gladden them with the sun and its radiance, the ocean and its waves, the heaven and its loftiness, the stars and their lights, and what has been inscribed for them by My Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Scroll. Thus does God reward His servants as a grace from Him, and He is the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.
:::

### 104

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا یحیی ان استمع النّدآء من شطر عکّآء عن یمین البقعة النّورآء من السّدرة انّه لا اله الّا انا الغنیّ المتعال هل تعرف من ینطقک و هل تعلم من اقبل الیک قل ای ونفسک انّ مکلّم الطّور ینطق لی و مالک الظّهور قد اقبل الی وجهی فضلاً من عنده و هو الغنیّ بالحقّ و انا الفقیر المحتاج یا یحیی وصّ عبادی بالأمانة و الصّدق و بما یرتفع به ذکر اللّه فی المدن و الدّیار ان افتحوا القلوب بجنود الأخلاق کذلک امرنا العباد من قبل و فی هذا الکتاب و کذلک زیّنّا دیباج کتاب الوجود بذکر المقصود لتشکر ربّک مالک الأنام
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Yaḥyā, an istamiʿ al-nidāʾa min shaṭri ʿAkkāʾa ʿan yamīni al-buqʿati al-nūrāʾi mina al-sidrati, innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ghaniyyu al-mutaʿāl. Hal taʿrifu man yunṭiquka wa-hal taʿlamu man aqbala ilayka? Qul ay wa-nafsika inna mukallima al-Ṭūri yanṭiqu lī wa-mālika al-ẓuhūri qad aqbala ilā wajhī faḍlan min ʿindihi wa-huwa al-ghaniyyu bi-al-ḥaqqi wa-anā al-faqīru al-muḥtāj. Yā Yaḥyā, waṣṣi ʿibādī bi-al-amānati wa-al-ṣidqi wa-bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi dhikru Allāhi fī al-muduni wa-al-diyār. An iftaḥū al-qulūba bi-junūdi al-akhlāq. Kadhālika amarnā al-ʿibāda min qablu wa-fī hādhā al-kitāb. Wa-kadhālika zayyannā dībāja kitābi al-wujūdi bi-dhikri al-maqṣūdi li-tashkura rabbaka mālika al-anām.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Yaḥyā! Listen to the call from the direction of ʿAkkā, from the Tree on the right side of the luminous Spot: “There is indeed no God but Me, the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted.” Do you recognize Him who causes you to speak, and do you know who has turned toward you? Say: “Yes, by Your own Self! He who spoke on Sinai speaks to me, and the Lord of Revelation has turned His face toward me as a grace from Him. He is in truth the Self-Sufficient, while I am poor and needy.” O Yaḥyā! Exhort My servants to trustworthiness and truthfulness and to whatever will exalt the remembrance of God in cities and lands. Conquer hearts with the hosts of good character. Thus have We commanded the servants before and in this Book. Thus have We adorned the brocade of the Book of Existence with the remembrance of the Desired One, that you may thank your Lord, the Lord of humankind.
:::

### 105

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر من سمّی بمولی فیهذا المقام الأعلی بندائی الأحلی و انا المقتدر علی ما اراد قم علی الذّکر و الثّنآء و سبّح بحمد ربّک مالک المآب انّا ذکرناکم بذکر سالت به البطحآء و جری فرات رحمتی من کلّ الجهات قل یا قوم لا تمنعوا انفسکم عن بحر الحیوان اتّقوا الرّحمن الّذی اتی بجنود الوحی و رایات الآیات قل هل یبقی لکم ما ترونه الیوم لا ونفسی الحقّ سیفنی من علی الأرض و یبقی الملک لنفسه وحدها یشهد بذلک کلّ شجر و حجر و مدر و حصاة
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru man summiya bi-Mawlā fī hādhā al-maqāmi al-aʿlā bi-nidāʾī al-aḥlā wa-anā al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā arād. Qum ʿalā al-dhikri wa-al-thanāʾi wa-sabbiḥ bi-ḥamdi rabbika māliki al-maʾāb. Innā dhakarnākum bi-dhikrin sālat bihi al-baṭḥāʾu wa-jarā furātu raḥmatī min kulli al-jihāt. Qul yā qawmi lā tamnaʿū anfusakum ʿan baḥri al-ḥayawān. Ittaqū al-Raḥmāna alladhī atā bi-junūdi al-waḥyi wa-rāyāti al-āyāt. Qul hal yabqā lakum mā tarawnahu al-yawm? Lā wa-nafsī al-Ḥaqq. Sa-yafnā man ʿalā al-arḍi wa-yabqā al-mulku li-nafsihi waḥdahā. Yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu shajarin wa-ḥajarin wa-madarin wa-ḥaṣāt.
:::

::: {.translation}
We also remember him who is named Mawlā in this most exalted station with My sweetest call, and I have power over whatever I will. Arise in remembrance and praise, and glorify your Lord, the Lord of the place of return. We have remembered you with a remembrance through which the valley has flowed and the sweet waters of My mercy have streamed from every direction. Say: O people! Do not deprive yourselves of the ocean of life. Be mindful of the All-Merciful, who has come with the hosts of revelation and the banners of verses. Say: Will what you see today remain yours? No, by My own Self, the True One! Those on earth will perish, and sovereignty will remain His alone. To this every tree, stone, clod, and pebble bears witness.
:::

### 106

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر الهادی الّذی هدیناه الی سوآء الصّراط یا هادی انّ المظلوم یذکرک و یأمرک و الّذین آمنوا بالمعروف ان اتّبعوا ما امرتم به من لدن فالق الأصباح تاللّه یوم اللّه ینطق بالحقّ فی هذا القصر الّذی جعله اللّه المنظر الأکبر ان اعرفوا یا اولی الألباب قل ضعوا ما عند القوم قد اتی سلطان الوجود بأعلام الوحی و الالهام یا ملأ الأرض اتّقوا اللّه و لا تحرموا انفسکم عن الّذی به ظهر ما کان مکنوناً فی الزّبر و الألواح خذوا کتاب اللّه بقوّة و لا تتّبعوا کلّ جاهل مرتاب کذلک نوّرنا افق سمآء العرفان بنور البیان طوبی لمن سمع و رأی و ویل لکلّ غافل مکّار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru al-Hādī alladhī hadaynāhu ilā sawāʾi al-ṣirāṭ. Yā Hādī, inna al-maẓlūma yadhkuruka wa-yaʾmuruka wa-alladhīna āmanū bi-al-maʿrūf. An ittabiʿū mā umirtum bihi min ladun fāliqi al-aṣbāḥ. Ta-Allāhi yawmu Allāhi yanṭiqu bi-al-ḥaqqi fī hādhā al-qaṣri alladhī jaʿalahu Allāhu al-manẓara al-akbar. An iʿrifū yā ulī al-albāb. Qul ḍaʿū mā ʿinda al-qawmi qad atā sulṭānu al-wujūdi bi-aʿlāmi al-waḥyi wa-al-ilhām. Yā malaʾa al-arḍi ittaqū Allāha wa-lā taḥrimū anfusakum ʿani alladhī bihi ẓahara mā kāna maknūnan fī al-zuburi wa-al-alwāḥ. Khudhū kitāba Allāhi bi-quwwatin wa-lā tattabiʿū kulla jāhilin murtāb. Kadhālika nawwarnā ufuqa samāʾi al-ʿirfāni bi-nūri al-bayān. Ṭūbā li-man samiʿa wa-raʾā wa-waylun li-kulli ghāfilin makkār.
:::

::: {.translation}
We also remember Hādī, whom We guided to the straight path. O Hādī! The Wronged One remembers you and enjoins you and those who have believed to do what is right. Follow what you have been commanded by the Cleaver of the dawn. By God! The Day of God speaks the truth in this palace, which God has made the Most Great Outlook. Recognize this, you who possess understanding! Say: Set aside what the people possess; the Sovereign of existence has come with the banners of revelation and inspiration. O peoples of the earth! Be mindful of God, and do not deprive yourselves of Him through whom what was concealed in the Books and Tablets has been revealed. Take hold of the Book of God with strength, and do not follow any ignorant doubter. Thus have We illumined the horizon of the heaven of recognition with the light of utterance. Blessed is whoever has heard and seen, and woe to every heedless schemer!
:::

### 107

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ان یا قلمی الأعلی ان اذکر من سمع صریرک و اقبل الیک الّذی سمّی بیوسف لیفرح بهذا الذّکر الّذی اذا ظهر سجدت له الأذکار انّا ظهرنا و اظهرنا الأمر علی شأن اضطربت القلوب و شاخصت الأبصار الّا الّذین نبذوا الأوهام عن ورائهم مقبلین الی اللّه مطلع الأنوار طوبی لمن فاز باصغآء ندائی و وجد عرف قمیصی و انتبه من نسمات عنایتی اذ سرت فی الأسحار هذا یوم فیه انجذبت الأشیآء من ندآء مالک الأسمآء ولکنّ النّاس فی غفلة و نعاس نعیماً لمن وجد عرف البیان و قام علی خدمة الأمر فی الغدوّ و الآصال انّا سمعنا ذکرک ذکرناک و رأینا اقبالک اقبلنا الیک من مشرق الأذکار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In yā qalamī al-aʿlā in udhkur man samiʿa ṣarīraka wa-aqbala ilayka alladhī summiya bi-Yūsuf li-yafraḥa bi-hādhā al-dhikr alladhī idhā ẓahara sajadat lahu al-adhkār. Innā ẓaharnā wa-aẓharnā al-amr ʿalā shaʾn iḍṭarabat al-qulūb wa-shākhiṣat al-abṣār illā alladhīna nabadhū al-awhām ʿan warāʾihim muqbilīna ilā Allāh maṭlaʿ al-anwār. Ṭūbā li-man fāza bi-iṣghāʾ nidāʾī wa-wajada ʿarf qamīṣī wa-intabaha min nasamāt ʿināyatī idh sarat fī al-asḥār. Hādhā yawm fīhi injadhabat al-ashyāʾ min nidāʾ mālik al-asmāʾ wa-lākinna al-nās fī ghafla wa-nuʿās. Naʿīman li-man wajada ʿarf al-bayān wa-qāma ʿalā khidmat al-amr fī al-ghuduww wa-al-āṣāl. Innā samiʿnā dhikraka dhakarnāka wa-raʾaynā iqbālaka aqbalnā ilayka min mashriq al-adhkār.
:::

::: {.translation}
O My Most Exalted Pen! Remember the one who heard your rustling and turned toward you, who is named Yūsuf, so that he may rejoice in this remembrance, before which all remembrances bowed down when it appeared. We have appeared and manifested the Cause in such a way that hearts were shaken and eyes stared in astonishment, except those who cast vain imaginings behind them and turned toward God, the Dawning-Place of lights. Blessed is whoever has attained to hearing My call, perceived the fragrance of My robe, and awakened through the breezes of My loving care as they wafted at dawn. This is a day when all things have been enraptured by the call of the Lord of Names, yet the people remain heedless and asleep. Blessed is whoever has perceived the fragrance of utterance and arisen to serve the Cause morning and evening. We heard your remembrance and remembered you; We saw your turning toward Us and turned toward you from the Dawning-Place of remembrances.
:::

### 108

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر علی قبل محمّد و نبشّره و الّذین آمنوا فیهناک برحمتی و عنایتی و فضلی الّذی به شهدت الذّرّات توکّل فی کلّ الأمور علی مکلّم الطّور و تمسّک بما نزّل فی الکتاب من لدن مرسل الأریاح ایّاک ان تمنعک اوهام العلمآء عن فاطر السّمآء او تخوّفک سطوة الأمرآء عن مطلع الایقان لا تلتفتوا الی ایّام معدودات انّها ستمضی و یرون الموحّدون انفسهم فی اعلی الجنان انّا نأمرکم فیکلّ الأحوال بالحکمة لئلّا یرتفع ضوضآء الّذین کفروا بالمآل کذلک تضوّع عرف البیان فی الامکان طوبی لمن وجد و ویل لکلّ منکر مکّار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru ʿAlī qabla Muḥammad wa-nubashshiruhu wa-alladhīna āmanū fī hunāka bi-raḥmatī wa-ʿināyatī wa-faḍlī alladhī bihi shahidat al-dharrāt. Tawakkal fī kull al-umūr ʿalā mukallim al-Ṭūr wa-tamassak bi-mā nuzzila fī al-kitāb min ladun mursil al-aryāḥ. Iyyāka an tamnaʿaka awhām al-ʿulamāʾ ʿan fāṭir al-samāʾ aw tukhawwifaka saṭwat al-umarāʾ ʿan maṭlaʿ al-īqān. Lā taltafitū ilā ayyām maʿdūdāt innahā sa-tamḍī wa-yarawna al-muwaḥḥidūn anfusahum fī aʿlā al-jinān. Innā naʾmurukum fī kull al-aḥwāl bi-al-ḥikma li-allā yartafiʿa ḍawḍāʾ alladhīna kafarū bi-al-maʾāl. Kadhālika taḍawwaʿa ʿarf al-bayān fī al-imkān. Ṭūbā li-man wajada wa-wayl li-kull munkir makkār.
:::

::: {.translation}
We also remember ʿAlī before Muḥammad, and give him and those who have believed in that place the good news of My mercy, My loving care, and My grace, to which the atoms have borne witness. In all matters, place your trust in Him who spoke on Sinai, and hold fast to what has been sent down in the Book by the Sender of the winds. Beware lest the vain imaginings of the learned keep you from the Creator of heaven, or the might of rulers frighten you away from the Dawning-Place of certitude. Pay no heed to these few days: they will pass, and those who affirm God's unity will see themselves in the loftiest gardens of paradise. We enjoin you to exercise wisdom under all circumstances, lest the clamor of those who have denied the ultimate return arise. Thus has the fragrance of utterance spread throughout existence. Blessed is whoever has perceived it, and woe to every scheming denier!
:::

### 109

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر احبّائی فی الشّین و الهآء و نبشّرهم باقبالی الیهم و نکبّر علی وجوههم من هذا المقام الّذی تزیّن بأنوار وجه ربّهم العزیز الغفّار یا احبّائی ان افرحوا بما نزّل لکم من سمآء الأمر ثمّ اشکروا ربّکم الرّحمن فیکلّ الأحیان انّه غفرکم و هداکم و فضّلکم علی اکثر العباد انّا ذکرنا کلّ من ذکر اسمه تلقآء الوجه ثمّ الّذین ما ذکرت اسمائهم انّه یفعل کیف یشآء بسلطان من عنده و هو المقتدر العزیز العلّام
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru aḥibbāʾī fī al-Shīn wa-al-Hāʾ wa-nubashshiruhum bi-iqbālī ilayhim wa-nukabbiru ʿalā wujūhihim min hādhā al-maqām alladhī tazayyana bi-anwār wajh rabbihim al-ʿAzīz al-Ghaffār. Yā aḥibbāʾī in ifraḥū bi-mā nuzzila lakum min samāʾ al-amr thumma ushkurū rabbakum al-Raḥmān fī kull al-aḥyān. Innahu ghafarakum wa-hadākum wa-faḍḍalakum ʿalā akthar al-ʿibād. Innā dhakarnā kulla man dhukira ismuhu tilqāʾ al-wajh thumma alladhīna mā dhukirat asmāʾuhum. Innahu yafʿalu kayfa yashāʾ bi-sulṭān min ʿindihi wa-huwa al-Muqtadir al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAllām.
:::

::: {.translation}
We also remember My loved ones in Shīn and Hāʾ, give them the good news that I have turned toward them, and greet their faces with words of glorification from this station, which is adorned with the lights of the face of their Lord, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving. O My loved ones! Rejoice in what has been sent down for you from the heaven of the Cause, and thank your Lord, the All-Merciful, at all times. He has forgiven you, guided you, and favored you above most of His servants. We have remembered everyone whose name was mentioned before Our face, as well as those whose names were not mentioned. He does as He wills through a sovereignty of His own, and He is the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
:::

### 110

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر من سمّی بخانلر و نبشّره بعنایاتی الّتی لا یأخذها النّفاد ان افرح بما ذکرناک و الّذین آمنوا بآیات تفدی لها الأرواح ان اقتصر امورک علی ذکر اللّه و ثنائه اذا ورد علیک احد من اولیائه قم علی خدمته بالرّوح و الرّیحان ایّاک ان تحزنک شئونات الدّنیا و ما یرد فیها دعها عن ورائک و تمسّک بحبل اللّه مالک الایجاد البهآء علیک و علی ابنائک و اهلک و علی کلّ موقن صبّار انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru man summiya bi-Khānlar wa-nubashshiruhu bi-ʿināyātī allatī lā yaʾkhudhuhā al-nafād. In ifraḥ bi-mā dhakarnāka wa-alladhīna āmanū bi-āyāt tufdā lahā al-arwāḥ. In iqtaṣir umūraka ʿalā dhikr Allāh wa-thanāʾihi. Idhā warada ʿalayka aḥad min awliyāʾihi qum ʿalā khidmatihi bi-al-rūḥ wa-al-rayḥān. Iyyāka an tuḥzinaka shuʾūnāt al-dunyā wa-mā yaridu fīhā. Daʿhā ʿan warāʾika wa-tamassak bi-ḥabl Allāh mālik al-ījād. Al-bahāʾ ʿalayka wa-ʿalā abnāʾika wa-ahlika wa-ʿalā kull mūqin ṣabbār. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
We also remember the one named Khānlar and give him the good news of My inexhaustible favors. Rejoice that We have remembered you and those who have believed in verses for which souls would be sacrificed. Confine your affairs to the remembrance and praise of God. Whenever one of His loved ones comes to you, arise to serve him with joy and gladness. Beware lest the affairs of this world and what happens in it grieve you. Leave it behind you and hold fast to the cord of God, the Lord of creation. Glory rest upon you, your sons, your family, and everyone who is assured and steadfastly patient. End.
:::

### 111

::: {.original lang="ar"}
آیا بعد از امواج بحر معانی و ظهورات انوار بیان الهی اینعبد چه ذکر نماید و چه عرض کند وقتی از اوقات اینکلمهٴ علیا از لسان مالک اسماء ظاهر فی‌الحقیقه قلب از آن محترق و زفرات متصاعد و عبرات نازل قوله جلّت عظمته
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Āyā baʿd az amvāj-i baḥr-i maʿānī va ẓuhūrāt-i anvār-i bayān-i ilāhī īn ʿabd che dhikr namāyad va che ʿarż konad? Vaqtī az awqāt īn kalimiy-i ʿulyā az lisān-i Mālik-i Asmāʾ ẓāhir, fī al-ḥaqīqa qalb az ān moḥtareq va zafarāt motaṣāʿid va ʿabarāt nāzil. Qawluhu jallat ʿaẓamatuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
After the waves of the ocean of meanings and the manifestations of the lights of divine utterance, what can this servant mention, and what can he present? On one occasion, these exalted words issued from the tongue of the Lord of Names. Truly, the heart is set aflame by them, sighs ascend, and tears fall. His words—exalted be His grandeur:
:::

### 112

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا عبد حاضر مشاهده مینمائی و اصغا میکنی که در لیالی و ایّام صریر قلم فضل مرتفع و ندای مظلوم بلند و جمیع از برای هدایت عباد و نجات من علی الأرض بوده ای کاش در جزای اینموهبت کبری و شفقت عظمی بر امر الهی متّحد می‌شدند و بآنچه سبب و علّت سموّ و علوّ اوست متشبّث که شاید عرف خوشی از اعمال خالصه و اخلاق روحانیّه ساطع شود و عالمرا اخبار نماید بآنچه ظاهر شده این عرف اگر مرتفع شود قاصدیست صادق و رسولیست کامل و مبیّن طوبی لمن فاز ببیانی و عرف ما اراد ملکوت مشیّتی انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿabd-i ḥāżir, moshāhede mī-namāʾī va iṣghā mī-konī ke dar layālī va ayyām ṣarīr-i qalam-i fażl mortafeʿ va nidā-yi Maẓlūm boland va jamīʿ az barā-yi hidāyat-i ʿibād va najāt-i man ʿalā al-arḍ būde. Ey kāsh dar jazā-yi īn mawhebat-i kubrā va shafaqat-i ʿuẓmā bar amr-i ilāhī mottaḥid mī-shodand va bi-ānche sabab va ʿellat-i somovv va ʿolovv-i ūst motashabbith ke shāyad ʿarf-i khoshī az aʿmāl-i khāliṣe va akhlāq-i rūḥāniyye sāṭeʿ shavad va ʿālam-rā ikhbār namāyad bi-ānche ẓāhir shode. Īn ʿarf agar mortafeʿ shavad qāṣedīst ṣādiq va rasūlīst kāmil va mobayyin. Ṭūbā li-man fāza bi-bayānī wa-ʿarafa mā arāda malakūt mashīʾatī. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
“O servant in attendance! You see and hear how, night and day, the rustling of the Pen of grace rises and the call of the Wronged One rings out, all for the guidance of the servants and the salvation of those on earth. If only, in return for this supreme gift and this immense compassion, they would unite in the Cause of God and hold fast to whatever brings about its elevation and exaltation, so that a sweet fragrance might spread from pure deeds and spiritual qualities and acquaint the world with what has appeared. If this fragrance rises, it is a truthful envoy and a perfect messenger who makes things clear. Blessed is whoever has attained to My utterance and recognized what the kingdom of My will has intended.” End.
:::

### 113

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این فقیر لازال در آنچه ظاهر شده متحیّر و مبهوت بیک طنین عنکبوت اقبال مینمایند و از صریر قلم اعلی اعراض رایحهٴ کریهه را محبوب میشمرند و از عرف فردوس اعلی محروم جمیع امور ظاهر و مشهود سوف یراه حضرتک کذلک اخبرنی من عنده امّ الکتاب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn faqīr lā-zāl dar ānche ẓāhir shode motaḥayyer va mabhūt. Bi-yek ṭanīn-i ʿankabūt iqbāl mī-namāyand va az ṣarīr-i Qalam-i Aʿlā iʿrāż. Rāyiḥiy-i karīhe-rā maḥbūb mī-shomarand va az ʿarf-i Firdaws-i Aʿlā maḥrūm. Jamīʿ-i omūr ẓāhir va mashhūd. Sawfa yarāhu ḥaḍratuka kadhālika akhbaranī man ʿindahu umm al-kitāb.
:::

::: {.translation}
This poor one remains bewildered and astonished at what has appeared. They turn toward the buzzing of a spider and turn away from the rustling of the Most Exalted Pen. They cherish a foul odor and are deprived of the fragrance of the most exalted Paradise. All matters are manifest and evident. You will see it; thus has He who possesses the Mother Book informed me.
:::

### 114

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در این حین دستخطّ ثالث آنحضرت بمثابهٴ نسیم ربیع حقیقی بر این جسد یابس مطروح عبور نمود بخششها فرمود و عنایتها اظهار داشت للّه الحمد بشیر محبّت در ظهور و مرور و انشآءاللّه این بشیر ممنوع نشود و از حرکت باز نماند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar īn ḥīn dast-khaṭṭ-i thālith-i ān ḥażrat bi-mathābiy-i nasīm-i rabīʿ-i ḥaqīqī bar īn jasad-i yābis-i maṭrūḥ ʿobūr namūd, bakhshesh-hā farmūd va ʿināyat-hā iẓhār dāsht. Li-llāh al-ḥamd, bashīr-i maḥabbat dar ẓuhūr va morūr va in shāʾ Allāh īn bashīr mamnūʿ nashavad va az ḥarakat bāz namānad.
:::

::: {.translation}
At this moment, your third handwritten letter passed over this dry, prostrate body like the breeze of the true spring, bestowing gifts and showing kindness. Praise be to God, the herald of love continues to appear and pass by. God willing, this herald will not be hindered or cease to move.
:::

### 115

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و بعد از قرائت و اطّلاع بمقام لا عدل له توجّه نموده بعد از حضور و اذن مناجات آنمحبوب بکمال روح و ریحان تلقاء عرش رحمن عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان القدم و مولی العالم قوله تبارک و تعالی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va baʿd az qirāʾat va iṭṭilāʿ bi-maqām-i lā ʿidla lahu tavajjoh namūde, baʿd az ḥuḍūr va idhn, monājāt-i ān maḥbūb bi-kamāl-i rūḥ va rayḥān tilqāʾ-i ʿarsh-i Raḥmān ʿarż shod. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi lisān al-qidam wa-mawlā al-ʿālam. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā.
:::

::: {.translation}
After reading it and acquainting myself with its contents, I turned toward the peerless station. After entering the presence and receiving permission, the prayer of that dear friend was presented with the utmost joy and gladness before the throne of the All-Merciful. This is what the Tongue of Eternity and Lord of the world spoke. His words—blessed and exalted is He:
:::

### 116

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ایّها المتوجّه الی وجهی و المنجذب بآیاتی انّا سمعنا ندائک و ما ناجیت به اللّه ربّک و سمعنا زفراتک و رأینا عبراتک فی حبّ اللّه محبوبک و مقصودک و شاهدنا نار حبّک و اشتعال قلبک و خضوعک و خشوعک و اهتزاز ارکانک فی عشق اللّه و ودّه انّا کنّا معک فی المجالس و المحافل اذ کنت ناطقاً بهذا الاسم الأعظم و هذا النّبأ الّذی بشّرنا به النّبیّین و المرسلین نعیماً لک و للّذین ما منعتهم شئونات الأوهام قاموا و قالوا اللّه ربّنا و ربّ العرش العظیم کبّر من قبلی علی احبّائی قل تاللّه ینوح قلبی و تبکی عینی بما ورد علی امری العزیز البدیع تمسّکوا بحبل الاتّحاد و ما فات عنکم فی ایّام اللّه ربّ العالمین کذلک اوقدنا سراج النّصح بدهن الفضل و نار الحبّ ان لن تحفظوه عن الأریاح لا تکونوا سبباً لاطفائه اتّقوا الرّحمن و تفکّروا فی عنایة ربّکم الغفور الرّحیم قوموا علی خدمة الأمر انّه خیر لکم عمّا خلق فی السّموات و الأرضین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ayyuhā al-mutawajjih ilā wajhī wa-al-munjadhib bi-āyātī, innā samiʿnā nidāʾaka wa-mā nājayta bihi Allāh rabbaka wa-samiʿnā zafarātaka wa-raʾaynā ʿabarātaka fī ḥubb Allāh maḥbūbika wa-maqṣūdika wa-shāhadnā nār ḥubbika wa-ishtiʿāl qalbika wa-khuḍūʿaka wa-khushūʿaka wa-ihtizāz arkānika fī ʿishq Allāh wa-wuddihi. Innā kunnā maʿaka fī al-majālis wa-al-maḥāfil idh kunta nāṭiqan bi-hādhā al-ism al-aʿẓam wa-hādhā al-nabaʾ alladhī bashsharnā bihi al-nabiyyīn wa-al-mursalīn. Naʿīman laka wa-li-alladhīna mā manaʿathum shuʾūnāt al-awhām qāmū wa-qālū Allāh rabbunā wa-rabb al-ʿarsh al-ʿaẓīm. Kabbir min qibalī ʿalā aḥibbāʾī. Qul ta-Allāh yanūḥu qalbī wa-tabkī ʿaynī bi-mā warada ʿalā amrī al-ʿazīz al-badīʿ. Tamassakū bi-ḥabl al-ittiḥād wa-mā fāta ʿankum fī ayyām Allāh rabb al-ʿālamīn. Kadhālika awqadnā sirāj al-nuṣḥ bi-duhn al-faḍl wa-nār al-ḥubb. In lan taḥfaẓūhu ʿan al-aryāḥ lā takūnū sababan li-iṭfāʾihi. Ittaqū al-Raḥmān wa-tafakkarū fī ʿināyat rabbikum al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm. Qūmū ʿalā khidmat al-amr innahu khayr lakum ʿammā khuliqa fī al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
“O you who turn toward My face and are enraptured by My verses! We have heard your call and what you whispered in prayer to God, your Lord. We have heard your sighs and seen your tears in your love for God, your Beloved and your Goal. We have witnessed the fire of your love, the burning of your heart, your submissiveness and humility, and the trembling of your limbs in love and affection for God. We were with you in gatherings and assemblies when you spoke of this Most Great Name and this Announcement of which We gave the prophets and messengers glad tidings. Blessed are you and those whom vain imaginings have not held back, who arose and said, ‘God is our Lord and the Lord of the mighty throne.’ Greet My loved ones on My behalf with words of glorification. Say: By God! My heart laments and My eyes weep at what has befallen My mighty and wondrous Cause. Hold fast to the cord of unity and to what you have missed in the days of God, the Lord of the worlds. Thus have We kindled the lamp of counsel with the oil of grace and the fire of love. If you will not protect it from the winds, do not be the cause of its extinction. Be mindful of the All-Merciful, and reflect on the loving care of your Lord, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. Arise to serve the Cause: it is better for you than all that has been created in the heavens and the earths.” End.
:::

### 117

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بصدهزار لسان این خادم فانی از دوستان الهی مسئلت مینماید که از جان بخروشند و جمعاً بکوشند که شاید اهل عالم مطّلع و آگاه شوند بآنچه که حقّ جلّ جلاله اراده فرموده اگر احصای اختلاف و احساس اعمال غیرطیّبه نمایند لعمر محبوبی و محبوبکم یفرّون و یستهزئون در یکی از الواح میفرماید باید دوستان بمثابهٴ رگ شریان در جسد عالم متحرّک باشند لذا باید جمیع باعمال و اخلاقی ظاهر شوند که جمیع عالم بسبب آن اقبال نمایند و بحرکت آیند صدهزار جان فدای عاملین للّه کجایند نفوسیکه حقّرا بر خود مقدّم دارند و در سبیلش عمل نمایند آنچه که سبب ترقّی و محبّت اهل عالم است از فضل حقّ امید هست که حبّهای عنایت مودعهٴ در قلوب انبات نماید و باثمار لطیفه مزیّن گردد الأمر بیده و هو القویّ القدیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-ṣad-hizār lisān īn khādim-i fānī az dūstān-i ilāhī masʾalat mī-namāyad ke az jān bi-khorūshand va jamʿan bi-kūshand ke shāyad ahl-i ʿālam moṭṭaliʿ va āgāh shavand bi-ānche ke Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu irāde farmūde. Agar iḥṣā-yi ikhtilāf va iḥsās-i aʿmāl-i ghayr-i ṭayyebe namāyand, la-ʿamr maḥbūbī wa-maḥbūbikum yafirrrūna wa-yastahziʾūn. Dar yekī az alvāḥ mī-farmāyad bāyad dūstān bi-mathābiy-i rag-i sharyān dar jasad-i ʿālam motaḥarrek bāshand. Lidhā bāyad jamīʿ bi-aʿmāl va akhlāqī ẓāhir shavand ke jamīʿ-i ʿālam bi-sabab-i ān iqbāl namāyand va bi-ḥarakat āyand. Ṣad-hizār jān fidā-yi ʿāmilīn li-llāh. Kojāyand nofūsī ke Ḥaqq-rā bar khod moqaddam dārand va dar sabīlash ʿamal namāyand ānche ke sabab-i taraqqī va maḥabbat-i ahl-i ʿālam ast? Az fażl-i Ḥaqq omīd hast ke ḥabb-hā-yi ʿināyat-i mūdaʿiy-i dar qolūb inbāt namāyad va bi-athmār-i laṭīfe mozayyan gardad. Al-amr bi-yadihi wa-huwa al-Qawiyy al-Qadīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
With a hundred thousand tongues, this ephemeral servant beseeches the friends of God to cry out from their souls and strive together, so that the people of the world may become informed and aware of what God—exalted be His glory—has intended. If they reckon up the dissension and perceive unworthy deeds, by the life of my Beloved and yours, they will flee and scoff. In one of the Tablets He says that the friends must be like a pulsating artery in the body of the world. Therefore, all must manifest such deeds and qualities that the whole world will thereby turn toward Him and be stirred into action. May a hundred thousand lives be sacrificed for those who act for God! Where are the souls who put God before themselves and do in His path what brings about the advancement and love of the world's people? Through God's grace, there is hope that the seeds of loving care deposited in hearts will sprout and become adorned with exquisite fruits. The matter is in His hand, and He is the Strong, the All-Powerful.
:::

### 118

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ذکر جناب آقا شیخ عبّاس علیه بهآء اللّه از قلم آنحضرت مرقوم اینفقره تلقاء عرش مطلع نور احدیّه عرض شد و این لوح امنع مخصوص ایشان از سماء عنایت نازل انشآءاللّه از فرات جاریهٴ در لوح الهی بیاشامند و باجر لقا و عنایت ربّنا مالک الأسمآء فائز گردند قوله عزّ بیانه و جلّ فضله و جلّت عظمته
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhikr-i Janāb-i Āqā Shaykh ʿAbbās ʿalayhi bahāʾ Allāh az qalam-i ān ḥażrat marqūm. Īn faqare tilqāʾ-i ʿarsh-i maṭlaʿ-i nūr-i aḥadiyye ʿarż shod va īn lawḥ-i amnaʿ makhṣūṣ-i īshān az samā-yi ʿināyat nāzil. In shāʾ Allāh az Furāt-i jāriyiy-i dar lawḥ-i ilāhī biyāshāmand va bi-ajr-i liqā va ʿināyat-i Rabbinā Mālik al-Asmāʾ fāʾiz gardand. Qawluhu ʿazza bayānuhu wa-jalla faḍluhu wa-jallat ʿaẓamatuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
Your pen had made mention of the honored Āqā Shaykh ʿAbbās, upon whom be the glory of God. This matter was presented before the throne of the Dawning-Place of the light of divine unity, and this most exalted Tablet was sent down especially for him from the heaven of loving care. God willing, he will drink from the Euphrates flowing in the divine Tablet and attain the reward of the Presence and the favor of our Lord, the Lord of Names. His words—mighty be His utterance, exalted His grace, and great His grandeur:
:::

### 119

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو الشّاهد السّمیع العلیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-Shāhid al-Samīʿ al-ʿAlīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Witness, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
:::

### 120

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا عبّاس یذکرک المظلوم بذکر تنجذب به المقرّبون الی اللّه المهیمن القیّوم قد اتت السّاعة و ارتفع النّدآء و ظهرت الصّیحة و مرّت الجبال و القوم هم لا یشعرون قد انقلب العالم و استقرّ العرش و استوی علیه مالک الظّهور و مکلّم الطّور و النّاس اکثرهم لا یفقهون قد ظهرت امّ الکتاب و تنادی بین الأرض و السّمآء بأعلی النّدآء و تدع الکلّ الی المقام المحمود من النّاس من انکر و منهم من اعرض و منهم من جادل بآیات اللّه ربّ ما کان و ما یکون و منهم من نقض میثاق اللّه و عهده بظلم ناح به اهل مدائن الأسمآء و سکّان الملکوت فلمّا تفرّسنا وجدنا اکثر اعدائنا العلمآء کذلک یقصّ لک لسان الأبهی من الأفق الأعلی انّه لهو الحقّ علّام الغیوب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿAbbās yadhkuruka al-Maẓlūm bi-dhikr tanjadhibu bihi al-muqarrabūn ilā Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Qad atat al-sāʿa wa-irtafaʿa al-nidāʾ wa-ẓaharat al-ṣayḥa wa-marrat al-jibāl wa-al-qawm hum lā yashʿurūn. Qad inqalaba al-ʿālam wa-istaqarra al-ʿarsh wa-istawā ʿalayhi mālik al-ẓuhūr wa-mukallim al-Ṭūr wa-al-nās aktharuhum lā yafqahūn. Qad ẓaharat umm al-kitāb wa-tunādī bayna al-arḍ wa-al-samāʾ bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾ wa-tadʿu al-kull ilā al-maqām al-maḥmūd. Min al-nās man ankara wa-minhum man aʿraḍa wa-minhum man jādala bi-āyāt Allāh rabb mā kāna wa-mā yakūn wa-minhum man naqaḍa mīthāq Allāh wa-ʿahdahu bi-ẓulm nāḥa bihi ahl madāʾin al-asmāʾ wa-sukkān al-malakūt. Fa-lammā tafarrasnā wajadnā akthar aʿdāʾinā al-ʿulamāʾ. Kadhālika yaquṣṣu laka lisān al-Abhā min al-ufuq al-aʿlā innahu la-huwa al-Ḥaqq ʿAllām al-ghuyūb.
:::

::: {.translation}
O ʿAbbās! The Wronged One remembers you with a remembrance through which those brought near are drawn toward God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. The Hour has come, the call has risen, the cry has sounded, and the mountains have passed away, yet the people are unaware. The world has been overturned, the throne has been established, and the Lord of Revelation, who spoke on Sinai, has seated Himself upon it, yet most people do not understand. The Mother Book has appeared and calls out between earth and heaven with the loudest call, summoning everyone to the praised station. Among the people are those who have denied, those who have turned away, those who have disputed the verses of God, the Lord of all that has been and will be, and those who have broken God's covenant and His pledge with an injustice that has caused the inhabitants of the cities of names and the dwellers of the Kingdom to lament. When We looked discerningly, We found that most of Our enemies were the learned. Thus does the Tongue of the All-Glorious recount to you from the most exalted horizon. He is indeed the Truth, the Knower of things unseen.
:::

### 121

::: {.original lang="ar"}
انّا اظهرنا العلم لعرفان المعلوم فلمّا الاح افق الظّهور و اتی المعلوم انکره العلمآء فی اوّل الأمر الّا من شآء اللّه مالک الوجود قل یا معشر العلمآء ضعوا ما عندکم تاللّه قد ارتفع صریر القلم الأعلی و یبشّر الکلّ بظهور المعلوم الّذی توجّهتم الیه فیکلّ اصیل و بکور قل ما لی اراکم یا معشر الغافلین تقصدون البیت و تعرضون عن الّذی رفعه بأمر من عنده اتّقوا اللّه و لا تتّبعوا اهوائکم ان اتّبعوا من اتاکم بکتاب مشهود الّذی اذا ظهر خضعت له کتب العالم کلّها ان انصفوا یا قوم و لا تکونوا من الّذین کفروا بالشّاهد و المشهود هذا یوم وعدتم به فی صحف اللّه و کتبه و هذا امر اخذ عهده من عنده علم ما کان و ما یکون
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Innā aẓharnā al-ʿilm li-ʿirfān al-maʿlūm, fa-lammā alāḥa ufuq al-ẓuhūr wa-atā al-maʿlūm ankarahu al-ʿulamāʾ fī awwal al-amr illā man shāʾa Allāh Mālik al-wujūd. Qul yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ, ḍaʿū mā ʿindakum. Ta-Allāh qad irtafaʿa ṣarīr al-Qalam al-Aʿlā wa-yubashshiru al-kull bi-ẓuhūr al-maʿlūm alladhī tawajjahtum ilayhi fī kull aṣīl wa-bukūr. Qul mā lī arākum yā maʿshar al-ghāfilīn taqṣidūna al-Bayt wa-tuʿriḍūna ʿan alladhī rafaʿahu bi-amr min ʿindih. Ittaqū Allāh wa-lā tattabiʿū ahwāʾakum. In ittabiʿū man atākum bi-kitāb mashhūd alladhī idhā ẓahara khaḍaʿat lahu kutub al-ʿālam kulluhā. In anṣifū yā qawm wa-lā takūnū min alladhīna kafarū bi-al-shāhid wa-al-mashhūd. Hādhā yawm wuʿidtum bihi fī ṣuḥuf Allāh wa-kutubih, wa-hādhā amr akhadha ʿahdahu man ʿindahu ʿilm mā kāna wa-mā yakūn.
:::

::: {.translation}
We brought forth knowledge so that the One who is its object might be recognized. Yet when the horizon of revelation shone and that One came, the learned denied Him at the very outset, except those whom God, the Master of existence, willed otherwise. Say: O company of the learned! Set aside what you possess. By God, the sound of the Most Exalted Pen has risen, announcing to all the appearance of the One toward whom you turned every evening and morning. Say: Why do I see you, O company of the heedless, making your way to the House while turning away from Him who raised it by a command from Himself? Fear God and do not follow your desires. Rather, follow Him who has come to you with a manifest Book, before which, when it appeared, all the books of the world bowed down. Be fair, O people, and do not be among those who have denied the witness and the witnessed. This is the Day promised to you in the scrolls of God and His books, and this is the Cause whose covenant was taken by Him who possesses the knowledge of all that has been and will be.
:::

### 122

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل یا ملأ الظّالمین قد عملتم ما صاح به الملأ الأعلی و ناح اهل الفردوس و صعدت زفرات الجنّة العلیا و نزلت عبرات الملائکة و الرّوح قل ان کان عندکم اعظم عمّا اتی من جبروت الارادة فأتوا به و لا تتّبعوا کلّ جاهل مردود قل تعالوا لأریکم ما غفلتم عنه فی هذا الیوم الّذی نسب الی اللّه العزیز الودود هذا یوم فیه تضوّعت رائحة الرّحمن و فاحت نفحات الوحی و نطق عندلیب الأمر علی الأغصان الملک للّه مالک الملوک
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul yā malaʾ al-ẓālimīn, qad ʿamiltum mā ṣāḥa bihi al-Malaʾ al-Aʿlā wa-nāḥa ahl al-Firdaws wa-ṣaʿidat zafarāt al-janna al-ʿulyā wa-nazalat ʿabarāt al-malāʾika wa-al-Rūḥ. Qul in kāna ʿindakum aʿẓam ʿammā atā min jabarūt al-irāda faʾtū bihi wa-lā tattabiʿū kulla jāhil mardūd. Qul taʿālaw li-uriyakum mā ghafaltum ʿanhu fī hādhā al-yawm alladhī nusiba ilā Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Wadūd. Hādhā yawm fīhi taḍawwaʿat rāʾiḥat al-Raḥmān wa-fāḥat nafaḥāt al-waḥy wa-naṭaqa ʿandalīb al-amr ʿalā al-aghṣān: al-mulk li-Allāh Mālik al-mulūk.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: O company of the unjust! You have done what has caused the Concourse on High to cry out, the people of Paradise to lament, the sighs of the highest heaven to ascend, and the tears of the angels and the Spirit to fall. Say: If you possess anything greater than what has come from the dominion of the divine Will, bring it forth, and do not follow every ignorant outcast. Say: Come, that I may show you what you have overlooked in this Day that has been attributed to God, the Almighty, the All-Loving. This is a Day in which the fragrance of the All-Merciful has spread abroad, the breezes of revelation have wafted, and the Nightingale of the Cause has spoken upon the branches: “Sovereignty belongs to God, the King of kings.”
:::

### 123

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا عبّاس قم علی خدمة الأمر باسم ربّک مالک القدم و ذکّر النّاس بهذا النّبأ الأعظم الّذی اذا ظهر ارتعدت فرائص الأوهام و الظّنون ایّاک ان تمنعک عن مالک الأسمآء شوکة الأمرآء و شبهات العلمآء کن کالجبل الرّاسخ علی هذا الأمر المحتوم قل انّه اتی بالحقّ و لا یلتفت الی اقبالکم و اعراضکم ظهر و اظهر ما اراد رغماً لأنفکم لو انتم تعلمون انّه هو الّذی ینطق فیکلّ شأن انّه لا اله الّا انا الفرد الواحد العزیز المحبوب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿAbbās, qum ʿalā khidmat al-amr bi-ism rabbika Mālik al-qidam, wa-dhakkir al-nās bi-hādhā al-nabaʾ al-aʿẓam alladhī idhā ẓahara irtaʿadat farāʾiṣ al-awhām wa-al-ẓunūn. Iyyāka an tamnaʿaka ʿan Mālik al-asmāʾ shawkat al-umarāʾ wa-shubuhāt al-ʿulamāʾ. Kun ka-al-jabal al-rāsikh ʿalā hādhā al-amr al-maḥtūm. Qul innahu atā bi-al-ḥaqq wa-lā yaltafitu ilā iqbālikum wa-iʿrāḍikum. Ẓahara wa-aẓhara mā arāda raghman li-anfikum law antum taʿlamūn. Innahu huwa alladhī yanṭiqu fī kull shaʾn: innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-ʿAzīz al-Maḥbūb.
:::

::: {.translation}
O ʿAbbās! Arise to serve the Cause in the name of your Lord, the Master of eternity, and remind the people of this Most Great Announcement, whose appearance has made the limbs of vain imaginings and idle suppositions tremble. Beware lest the power of rulers and the doubts raised by the learned keep you from the Master of names. Be as a firmly rooted mountain in this irrevocable Cause. Say: He has come in truth and pays no heed to your acceptance or rejection. He has appeared and brought forth whatever He wished, despite you, if you only knew. He is the One who declares in every circumstance: “There is no God but Me, the Single, the One, the Almighty, the Beloved.”
:::

### 124

::: {.original lang="ar"}
کذلک فتحنا علی وجهک باب الفضل بمفتاح العدل اذا فزت به قل لک الحمد یا اله الغیب و الشّهود اشهد انّک نبذت الرّاحة لارتقآء الأمم و قبلت الذّلة لعزّ العالم و اخترت الغربة لبلوغ العباد الی الوطن الأعلی المقام الّذی جعله اللّه مقدّساً عمّا تدرکه العقول یا ایّها المتوجّه الی الوجه خذ الرّحیق المختوم باسم المظلوم ثمّ اشرب منه بهذا الذّکر الّذی به انجذبت الأرواح و القلوب انّا کتبنا لک اجر اللّقآء من قلمی الأعلی فی الصّحیفة الحمرآء ان افرح ثمّ اشکر ربّ البیت المعمور انّا قبلنا اقبالک و توجّهک و عملک فی سبیل اللّه طوبی لک بما زیّنت اعمالک بطراز القبول انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Kadhālika fataḥnā ʿalā wajhika bāb al-faḍl bi-miftāḥ al-ʿadl. Idhā fuzta bihi qul: laka al-ḥamd yā Ilāh al-ghayb wa-al-shuhūd. Ashhadu annaka nabadhta al-rāḥa li-irtiqāʾ al-umam wa-qabilta al-dhilla li-ʿizz al-ʿālam wa-ikhtarta al-ghurba li-bulūgh al-ʿibād ilā al-waṭan al-aʿlā, al-maqām alladhī jaʿalahu Allāh muqaddasan ʿammā tudrikuhu al-ʿuqūl. Yā ayyuhā al-mutawajjih ilā al-wajh, khudh al-raḥīq al-makhtūm bi-ism al-Maẓlūm thumma ishrab minhu bi-hādhā al-dhikr alladhī bihi injadhabat al-arwāḥ wa-al-qulūb. Innā katabnā laka ajr al-liqāʾ min qalamī al-aʿlā fī al-ṣaḥīfa al-ḥamrāʾ. In ifraḥ thumma ishkur Rabb al-Bayt al-Maʿmūr. Innā qabilnā iqbālaka wa-tawajjuhaka wa-ʿamalaka fī sabīl Allāh. Ṭūbā laka bi-mā zayyanat aʿmāluka bi-ṭirāz al-qabūl. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Thus We have opened before you the door of grace with the key of justice. When you attain it, say: “Praise be to You, O God of the unseen and the seen! I bear witness that You have cast aside comfort for the advancement of the nations, accepted abasement for the exaltation of the world, and chosen exile so that Your servants might reach the most exalted homeland, the station that God has sanctified beyond the grasp of minds.” O you who have turned toward the Face! Take the sealed wine in the name of the Wronged One, then drink from it with this remembrance through which souls and hearts have been drawn in rapture. With My Most Exalted Pen We have inscribed for you the reward of attaining Our presence upon the Crimson Scroll. Rejoice, then give thanks to the Lord of the Frequented House. We have accepted your turning toward Us, your devotion, and your work in the path of God. Blessed are you, for your deeds have been adorned with the ornament of acceptance. End.
:::

### 125

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا محبوب فؤادی گویا بر هر کلمه‌ئی از کلمات الهی یک منادی موجود و بأعلی النّدآء من فی الوجود را ندا مینماید سبحان‌اللّه عالم را چه واقع که از این فضل اکبر خود را محروم نموده‌اند و بما لا یسمن و لا یغنی مشغول گشته‌اند باری الحمد للّه جناب مذکور بشرافت کبری فائز و بذکر قلم اعلی مشرّف انشآءاللّه قدر اینمقام اعلی را بدانند و از سلسبیل و کوثر و تسنیم بیان الهی بنوشند و بنوشانند و آنمحبوب و این عبد بکلمهٴ هنیئاً ناطق شویم و مریئاً گوئیم حبّذا هذا العرف نمیدانم از کجا میآید الحمد لمظهره و مرسله و مبعثه و فاطره و خالقه و محدثه اینفانیهم خدمت ایشان تکبیر و سلام معروض میدارد و دعای توفیق استدعا مینماید انّ ربّنا الرّحمن علی کلّشیء قدیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā maḥbūb-i fuʾādī, gūyā bar har kalamiʾī az kalimāt-i ilāhī yak munādī mawjūd va bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾ man fī al-wujūd rā nidā mīnamāyad. Subḥān Allāh, ʿālam rā chih vāqiʿ kih az īn faḍl-i akbar khud rā maḥrūm namūdih-and va bi-mā lā yusmin wa-lā yughnī mashghūl gashtih-and. Bārī al-ḥamdu li-Allāh, jināb-i madhkūr bi-sharāfat-i kubrā fāʾiz va bi-dhikr-i Qalam-i Aʿlā musharraf. In shāʾa Allāh qadr-i īn maqām-i aʿlā rā bidānand va az Salsabīl va Kawthar va Tasnīm-i bayān-i ilāhī binūshand va binūshānand va ān maḥbūb va īn ʿabd bi-kalami-yi hanīʾan nāṭiq shavīm va marīʾan gūʾīm. Ḥabbadhā hādhā al-ʿarf, nimīdānam az kujā mīāyad. Al-ḥamd li-muẓhirihi wa-mursilihi wa-mabʿathihi wa-fāṭirihi wa-khāliqihi wa-muḥdithih. Īn fānī ham khidmat-i īshān takbīr va salām maʿrūḍ mīdārad va duʿā-yi tawfīq istidʿā mīnamāyad. Inna Rabbanā al-Raḥmān ʿalā kull shayʾ qadīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
O beloved of my heart! It is as though a herald stands upon every word of the divine utterances, calling at the top of his voice to all who exist. Glory be to God! What has happened to the world that its people have deprived themselves of this greatest grace and occupied themselves with what neither nourishes nor satisfies? In any event, praise be to God, the gentleman mentioned has attained the greatest honor and has been honored by the remembrance of the Most Exalted Pen. God willing, may he appreciate the value of this most exalted station, drink from the Salsabīl, Kawthar, and Tasnīm of divine utterance, and give others to drink, so that you, that beloved one, and this servant may utter the word “Delightful!” and say, “Wholesome!” How wonderful is this fragrance! I do not know where it comes from. Praise be to Him who manifests it, sends it forth, is its source, fashions it, creates it, and brings it into being. This mortal also offers him greetings of “God is most great” and peace, and requests his prayers for divine assistance. Our Lord, the All-Merciful, is indeed powerful over all things.
:::

### 126

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و ما ذکر حضرتکم فی جناب محمّد کریم الّذی هاجر فی سنة القبل قد فاز باصغآء ربّنا الرّحمن و نزّل له ما تفرح به افئدة العارفین قوله تمّت کلمته و کمل برهانه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-mā dhakarat ḥaḍratukum fī janāb Muḥammad Karīm alladhī hājara fī sanat al-qabl qad fāza bi-iṣghāʾ Rabbinā al-Raḥmān, wa-nuzzila lahu mā tafraḥu bihi afʾidat al-ʿārifīn. Qawluhu, tammat kalimatuhu wa-kamula burhānuh:
:::

::: {.translation}
What you mentioned concerning Muḥammad Karīm, who emigrated last year, has reached the hearing of our Lord, the All-Merciful, and there has been revealed for him that which gladdens the hearts of those who recognize Him. His words—perfect is His word and complete His proof:
:::

### 127

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی الّذی به نزل کلّ کتاب مبین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-ismī alladhī bihi nazala kull kitāb mubīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, through which every clear Book has been sent down.
:::

### 128

::: {.original lang="fa"}
شهد اللّه انّه لا اله الّا انا المهیمن القیّوم قد انزلنا الآیات و اظهرنا البیّنات و ارسلنا الرّسل لیبشّروا العباد بهذا الظّهور الّذی به ظهر ما کان مذکوراً بلسان الأنبیآء و مسطوراً فی کتب اللّه ربّ العالمین اذا ظهر الأمر و نزّلت الآیات و استقرّ هیکل الظّهور علی العرش قام النّاس علی الاعراض الّا من حفظته ید الاقتدار من لدن قویّ قدیر یا کریم ان استمع ما ینادیک به المظلوم من شطر السّجن و یذکرک بما تجد منه عرف البقآء انّ ربّک لهو العلیم الحکیم طوبی لوجه توجّه الی الأفق الأعلی و لرجل سلک سبیل اللّه العزیز الحمید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Shahida Allāh annahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Qad anzalnā al-āyāt wa-aẓharnā al-bayyināt wa-arsalnā al-rusul li-yubashshirū al-ʿibād bi-hādhā al-ẓuhūr alladhī bihi ẓahara mā kāna madhkūran bi-lisān al-anbiyāʾ wa-masṭūran fī kutub Allāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn. Idhā ẓahara al-amr wa-nuzzilat al-āyāt wa-istaqarra haykal al-ẓuhūr ʿalā al-ʿarsh qāma al-nās ʿalā al-iʿrāḍ illā man ḥafiẓathu yad al-iqtidār min ladun Qawiyy Qadīr. Yā Karīm, in istamiʿ mā yunādīka bihi al-Maẓlūm min shaṭr al-sijn wa-yadhkuruka bi-mā tajidu minhu ʿarf al-baqāʾ. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Ṭūbā li-wajh tawajjaha ilā al-ufuq al-aʿlā wa-li-rajul salaka sabīl Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd.
:::

::: {.translation}
God bears witness that there is no God but Me, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. We have sent down the verses, brought forth the clear proofs, and dispatched the Messengers to announce to the servants this Revelation, through which there has appeared what was spoken by the tongues of the Prophets and inscribed in the books of God, the Lord of the worlds. When the Cause appeared, the verses were sent down, and the Temple of Revelation was established upon the throne, the people rose up in rejection, except those whom the hand of might protected on behalf of One who is Strong and Powerful. O Karīm! Listen to what the Wronged One calls to you from the direction of the prison, remembering you with words from which you may perceive the fragrance of everlasting life. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Blessed is the face that has turned toward the most exalted horizon, and the man who has walked the path of God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.
:::

### 129

::: {.original lang="ar"}
انّا سمعنا ندائک اذ وجدت عرف قمیصی من شطر الحجاز المقام الّذی نوّرناه بأنوار وجه محمّد رسول اللّه و خاتم النّبیّین انّا سمعنا ذکرک من قبل و ذکرناک فی کتاب ما اطّلع به الّا الفرد الخبیر طوبی لمن نبذ الهوی و اتّبع ما امر به من لدی اللّه مالک الوری انّه من اعلی الخلق فی کتابه المبین نعیماً لک بما نبذت الأوهام عن ورائک مقبلاً الی مشرق وحی ربّک الرّحمن الرّحیم انّه ینصر من یشآء بسلطان من عنده و یهدی المقبلین الی صراطه المستقیم هذا یوم فیه ظهر ما لا ظهر فی ازل الآزال یشهد بذلک من ینطق بالحقّ فیکلّ شأن انّه لا اله الّا انا العلیّ العظیم انّک اذا فزت بکتابی و وجدت عرف بیانی سبّح بحمد ربّک ثمّ اشکره بهذا الفضل الّذی ما رأت عین الابداع شبهه یشهد بذلک کلّ عالم منصف و کلّ عارف بصیر لا تحزن من شیء قد قبل ما عملته فی سبیله انّه لا یضیع اجر المحسنین کذلک انار افق البیان بنیّر ذکر ربّک المشفق الکریم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Innā samiʿnā nidāʾaka idh wajadta ʿarf qamīṣī min shaṭr al-Ḥijāz, al-maqām alladhī nawwarnāhu bi-anwār wajh Muḥammad Rasūl Allāh wa-Khātam al-Nabiyyīn. Innā samiʿnā dhikraka min qabl wa-dhakarnāka fī kitāb mā iṭṭalaʿa bihi illā al-Fard al-Khabīr. Ṭūbā li-man nabadha al-hawā wa-ittabaʿa mā umira bihi min ladā Allāh Mālik al-warā. Innahu min aʿlā al-khalq fī kitābihi al-mubīn. Naʿīman laka bi-mā nabadhta al-awhām ʿan warāʾika muqbilan ilā mashriq waḥy rabbika al-Raḥmān al-Raḥīm. Innahu yanṣuru man yashāʾ bi-sulṭān min ʿindihi wa-yahdī al-muqbilīn ilā ṣirāṭihi al-mustaqīm. Hādhā yawm fīhi ẓahara mā lā ẓahara fī azal al-āzāl. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man yanṭiqu bi-al-ḥaqq fī kull shaʾn: innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿAliyy al-ʿAẓīm. Innaka idhā fuzta bi-kitābī wa-wajadta ʿarf bayānī sabbiḥ bi-ḥamd rabbika thumma ishkurhu bi-hādhā al-faḍl alladhī mā raʾat ʿayn al-ibdāʿ shibhah. Yashhadu bi-dhālika kull ʿālim munṣif wa-kull ʿārif baṣīr. Lā taḥzan min shayʾ, qad qubila mā ʿamiltahu fī sabīlih. Innahu lā yuḍīʿu ajr al-muḥsinīn. Kadhālika anāra ufuq al-bayān bi-nayyir dhikr rabbika al-Mushfiq al-Karīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
We heard your call when you perceived the fragrance of My robe from the direction of the Ḥijāz, the place We illumined with the lights of the face of Muḥammad, the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets. We heard your remembrance before and remembered you in a Book known to none but the Unique, the All-Informed. Blessed is the one who has cast aside desire and followed what he was commanded by God, the Master of creation. He is among the most exalted of creation in His clear Book. Joy be yours, for you have cast vain imaginings behind you and turned toward the Dawning-Place of the revelation of your Lord, the All-Merciful, the Merciful. He aids whomever He wills with authority from Himself and guides those who turn toward Him to His straight path. This is a Day in which there has appeared what never appeared in the eternity of eternities. To this bears witness the One who declares the truth in every circumstance: “There is no God but Me, the Most High, the Most Great.” When you receive My letter and perceive the fragrance of My utterance, glorify your Lord with praise, then thank Him for this grace, the like of which the eye of creation has never seen. Every fair-minded scholar and every discerning person of understanding bears witness to this. Do not grieve over anything. What you have done in His path has been accepted. He does not let the reward of those who do good be lost. Thus has the horizon of utterance been illumined by the luminary of the remembrance of your Lord, the Compassionate, the Generous. End.
:::

### 130

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هذه نعمة اخری و رحمة اخری و فضل آخر لمن اقبل الیه و تقرّب الی ساحة قدسه و استنشق الهوآء الّذی کان مجاوراً هوآء هذا السّجن المنیع انشآءاللّه از نار محبّت الهی که از هر حرفی از حروفاتش ظاهر و باهر است مشتعل شوند و باستقامت تمام بحکمت و بیان بذکرش ناطق له الفضل و المنّة فیکلّ الأحوال و هو الفضّال فی ازل الآزال
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Hādhihi niʿma ukhrā wa-raḥma ukhrā wa-faḍl ākhar li-man aqbala ilayhi wa-taqarraba ilā sāḥat qudsihi wa-istanshaqa al-hawāʾ alladhī kāna mujāwiran hawāʾ hādhā al-sijn al-manīʿ. In shāʾa Allāh az nār-i maḥabbat-i ilāhī kih az har ḥarfī az ḥurūfātash ẓāhir va bāhir ast mushtaʿil shavand va bi-istiqāmat-i tamām bi-ḥikmat va bayān bi-dhikrih nāṭiq. Lahu al-faḍl wa-al-minna fī kull al-aḥwāl wa-huwa al-Faḍḍāl fī azal al-āzāl.
:::

::: {.translation}
This is another blessing, another mercy, and another grace for one who has turned toward Him, drawn near to the court of His holiness, and breathed the air that was adjacent to the air of this inaccessible prison. God willing, may he be set ablaze by the fire of divine love that is manifest and radiant in every one of its letters, and with complete steadfastness, wisdom, and eloquence speak His remembrance. His are grace and bounty in all circumstances, and He is the All-Bountiful from the eternity of eternities.
:::

### 131

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه آنمحبوب ذکر نفوس مقبله علیهم بهآء اللّه فرموده بودند در ساحت اقدس کان اللّه و لم یکن معه من شیء واحداً بعد واحد عرض شد و مخصوص هر یک از سماء مشیّت نازل شد آنچه که غریب را بوطن هدایت کند و تشنه را بسلسبیل و عاشقرا بمعشوق رساند و طالب را بشطر مطلوب کشاند قال عظم احسانه و جلّ کبریائه و احاط فضله و علا سلطانه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnkih ān maḥbūb dhikr-i nufūs-i muqbilih, ʿalayhim Bahāʾ Allāh, farmūdih būdand, dar sāḥat-i aqdas, kāna Allāh wa-lam yakun maʿahu min shayʾ, wāḥidan baʿda wāḥid ʿarḍ shud va makhṣūṣ-i har yak az samāʾ-i mashiyyat nāzil shud ānchih kih gharīb rā bi-waṭan hidāyat kunad va tishnih rā bi-Salsabīl va ʿāshiq rā bi-maʿshūq rasānad va ṭālib rā bi-shaṭr-i maṭlūb kishānad. Qāla, ʿaẓuma iḥsānuhu wa-jalla kibriyāʾuhu wa-aḥāṭa faḍluhu wa-ʿalā sulṭānuh:
:::

::: {.translation}
As for those souls who have turned toward Him—upon them be the glory of God—whom you, that beloved one, had mentioned, they were presented one by one in the Most Holy Court: “God was, and nothing was with Him.” For each one specifically there descended from the heaven of the divine Will that which guides the stranger to his homeland, brings the thirsty to Salsabīl and the lover to the beloved, and draws the seeker toward the One he seeks. He said—great is His beneficence, glorious His majesty, all-encompassing His grace, and exalted His sovereignty:
:::

### 132

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المشرق من افق سمآء ملکوتی العظیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-ismī al-mushriq min ufuq samāʾ malakūtī al-ʿaẓīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, shining from the horizon of the heaven of My mighty Kingdom.
:::

### 133

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا سلیم یذکرک الکریم من شطر السّجن خالصاً لوجهه لتسمع صریر قلمی الأعلی و هدیر طیر البقآء علی اغصان سدرة المنتهی انّه لا اله الّا انا العلیم الخبیر طوبی لقلب انجذب بآیات اللّه و لوجه توجّه الیه و للّسان نطق بذکره البدیع لا تنظر الی العلمآء و کبریائهم ان انظر الی من یذکرک فی هذا السّجن العظیم قل انّه ظهر بالحقّ و قام علی الأمر بسلطان ما منعته شئونات الأوهام و لا حجّبته حجبات المعرضین کم من عالم منع عن فضل اللّه و رحمته و کم من امّیّ فاز بهذا الرّحیق المنیر ان اشکر اللّه بما عرّفک مطلع الأمر و مشرق الوحی و عصمک عن شبهات الّذین کفروا ببرهانه القویم ان استقم علی حبّ اللّه و امره علی شأن یجد منک الموحّدون عرف الاستقامة فیهذا النّبأ الّذی استبشر به الملأ الأعلی و اهل الفردوس علی مقام کریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Salīm, yadhkuruka al-Karīm min shaṭr al-sijn khāliṣan li-wajhihi li-tasmaʿa ṣarīr qalamī al-aʿlā wa-hadīr ṭayr al-baqāʾ ʿalā aghṣān Sidrat al-Muntahā. Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr. Ṭūbā li-qalb injadhaba bi-āyāt Allāh wa-li-wajh tawajjaha ilayhi wa-li-lisān naṭaqa bi-dhikrihi al-badīʿ. Lā tanẓur ilā al-ʿulamāʾ wa-kibriyāʾihim. In inẓur ilā man yadhkuruka fī hādhā al-sijn al-ʿaẓīm. Qul innahu ẓahara bi-al-ḥaqq wa-qāma ʿalā al-amr bi-sulṭān mā manaʿathu shuʾūnāt al-awhām wa-lā ḥajjabathu ḥujubāt al-muʿriḍīn. Kam min ʿālim muniʿa ʿan faḍl Allāh wa-raḥmatihi wa-kam min ummiyy fāza bi-hādhā al-raḥīq al-munīr. In ishkur Allāh bi-mā ʿarrafaka maṭlaʿ al-amr wa-mashriq al-waḥy wa-ʿaṣamaka ʿan shubuhāt alladhīna kafarū bi-burhānihi al-qawīm. In istaqim ʿalā ḥubb Allāh wa-amrihi ʿalā shaʾn yajidu minka al-muwaḥḥidūn ʿarf al-istiqāma fī hādhā al-nabaʾ alladhī istabshara bihi al-Malaʾ al-Aʿlā wa-ahl al-Firdaws ʿalā maqām karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Salīm! The Generous One remembers you from the direction of the prison, solely for His own sake, so that you may hear the sound of My Most Exalted Pen and the call of the Bird of everlasting life upon the branches of the Lote-Tree of the Utmost Boundary. There is no God but Me, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Blessed is the heart enraptured by the verses of God, the face that has turned toward Him, and the tongue that has spoken His wondrous remembrance. Do not look at the learned and their arrogance. Rather, look toward Him who remembers you in this mighty prison. Say: He has appeared in truth and arisen for the Cause with an authority that the workings of vain imaginings have neither hindered nor the veils of those who turn away obscured. How many a learned person has been kept from the grace of God and His mercy, and how many an unlettered person has attained this luminous wine! Thank God for enabling you to recognize the Dawning-Place of the Cause and the Dayspring of revelation, and for protecting you from the doubts raised by those who have denied His firm proof. Be steadfast in the love of God and His Cause, so that those who affirm His unity may perceive from you the fragrance of steadfastness in this Announcement, which has gladdened the Concourse on High and the people of Paradise in a noble station.
:::

### 134

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و هذا ما نزل لمن سمّی بمیرزا ابوالحسن
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-hādhā mā nazala li-man summiya bi-Mīrzā Abū al-Ḥasan.
:::

::: {.translation}
And this is what was revealed for the one named Mīrzā Abū al-Ḥasan.
:::

### 135

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی العلیم الحکیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-ismī al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
:::

### 136

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا اباالحسن ذکرت نزد مظلوم مذکور و سماء بیان رحمن بتو متوجّه این آسمانیست که سیّارات آن تا حین احصا نشده و نخواهد شد و شموس و اقمار آن لازال فی قطب الزّوال لائح و مشرق هر حکیمی از احصایش متحیّر و هر قویّ قادری از ادراک و تحدیدش عاجز و ترا وصیّت مینماید براستی و انصاف چه اگر جمیع خلق عالم بطراز انصاف مزیّن می‌شدند از عرفان اسم اعظم و مالک قدم محروم نمیگشتند اینمظلوم بگمان اهل ظنون بغیر ما حکم به اللّه حکم نمود حضرت رسول و خاتم انبیا روح ما سواه فداه چه تقصیر بر او ثابت که در سنین متوالیات بر اذیّتش قیام نمودند برخی کاذبش گفتند و بعضی مجنون و حزبی ساحر و قومی مفتری جمیع آنچه ذکر شد آنعبد و سایر عباد شنیده‌اند و دانسته‌اند از آن وجود مبارک گذشته در حضرت روح تفکّر نما که سبب چه بود که من علی الأرض بر انکارش قیام نمودند وارد شد بر مظاهر امر الهی آنچه که هر صاحب انصافی گریست و نوحه نمود سبب و علّت اعراض در هر عصر و قرن علمای آن زمان بودند که حبّ ریاست ایشانرا از اقبال منع مینمود الا انّهم فی ضلال مبین امید هست که آنجناب در مامضی تفکّر نماید و بصراط مستقیم الهی پی‌برد
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Abā al-Ḥasan, dhekrat nazd-e Maẓlūm madhkūr va samā-ye bayān-e Raḥmān be to motavajjeh. Īn āsmānīst ke sayyārāt-e ān tā ḥīn eḥṣā nashodeh va nakhāhad shod va shomūs va aqmār-e ān lā yazāl fī quṭb al-zawāl lāʾeḥ va moshreq. Har ḥakīmī az eḥṣāyash motaḥayyer va har qaviyy-e qāderī az edrāk va taḥdīdash ʿājez. Va to rā vaṣiyyat mīnamāyad be rāstī va enṣāf, che agar jamīʿ-e khalq-e ʿālam be ṭerāz-e enṣāf mozayyan mīshodand az ʿerfān-e Esm-e Aʿẓam va Mālek-e Qedam maḥrūm nemīgashtand. Īn Maẓlūm be gomān-e ahl-e ẓonūn be ghayr-e mā ḥakama bihi Allāh ḥokm namūd. Ḥażrat-e Rasūl va Khātam-e Anbiyā, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, che taqṣīr bar ū thābet ke dar senīn-e motavāleyāt bar adhiyyatash qīyām namūdand? Barkhī kādhebash goftand va baʿżī majnūn va ḥezbī sāḥer va qowmī moftarī. Jamīʿ-e ānche dhekr shod ān ʿabd va sāyer-e ʿebād shenīdeh-and va dānesteh-and. Az ān vojūd-e mobārak godhashteh dar Ḥażrat-e Rūḥ tafakkor namā ke sabab che būd ke man ʿalā al-arḍ bar enkārash qīyām namūdand. Vāred shod bar maẓāher-e Amr-e Elāhī ānche ke har ṣāḥeb-e enṣāfī gerīst va nowḥeh namūd. Sabab va ʿellat-e eʿrāż dar har ʿaṣr va qarn ʿolamā-ye ān zamān būdand ke ḥobb-e reyāsat īshān rā az eqbāl manʿ mīnamūd. A-lā innahum fī ḍalālin mubīn. Omīd hast ke ān janāb dar mā mażā tafakkor namāyad va be ṣerāṭ-e mostaqīm-e Elāhī pey barad.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Abū al-Ḥasan, you have been mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One, and the heaven of the All-Merciful’s utterance is turned toward you. This is a heaven whose planets have not yet been counted and never will be, and whose suns and moons are forever radiant and shining at the pole of decline. Every sage is bewildered at counting them, and every mighty and capable person is powerless to comprehend or delimit it. He counsels you to be truthful and fair, for if all the people of the world had adorned themselves with fairness, they would not have been deprived of recognizing the Most Great Name and the Lord of Eternity. In the estimation of those given to conjecture, this Wronged One has ruled contrary to what God has decreed. What fault was established against the Messenger and Seal of the Prophets—may the souls of all others be sacrificed for Him—that they rose up to torment Him for successive years? Some called Him a liar, others a madman, one faction a sorcerer, and another an impostor. That servant and the other servants have heard and known all that has been mentioned. Passing beyond that blessed Being, reflect on the Spirit: what caused those on earth to rise up in denial of Him? What befell the Manifestations of the Cause of God made every fair-minded person weep and lament. In every age and century, the cause and source of rejection were the religious scholars of that time, whose love of leadership prevented them from turning toward Him. Indeed, they are in manifest error. It is hoped that you will reflect on what has passed and find the straight path of God.
:::

### 137

::: {.original lang="ar"}
شک و شبهه‌ئی نبوده و نیست که اینمظلوم للّه میگوید و الی اللّه میخواند لا یضرّه الاعراض و لا ینفعه الاقبال ظنون و اوهام خلقرا بخلق گذار و بقلب منیر بحقّ جلّ جلاله توجّه نما که شاید باب معرفت بر وجهت بگشاید و از انوار وجه بعد فناء اشیاء ترا محروم نفرماید انّه یقول الحقّ و یهدی النّاس الی افقه المنیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Shakk va shobheʾī nabūdeh va nīst ke īn Maẓlūm li-llāh mīgūyad va ilā Allāh mīkhānad. Lā yaḍurruhu al-iʿrāḍ wa-lā yanfaʿuhu al-iqbāl. Ẓonūn va owhām-e khalq rā be khalq godhār va be qalb-e monīr be Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, tavajjoh namā ke shāyad bāb-e maʿrefat bar vajhat bogshāyad va az anvār-e vajh baʿd-e fanā-ye ashyā to rā maḥrūm nafarmāyad. Innahu yaqūlu al-ḥaqq wa-yahdī al-nāsa ilā ufuqihi al-munīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
There has never been, nor is there now, any doubt that this Wronged One speaks for God and summons people to God. Rejection does not harm Him, nor does acceptance benefit Him. Leave the people’s conjectures and imaginings to them, and turn with a radiant heart toward the True One, exalted be His glory, so that He may open the gate of recognition before you and not deprive you of the lights of His face after all things have passed away. He speaks the truth and guides people to His luminous horizon.
:::

### 138

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و هذا ما نزل لجناب مشهدی نصراللّه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-hādhā mā nazala li-Janāb-i Mashhadī Naṣr Allāh.
:::

::: {.translation}
And this is what was revealed for Mashhadī Naṣr Allāh.
:::

### 139

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المهیمن علی الأسمآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-Muhaymin ʿalā al-asmāʾ.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Guardian over all names.
:::

### 140

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا نصراللّه یذکرک مولی الوری اذ کان مسجوناً فی هذا المقام البعید و یبشّرک بفضل اللّه و رحمته انّه ما من اله الّا هو یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید ان اشهد بما شهد اللّه انّه لا اله الّا انا الفرد الخبیر قد ذکرت لدی المظلوم و نزل لک هذه الآیات الّتی لا یعادلها ما خلق فی الأرض یشهد بذلک ربّک العلیم طوبی لک بما نبذت شبهات القوم و شربت من بحر الیقین ان اعرف مقام من هداک ثمّ اشکر ربّک المؤیّد الکریم ایّاک ان تحزنک شئونات الخلق او تخوّفک الملوک و السّلاطین ینبغی لکلّ من اقبل الی افقی ان یترک الأرض و ما علیها لهم و یتوجّه الی فتح القلوب باسمی العزیز الحکیم انّ الأموال لأهل الجلال و القلوب للّه ربّ العالمین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Naṣr Allāh, yadhkuruka Mawlā al-warā idh kāna masjūnan fī hādhā al-maqām al-baʿīd wa-yubashshiruka bi-faḍli Allāh wa-raḥmatihi. Innahu mā min ilāhin illā Huwa, yafʿalu mā yashāʾ wa-yaḥkumu mā yurīd. An ishhad bi-mā shahida Allāh: innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Fard al-Khabīr. Qad dhukirta ladā al-Maẓlūm wa-nazala laka hādhihi al-āyāt allatī lā yuʿādiluhā mā khuliqa fī al-arḍ. Yashhadu bi-dhālika rabbuka al-ʿAlīm. Ṭūbā laka bi-mā nabadhta shubuhāti al-qawm wa-sharibta min baḥr al-yaqīn. An iʿraf maqāma man hadāka thumma ushkur rabbaka al-Muʾayyid al-Karīm. Iyyāka an tuḥzinaka shuʾūnu al-khalq aw tukhawwifaka al-mulūk wa-al-salāṭīn. Yanbaghī li-kulli man aqbala ilā ufuqī an yatruka al-arḍ wa-mā ʿalayhā lahum wa-yatawajjaha ilā fatḥ al-qulūb bi-smī al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥakīm. Inna al-amwāla li-ahl al-jalāl wa-al-qulūba li-llāhi rabb al-ʿālamīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Naṣr Allāh, the Lord of humanity remembers you while imprisoned in this remote place, and gives you the glad tidings of God’s grace and mercy. There is no god but Him. He does what He wills and decrees what He desires. Bear witness to what God has testified: “There is no god but Me, the Unique, the All-Aware.” You have been mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One, and these verses have been revealed for you, verses that nothing created on earth can equal. Your Lord, the All-Knowing, bears witness to this. Blessed are you for having cast aside the people’s doubts and drunk from the ocean of certitude. Recognize the station of Him who guided you, then thank your Lord, the Sustainer, the Generous. Beware lest the affairs of the people grieve you or kings and sovereigns frighten you. Everyone who has turned toward My horizon should leave the earth and all that is upon it to them, and set about winning hearts through My name, the Almighty, the All-Wise. Wealth belongs to the people of worldly grandeur, and hearts belong to God, the Lord of the worlds.
:::

### 141

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و نذکر فیهذا المقام من سمّی بأبی‌القاسم الّذی هاجر الی ان فاز بلقآء ربّه العزیز الکریم و نوصیه بالاستقامة علی هذا الأمر الأعظم و ندعو له ما ینبغی لفضل اللّه العلیّ العظیم البهآء علی اهل البهآء الّذین فازوا بذکری الجمیل انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru fī hādhā al-maqām man summiya bi-Abī al-Qāsim alladhī hājara ilā an fāza bi-liqāʾi rabbihi al-ʿAzīz al-Karīm, wa-nūṣīhi bi-al-istiqāmati ʿalā hādhā al-Amr al-Aʿẓam wa-nadʿū lahu mā yanbaghī li-faḍli Allāh al-ʿAliyy al-ʿAẓīm. Al-Bahāʾ ʿalā ahl al-Bahāʾ alladhīna fāzū bi-dhikrī al-jamīl. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
And here We remember the one named Abū al-Qāsim, who emigrated until he attained the presence of his Lord, the Almighty, the Generous. We counsel him to remain steadfast in this Most Great Cause, and pray for him as befits the grace of God, the Most High, the Magnificent. Glory rest upon the people of Bahāʾ who have attained My gracious remembrance. End.
:::

### 142

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این خادم فانی از رحمت و عنایت مقصود عالمیان امیدوار است که ید عنایتش کلّ را اخذ نماید و از جحیم سفلی بجنّت علیا کشاند انّه لا یعجزه من شیء و لا یعزب عن علمه من امر یعطی بالفضل و یمنع بالحکمة و هو المقتدر الآمر المرید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn khādem-e fānī az raḥmat va ʿenāyat-e Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān omīdvār ast ke yad-e ʿenāyatash koll rā akhdh namāyad va az jaḥīm-e soflā be jannat-e ʿolyā kashānad. Innahu lā yuʿjizuhu min shayʾ wa-lā yaʿzubu ʿan ʿilmihi min amr. Yuʿṭī bi-al-faḍl wa-yamnaʿu bi-al-ḥikmah wa-Huwa al-Muqtadir al-Āmir al-Murīd.
:::

::: {.translation}
This ephemeral servant hopes, through the mercy and loving-kindness of the Desire of all the worlds, that the hand of His loving-kindness will take hold of everyone and draw them from the lowest hell to the highest paradise. Nothing can frustrate Him, and no matter escapes His knowledge. He gives through grace and withholds through wisdom. He is the All-Powerful, the Ordainer, the One who wills.
:::

### 143

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ ملّا محمّد علیه ٦٦٩ \[بهآء اللّه\] از اهل یا مرقوم داشتید و هم‌چنین ارتقاء ایشان بمرقاة البیان الی سماء عرفان ربّنا الرّحمن عرض شد اینکلمات عالیات از مظهر علم الهی و مصدر امر ربّانی و فی‌الحقیقه مقام لا یعرف و لا یذکر در بارهٴ ایشان ظاهر و نازل قوله تبارک و تعالی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāre-ye Mollā Moḥammad, ʿalayhi 669 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\], az ahl-e Yā marqūm dāshtīd va ham-chenīn erteqā-ye īshān be merqāt al-bayān ilā samāʾi ʿirfāni Rabbinā al-Raḥmān ʿarż shod. Īn kalemāt-e ʿāliyāt az Maẓhar-e ʿElm-e Elāhī va Maṣdar-e Amr-e Rabbānī va fī al-ḥaqīqeh Maqām-e lā yuʿraf wa-lā yudhkar dar bāre-ye īshān ẓāher va nāzel. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā:
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning Mullā Muḥammad, upon him be 669 \[the glory of God\], a native of Yā, and likewise his ascent by the ladder of utterance to the heaven of recognition of our Lord, the All-Merciful, was presented. These exalted words concerning him appeared and were revealed from the Manifestation of divine knowledge and the Source of the Lord’s command, and, in truth, from the Station that can neither be known nor mentioned. His words, blessed and exalted is He:
:::

### 144

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بنام گویندهٴ پاینده
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Be nām-e Gūyande-ye Pāyandeh.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of the Everlasting Speaker.
:::

### 145

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا محمّد از حقّ میطلبیم ترا مؤیّد فرماید بر عرفان و ایقان و خدمت امرش بشأنیکه اگر اهل عالم بر اعراض قیام نمایند قادر بر منع آنجناب نباشند امروز روح اللّه در برّیّهٴ ارض مقدّسه ندا مینماید و نور اللّه از افق اراده مشرق و عرف قمیص متضوّع و نسمات وحی در مرور مع‌ذلک عباد در ضلالت خود باقی و برقرار جهد نما تا از کوثر عرفان رحمن بیاشامی و از مائدهٴ منزله قسمت بری و بحکمت و بیان اهل امکانرا بافق اعلی هدایت نمائی ناس غافلند مبیّن لازم بر خدمت امر حقّ قیام نما تا مخدوم عالم شوی و بنار حبّش مشتعل شو تا محبوب آفاق گردی اگرچه کشف بعضی از اسرار شده ولکن اکثری از آن در علم الهی مستور و مکنون چه اگر اسرار یوم اللّه و مقامات نفوس موقنهٴ مطمئنّه اقلّ از سمّ ابره ظاهر شود جمیع ناسرا طائف مطاف ماکان و مایکون مشاهده نمائی باسم حقّ بایست و بتدارک مافات قیام نما وقت بسیار عزیز است بل اعزّ از کبریت احمر ناسرا باخلاق روحانیّه و اعمال طیّبه وصیّت نما طوبی از برای نفوسیکه للّه عاملند و الی اللّه متوجّه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Moḥammad, az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm to rā moʾayyad farmāyad bar ʿerfān va īqān va khedmat-e Amrash be shaʾnī ke agar ahl-e ʿālam bar eʿrāż qīyām namāyand qāder bar manʿ-e ān janāb nabāshand. Emrūz Rūḥ Allāh dar barriyye-ye Arż-e Moqaddaseh nedā mīnamāyad va Nūr Allāh az ofoq-e erādeh moshreq va ʿarf-e qamīṣ motaḍavveʿ va nasamāt-e vaḥy dar morūr. Maʿa dhālek ʿebād dar żalālat-e khod bāqī va barqarār. Jahd namā tā az kowthar-e ʿerfān-e Raḥmān biyāshāmī va az māʾede-ye monazzaleh qesmat barī va be ḥekmat va bayān ahl-e emkān rā be Ofoq-e Aʿlā hedāyat namāʾī. Nās ghāfeland, mobayyen lāzem. Bar khedmat-e Amr-e Ḥaqq qīyām namā tā makhdūm-e ʿālam shavī va be nār-e ḥobbash moshtaʿel show tā maḥbūb-e āfāq gardī. Agarche kashf-e baʿżī az asrār shodeh va-lāken aktharī az ān dar ʿelm-e Elāhī mastūr va maknūn, che agar asrār-e Yawm Allāh va maqāmāt-e nofūs-e mūqene-ye moṭmaʾenneh aqall az samm-e ebreh ẓāher shavad jamīʿ-e nās rā ṭāʾef-e maṭāf-e mā kān va mā yakūn moshāhedeh namāʾī. Be nām-e Ḥaqq beʾīst va be tadārok-e mā fāt qīyām namā. Vaqt besyār ʿazīz ast bal aʿazz az kebrīt-e aḥmar. Nās rā be akhlāq-e rūḥāniyyeh va aʿmāl-e ṭayyebeh vaṣiyyat namā. Ṭūbā az barā-ye nofūsī ke li-llāh ʿāmeland va ilā Allāh motavajjeh.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Muḥammad, We ask the True One to strengthen you in recognition, certitude, and service to His Cause, so that even if all the people of the world should rise up in rejection, they would be powerless to hinder you. Today the Spirit of God calls out in the wilderness of the Holy Land, the Light of God shines from the horizon of His will, the fragrance of the garment is diffused, and the breezes of revelation are passing. Yet the servants remain fixed in their error. Strive to drink from the Kawthar of recognition of the All-Merciful, to receive a share of the table sent down from heaven, and to guide the inhabitants of the contingent world to the Most Exalted Horizon through wisdom and utterance. People are heedless; an expounder is needed. Arise to serve the Cause of the True One, so that you may become one whom the world serves, and be kindled with the fire of His love, so that you may become beloved throughout the world. Although some mysteries have been disclosed, most remain concealed and hidden in the knowledge of God. For if less than a needle’s eye of the mysteries of the Day of God and the stations of assured souls possessed of certitude were revealed, you would see all people circling the One around whom all that has been and will be revolves. Stand firm in the name of the True One and arise to make good what has been lost. Time is exceedingly precious, indeed more precious than red sulphur. Counsel people to adopt spiritual qualities and perform good deeds. Blessed are those souls who act for God and turn toward God.
:::

### 146

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل یا ملأ الأرض ایّاکم ان تمنعکم کتب العالم عن کتاب اللّه المهیمن القیّوم الّذی نزّل من سمآء الفضل من لدی الحقّ علّام الغیوب قل تاللّه لا ینفعکم ما عند النّاس اتّقوا الرّحمن ثمّ اقبلوا الیه بوجوه بیضآء و قلوب نورآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul yā malaʾ al-arḍ, iyyākum an tamnaʿakum kutubu al-ʿālam ʿan Kitābi Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm alladhī nuzzila min samāʾ al-faḍl min ladā al-Ḥaqq ʿAllām al-ghuyūb. Qul ta-Allāh, lā yanfaʿukum mā ʿinda al-nās. Ittaqū al-Raḥmān thumma aqbilū ilayhi bi-wujūhin bayḍāʾ wa-qulūbin nawrāʾ.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: O peoples of the earth, beware lest the books of the world keep you from the Book of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, which has been sent down from the heaven of grace by the True One, the Knower of the unseen. Say: By God, what people possess will not benefit you. Be mindful of the All-Merciful, then turn toward Him with radiant faces and luminous hearts.
:::

### 147

::: {.original lang="fa"}
کذلک یأمرکم من فی قبضته زمام العلوم قل یا معشر العلمآء طهّروا قلوبکم عمّا عندکم لتسمعوا صریر القلم الأعلی و حفیف سدرة المنتهی من المقام المحمود هذا یوم لا تغنیکم کنوز العالم و لا صفوف الأمم دعوها عن ورائکم رجآء ما عند اللّه ربّ ما کان و ما یکون انّا نوصیک و الّذین آمنوا بالاستقامة الکبری علی هذا الأمر الّذی به اضطربت ارکان الأسمآء الّا من شآء اللّه مالک الوجود کذلک ماج بحر بیانی و هاج عرف عنایتی انّک اذا رأیت و وجدت قم و قل اشهد انّک قبلت اذی العالم لارتفاع امر اللّه و حملت البلایا فی حبّ اللّه فاطر السّمآء و مالک الأسمآء الی ان قبلت السّجن الأعظم لنجاة الأمم اسئلک بالاسم الأعظم الّذی به سخّرت ملکوت الأسمآء بأن لا تخیّبنی عمّا عندک و لا تمنعنی عمّا قدّرته لأمنائک و اصفیائک ایربّ ترانی مقبلاً الیک و متمسّکاً بحبلک اسئلک بأن تؤیّدنی علی الاستقامة علی هذا الأمر الّذی به زلّت اقدام اکثر خلقک لا اله الّا انت المتعالی المشفق الغفور الکریم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Kadhālika yaʾmurukum man fī qabḍatihi zimāmu al-ʿulūm. Qul yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ, ṭahhirū qulūbakum ʿammā ʿindakum li-tasmaʿū ṣarīra al-Qalam al-Aʿlā wa-ḥafīfa Sidrat al-Muntahā min al-maqām al-maḥmūd. Hādhā yawmun lā tughnīkum kunūzu al-ʿālam wa-lā ṣufūfu al-umam. Daʿūhā ʿan warāʾikum rajāʾa mā ʿinda Allāhi rabbi mā kāna wa-mā yakūn. Innā nūṣīka wa-alladhīna āmanū bi-al-istiqāmati al-kubrā ʿalā hādhā al-Amr alladhī bihi iḍṭarabat arkānu al-asmāʾ illā man shāʾa Allāhu Mālik al-wujūd. Kadhālika māja baḥru bayānī wa-hāja ʿarfu ʿināyatī. Innaka idhā raʾayta wa-wajadta qum wa-qul: Ashhadu annaka qabilta adhā al-ʿālam li-irtifāʿi Amri Allāh wa-ḥamalta al-balāyā fī ḥubbi Allāhi Fāṭir al-samāʾ wa-Mālik al-asmāʾ ilā an qabilta al-Sijn al-Aʿẓam li-najāti al-umam. Asʾaluka bi-al-Ism al-Aʿẓam alladhī bihi sakhkharta malakūt al-asmāʾ bi-an lā tukhayyibanī ʿammā ʿindaka wa-lā tamnaʿanī ʿammā qaddartahu li-umanāʾika wa-aṣfiyāʾika. Ay Rabb, tarānī muqbilan ilayka wa-mutamassikan bi-ḥablika. Asʾaluka bi-an tuʾayyidanī ʿalā al-istiqāmati ʿalā hādhā al-Amr alladhī bihi zallat aqdāmu akthari khalqika. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Mutaʿālī al-Mushfiq al-Ghafūr al-Karīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Thus commands you the One who holds the reins of knowledge in His grasp. Say: O company of religious scholars, cleanse your hearts of what you possess, so that you may hear the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen and the rustling of the Tree of the Utmost Boundary from the praised station. This is a day when neither the treasures of the world nor the ranks of the nations will avail you. Leave them behind you, hoping for what is with God, the Lord of all that has been and will be. We counsel you and those who have believed to show the greatest steadfastness in this Cause, through which the pillars of the names have been shaken, except those whom God, the Lord of existence, has willed. Thus has the ocean of My utterance surged and the fragrance of My loving-kindness spread. When you have seen and perceived, arise and say: “I testify that You accepted the world’s afflictions for the exaltation of the Cause of God, and bore calamities out of love for God, the Creator of heaven and Lord of all names, until You accepted the Most Great Prison for the deliverance of the nations. I ask You by the Most Great Name, through which You have subdued the kingdom of names, not to disappoint me in what is with You or deprive me of what You have ordained for Your trusted and chosen ones. O Lord, You see me turning toward You and holding fast to Your cord. I ask You to strengthen me in steadfastness in this Cause, through which the feet of most of Your creatures have slipped. There is no god but You, the Most Exalted, the Compassionate, the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous.” End.
:::

### 148

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انشآء اللّه مؤیّد شوند بر آنچه از لسان عظمت بآن مأمور شدند و از کؤوس عنایت بیاشامند آشامیدنیکه از منع ظالمین بازنمانند فی‌الحقیقه اگر انسان در این ایّام قسمت نبرد و از فیوضات فیّاض بی‌نصیب ماند بچه چیز دلخوش و مسرور و مشغول بسیار حیف است این اوقات عزیزه بگذرد و انسان غافل باشد انشآءاللّه باید جمیع دوستان همّت بر خدمت گمارند اوّل کلّ بکمال تقدیس و تنزیه و انصاف و مشورت قیام نمایند آنچه را سبب تفریق مشاهده کنند اوّل باصلاح آن توجّه کنند و بعد بروح و ریحان و حکمت بخدمت مشغول گردند اصلاح امور ایشان و عالم همه خواهد شد و امثال این بیان مکرّر از لسان قدم استماع شده صدهزار نعیم و طوبی از برای نفوسیکه قیام نمایند بر آنچه که سبب ارتفاع امر و راحت اهل عالم است و فی‌الحقیقه نفس ارتفاع نفس راحت است ولکن ناس جاهل از اینفقره غافل انشآءاللّه آنمحبوب و اینعبد دعا میکنیم که شاید از شمال جهل بیمین دانائی فائز شوند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
En shāʾ Allāh moʾayyad shavand bar ānche az Lesān-e ʿAẓamat be ān maʾmūr shodand va az koʾūs-e ʿenāyat biyāshāmand, āshāmīdanī ke az manʿ-e ẓālemīn bāz namānand. Fī al-ḥaqīqeh agar ensān dar īn ayyām qesmat nabarad va az foyūżāt-e Fayyāż bī-naṣīb mānad be che chīz delkhosh va masrūr va mashghūl? Besyār ḥeyf ast īn owqāt-e ʿazīzeh bogdharad va ensān ghāfel bāshad. En shāʾ Allāh bāyad jamīʿ-e dūstān hemmat bar khedmat gomārand. Avval koll be kamāl-e taqdīs va tanzīh va enṣāf va mashverat qīyām namāyand. Ānche rā sabab-e tafrīq moshāhedeh konand avval be eṣlāḥ-e ān tavajjoh konand va baʿd be rūḥ va reyḥān va ḥekmat be khedmat mashghūl gardand. Eṣlāḥ-e omūr-e īshān va ʿālam hameh khāhad shod va amthāl-e īn bayān mokarrar az Lesān-e Qedam estemāʿ shodeh. Ṣad hezār naʿīm va ṭūbā az barā-ye nofūsī ke qīyām namāyand bar ānche ke sabab-e ertefāʿ-e Amr va rāḥat-e ahl-e ʿālam ast. Va fī al-ḥaqīqeh nafs-e ertefāʿ nafs-e rāḥat ast va-lāken nās-e jāhel az īn faqareh ghāfel. En shāʾ Allāh ān maḥbūb va īn ʿabd doʿā mīkonīm ke shāyad az shemāl-e jahl be yamīn-e dānāʾī fāʾez shavand.
:::

::: {.translation}
God willing, may they be strengthened to carry out what they were commanded by the Tongue of Grandeur, and drink from the cups of loving-kindness so deeply that the opposition of the oppressors cannot hold them back. In truth, if a person receives no share in these days and remains deprived of the outpourings of the All-Bountiful, what can give that person contentment and joy, and what can occupy them? It is a great pity for these precious times to pass while a person remains heedless. God willing, all the friends should devote their efforts to service. First, let all arise with the utmost purity, sanctity, fairness, and consultation. Whatever they observe to be a cause of division, let them first attend to remedying it, and then engage in service with joy, gladness, and wisdom. Their affairs and those of the whole world will be set right; statements like this have repeatedly been heard from the Tongue of Eternity. A hundred thousand blessings and gladness be upon those souls who arise to do what brings about the exaltation of the Cause and the well-being of the people of the world.
